sections.heading: Our Own Swimwear Factory in China
sections.body:
We make your swimwear in our own single factory in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China. Production and export sit within one company, so quality, cost and delivery stay under our direct control.

[Our factory has been running since 2011](/about-us/). We check quality throughout each order and sell B2B only, through this website and our team. You agree every order directly with us, never through online shops or third-party marketplaces.

[Our production certifications](/sustainability/) include OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for tested fabrics and trims, GRS and RCS for recycled fabrics, bluesign for chemistry, ISO 9001 for quality management and WRAP for social compliance.

sections.heading: Why Brands Source From Our Own Factory

items.title: Independent inspection
items.text: You're welcome to book [pre-shipment inspections](/faq/) with independent inspectors such as SGS or BV before your goods leave our factory.

items.title: Bulk production timing
items.text: Once you approve the sample and we receive your deposit, [bulk production takes 35 to 40 days](/faq/). Your order size and the season set the exact timing.

items.title: Sample courier cost
items.text: [Courier delivery for samples costs USD 50](/faq/), and you pay it on top of the sample fee.

items.title: Direct enquiry response
items.text: When you [contact our team](/contact-us/), you get a reply to every enquiry within one business day.

sections.heading: Custom Swimwear in Every Style and Size

items.title: Women's collections
items.text: We make women's swimwear in contemporary and classic shapes, seamless styles included, in plain or printed fabrics chosen for your collection.

items.title: Men's swimwear
items.text: We make men's swim briefs, board shorts and swim trunks in durable, quick-drying fabrics, with modern cuts, functional waistbands and secure stitching. You choose the specifications and can ask for sample adjustments before production starts.

items.title: Children's collections
items.text: Our dedicated children's lines run from babies to older children and include shorts, sets and boys' pieces with rubber patch labels. We take care of everything from printing to finishing, using soft fabrics, smooth stitching and strong seams, and we test samples for stretch and durability.

items.title: Matching family sets
items.text: We cut matching adult and children's pieces from a single print run, and we agree the fabric quantities for every size group beforehand. Separate runs cause shade and alignment differences that show when the pieces are worn side by side.

items.title: Coordinated couples' swimwear
items.text: We also make paired swimwear for couples, building coordinated looks around the fabric, print and style specifications you choose.

items.title: Beach cover-ups
items.text: We make cover-ups, sarongs, pareos and kaftans to go with your swimwear, in the silhouettes, fabrics, prints and trims you pick.

items.title: Resort clothing and accessories
items.text: You can add headbands, dresses, blouses, tops, skirts and pants to your range. We make them alongside the swimwear, so you get a complete resort collection.

items.title: Crochet and knits
items.text: For beachwear collections, we also make hand-made crochet pieces and space-dyed knits in 100% cotton.

sections.body: You can choose from triangle, bandeau, halter and underwire bikinis, tankinis and monokinis, through to burkinis and high-cut one-pieces.

items.title: Custom fit and construction
items.text: We build made-to-order styles on your patterns and customise the silhouettes, panels, coverage, colours, prints, embroidery, hardware, cups and performance features. During sampling we refine bikini straps, linings and closures, along with the stretch, support and shape retention of one-pieces.

items.title: Plus-size and larger cups
items.text: We fit these samples on a body in the target size. Cup depth, strap angle and coverage all change between sizes, so scaling alone leads to gaping, digging or too little support. The extra sampling round adds time before bulk production.

items.title: Tankini and bandeau fit
items.text: We develop tankini tops that pair with several bottoms and choose the coverage, breathability and stretch. For bandeaus, extra-stretch fabrics, the right linings and sample adjustments give a secure, comfortable grip.

items.title: Long-sleeve and performance styles
items.text: We test long-sleeve samples for UV resistance and stretch and keep plus-size proportions balanced. Performance styles use compression, resistance and speed-focused fabrics, hydrodynamic patterns and reinforced seams, and we test the samples for performance accuracy.

items.title: Fabric sourcing options
items.text: Our [fabric sourcing](/swimwear-fabrics-sourcing/) includes nylon/polyester-spandex blends, such as 80% nylon 20% spandex, with matching linings. Chlorine-resistant LYCRA Xtra Life, ECONYL recycled nylon, REPREVE recycled polyester and Italian Carvico are available on request.

items.title: Custom Printing service
items.text: Our [Custom Printing service](/custom-swimwear-printing/) prints polyester and sun-protection fabrics on our factory's thermal sublimation printer before cutting, so printing and manufacturing happen in the same place.

items.title: Embroidery service limits
items.text: Our [Embroidery service](/swimwear-embroidery/) offers standard machine or hand embroidery plus 3D, reflective and stone finishes. Embroidery and screen printing need 50 pieces per design, thread colours come from the available libraries, and custom woven labels need 1,000 pieces.

items.title: Swimwear Hardware service
items.text: Our [Swimwear Hardware service](/swimwear-hardware/) supplies colour-matched straps, rings, sliders, hooks and buckles in metal, plastic, resin or eco-friendly materials, along with drawstrings, eyelets and zippers.

sections.heading: OEM Swimwear Production, From Sample to Shipment

items.title: OEM production
items.text: If you already have tested patterns and a tech pack, OEM is your route. We produce to your existing specifications and check every stage against them.

items.title: ODM design development
items.text: If you have a brand concept but no developed designs yet, ODM is your route. It includes the design development needed to create exclusive styles for your brand.

items.title: In-house design team
items.text: You can start with a design, a picture or just an idea. Our team handles the patterns, grading and fit development, which means less design back-and-forth for you.

items.title: Development service
items.text: Our [Development service](/development/) turns your concepts into production-ready samples in 10 to 15 days. Grading from XS to 3XL is free, and we grade against US, EU or UK charts, your own fit references, or charts we develop for your market.

items.title: Private label collections
items.text: Our private label service covers both existing and custom designs. Your branding goes on the finished garments, and ours never does.

items.title: Collection customisation
items.text: You decide the fit, construction, materials, features, finishes and size ranges. We help you select fabrics, match colours and develop silhouettes for your label.

items.title: Logo positioning
items.text: You choose where your logo goes. We confirm the label type and position during sampling, before we make your branded collection.

items.title: Labels against wet skin
items.text: A woven neck label rubs against wet skin and pulls at thin necklines. A tagless heat-transfer label sits flat, and you can't feel it.

items.title: Individual branded packing
items.text: We mark and pack each piece individually in custom packaging built around your logo. We work directly with you all the way through worldwide delivery.

items.title: Packaging and labels service
items.text: Our [Swimwear Packaging & Custom Brand Labels service](/swimwear-packaging-custom-brand-labels/) includes a heat-transfer label, a hygiene liner and a hang tag, carrying your inside-back logo, washing instructions and size information. You can also add branded clips, silicone logos and fabric tags.

items.title: Launch service packages
items.text: The starter pack in our [Launch service](/swimwear-launch-services/) contains three finished samples, twenty fabric swatches, a stock-style catalogue and a launch guide. We also offer separate packages for designing, developing and manufacturing your first collection, as well as consulting.

items.title: Free quotation
items.text: For a [free quote](/request-a-quote/), email or WhatsApp us your tech pack or design, or coded front and back drawings or screenshots. Include your fabrics, colours, prints, quantities, sizing and packing needs. We assess feasibility and quote you an estimated price and timing. Then we agree the specifications, minimums and availability with you before you order.

items.title: Brief and specifications
items.text: We go through your brief with you in a consultation and confirm the technical requirements, including fabric and stretch. Then we send you digital mockups to approve.

items.title: Sampling before commitment
items.text: We source and prepare the materials, then revise and fit-test development samples. That way you can judge the product before you commit to bulk manufacturing.

items.title: Written fit approval
items.text: We don't cut any bulk fabric until you approve the final fit sample in writing. Changes made after cutting waste fabric and delay the schedule.

items.title: Production and finishing
items.text: We manage cutting, sewing and assembly, followed by washing and functional finishing. We also handle sourcing and inspections for you for the whole order.

items.title: Shipment and support
items.text: Once your goods pass inspection, we pack them and store them until they ship. After that, our team is still available for after-sales support.

items.title: Minimum order quantity
items.text: Orders start at 50 pieces per style in each colour, so small and growing labels can place production orders.

items.title: First trial runs
items.text: We agree first-trial quantities case by case. How flexible we can be on quantity depends on what production allows for your order.

items.title: Sample and design fees
items.text: Each sample costs USD 50. Design costs USD 50 per design, meaning per pattern or print, with all its colourways included. Neither fee is refunded or credited against bulk orders.

items.title: Payment schedule
items.text: You pay a 50% deposit when you confirm the order. The remaining 50% is due before your goods ship.

items.title: Shipping terms
items.text: We ship FOB, CIF or DDP. With worldwide DDP you get one all-in price for delivery to your door, and we handle freight, customs and duties.

items.title: Quality problem resolution
items.text: Under our [quality terms](/terms-and-conditions/), report any defects within 7 days of receiving your goods and send photos or videos. Once we've assessed them, we repair, remake, replace or credit the affected pieces. Shipping and handling are not refunded.

sections.heading: Wholesale Swimwear, Ready to Brand and Ship
sections.body:
Our ready-to-brand wholesale swimwear is already designed, patterned and graded to international body sizes. That cuts your development cost and your fit risk for a first collection. You can build your main range from these styles and add custom shapes as your signature pieces.

The collections cover women, men, children and plus sizes, with full, medium or cheeky bottom coverage, and we update the designs each season. You pick the styles, fabrics and colours. We produce them under your brand with your own custom heat-pressed logo.

If you choose designs we've already developed, you skip sampling and place a bulk PO in the colours and prints you want. Production starts once you approve the digital proof in writing. There's no physical sample, so that proof is your last chance to catch errors before manufacturing. Check the print scale, placement and colour on it carefully.

In-stock styles leave us within 24 hours, or within 7 business days at the latest. Email us to see more of the models and colours we have available.

We keep steady stock of selected wholesale styles, so you can place repeat orders. Ask us for our design catalogue. Once you've sent your enquiry, we send you line sheets with the available styles and their wholesale prices.

We arrange stock samples within 1 to 2 days. Order one before you decide between screen printing, heat transfers, embroidery or fabric logo labels, so you match the technique to the actual fabric. The fabric's texture and stretch affect how the finish looks and how long it lasts.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions

qa.question: Which kinds of swimwear do you make, such as bikinis, one-pieces, swim shorts and cover-ups, and is it for women, men and children?
qa.answer: Yes, we make swimwear for women, men and children. That covers bikinis, tankinis, one-pieces, monokinis, rash guards, swim shorts, board shorts and swim briefs, as well as sarongs, kaftans and beach dresses. We work from your designs or from our existing styles, in sizes XS to 3XL, and up to 5XL for plus sizes.

qa.question: How do you check the fit and finish of each order before it ships?
qa.answer: Before bulk production, we refine and fit-test your samples. After that we check the incoming fabric, the cutting and the sewing, run random checks during production and finish with a full final inspection. Before packing, we check the components against the sample you approved.

qa.question: Can you handle the whole job, including fabric sourcing, trims, labels and packaging, or do we have to supply some of it?
qa.answer: We handle the whole job under one roof, from fabric sourcing, hardware and accessories to labels, packaging and export shipping. You don't have to supply any of these components. Because we check them all together against your approved sample, there are fewer handoffs between suppliers and less risk of mismatched trims, wrong labels or packing errors.

facts.text: We manufacture swimwear ourselves in a single factory of our own in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China.
Production and export sit in one company that owns its factory, so quality, cost and delivery stay under our direct control.
The factory has been running since 2011.
Our production holds OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for tested fabrics and trims, GRS and RCS for recycled fabrics, bluesign for chemistry, ISO 9001 for quality management and WRAP for social compliance.
Quality is checked at every stage of an order: fabric on arrival, cutting, sewing, then random checks and a full final inspection.
Independent inspectors such as SGS or BV are welcome to check the goods before they ship.
We reply to every enquiry within one business day.

We are a business-to-business manufacturer: this website and our own team are our only sales channels. We have no online shop and no store on any third-party marketplace or platform, and every order is agreed directly with our team.

We produce bikinis, one-piece swimsuits, tankinis, seamless styles and swim trunks, as well as kids' swimwear and matching sets, in plain or printed fabrics. Alongside the swimwear we make cover-ups, sarongs, pareos and kaftans in a range of silhouettes, using the fabric, print and trim you choose, plus headbands and resort pieces such as dresses, blouses, tops, skirts and pants.

We make women's swimwear, including bikinis, one-pieces, contemporary cuts and cup-sized styles. We also make men's swimwear and swim trunks, plus-size lines, long-sleeve suits and resort wear, plus custom swimwear for every age from babies to adults.

Alongside women's swimwear we make men's styles to your specification: men's bikinis, board shorts and swim trunks in eco-friendly fabric, with the pattern, fabric, colours and style chosen by your brand. Men's pieces are cut in modern shapes from durable, quick-drying fabrics, with functional waistbands and secure stitching. Before mass production starts, you can ask us to adjust the sample.

We run dedicated children's swimwear lines and handle every step ourselves, from printing the fabric to the finishing details. Boys' swimwear can carry custom rubber patch labels, and we also make kids' shorts and matching kids' sets. We can also make coordinated family looks, such as mother-and-daughter suits cut from one shared print or paired swimwear for couples. For children's pieces we choose soft, skin-friendly fabrics and sew them with smooth stitching and strong seams. Before bulk production starts, we test your samples for stretch and durability.
For beachwear we also make hand-made crochet pieces and space-dyed knits in 100% cotton.

Our bikini styles cover triangle, bandeau, halter, high-neck, high-waisted, micro, string, underwire and tankini cuts, as well as trikinis, monokinis and classic shapes. We also make plus-size and curvy fits, bikini shorts, mix-and-match separates, reversible designs, burkinis and resort wear, and we can produce whatever cut you have in mind.
For bikinis and swim trunks, you choose the pattern, fabric, colour and style.

For one-piece swimwear, we work with performance fabrics that give stretch, support and shape retention. We develop necklines, coverage levels and paneling to your brief and refine each sample for fit before bulk production. Our teams then manage the cutting, stitching and quality checks.

For bikinis, we choose fabrics for stretch, colourfastness and comfort and fine-tune the straps, linings and closures during sampling. We make fit adjustments before bulk manufacturing and manage production from design through to delivery.

You can customise every element of your bikinis, high-cut one-pieces and other one-piece styles: silhouette, fabric, colourway, print, embroidery, hardware, underwires, complex cup sizes and performance features. Custom styles are built on your own patterns and made to order.

We can design tankini tops that pair with several of the bikinis in your line, and produce tops and bottoms as separate pieces that can be combined into sets. Our tankini designs and sizing are flexible, and we select fabrics for coverage, breathability and stretch. On bandeau styles we combine fabrics with extra stretch with suitable linings and fine-tune the samples until they grip securely and feel comfortable.
We make custom plus-size collections. Plus-size styles are fully customisable, and we produce curvy fits and larger cup sizes.
For long sleeve swimwear, we pick fabrics for UV resistance and stretch and test every design at the sampling stage. We adjust plus-size samples so the sizing stays proportional.

Our performance swimwear is built from fabrics chosen for compression, resistance and speed. It is cut to hydrodynamic patterns and sewn with reinforced seams, and we test the samples for performance accuracy.

We make swimwear from nylon and polyester swimwear fabrics blended with spandex, such as 80% nylon 20% spandex, with matching linings. On request we source chlorine-resistant LYCRA Xtra Life, recycled nylon such as ECONYL, recycled polyester such as REPREVE, and Italian Carvico fabrics.

We print your designs on our own thermal sublimation printer in the factory, on polyester and sun-protection fabrics, before the fabric goes to the cutting room. That keeps printing and the rest of manufacturing under one roof.

For a longer-lasting result, we can embroider your logo by machine or by hand in standard, 3D, reflective or stone embroidery. Embroidery and screen printing each have a minimum of 50 pieces per design, and thread colours are limited to the thread libraries available. Custom woven labels have a minimum of 1,000 pieces.
We supply straps, rings, sliders, hooks and buckles in metal, plastic, resin or eco-friendly materials, colour-matched to your fabric and prints. We also supply drawstrings, eyelets and zippers.
Both OEM and ODM work is possible: a new style can start from your own design, a picture or just an idea.
An in-house design team handles pattern design, grading and fit development, which saves you rounds of back-and-forth on the design.
With OEM, we mass-produce your existing designs to your exact specifications. You give us your requirements and we take care of the details, including design, colours and other specifications.
With ODM, our team creates exclusive designs for your brand.

In our own design studio, pattern makers, technical designers and our R&D and sampling teams take your bikinis, swim trunks and one-pieces from the first sketch or concept to a sample that is ready for production. We draft the patterns, sew a development sample, and adjust the silhouette, fit, cuts, linings and trims during sampling. The result is a style that belongs only to your brand and follows current trends, and we turn samples around quickly.

We size your swimwear for the markets you sell into, grading each style from XS to 3XL against US, EU or UK size charts and refining the fit as the sizes are built, with no charge for grading any size. You can send us your own size chart, measurement sheet or a reference garment and we will cut to it; once a chart is based on your fit model, every piece in the production run is checked against it, and the grading rules are fixed separately for each style. If you have no chart yet, our pattern makers draw one up for your target market, covering buyers in the EU, UK, US, Australia and the Middle East, and we can also prepare team size charts for club and school programmes. Our styles are made for women, men and children.

Alongside OEM and ODM production, our private label service lets you customise the design, logo, print, fabric, labels, packaging and hardware. Wholesale is also available, and because design and manufacturing both happen with us, you work with us directly from first idea to delivery anywhere in the world.

Our private label service covers both our ready-to-go styles and your custom designs, so you can tailor the design, fabric, labels and packaging and market the finished pieces under your brand name. We place your logo wherever you want it, sew your woven label into the neck or use tagless heat-transfer labels instead, and add branded tags and branded cardboard hangtags, leaving none of our own branding on the garment. Each piece is marked and packed individually in custom packaging built around your brand logo, and we can supply size charts too. Along the way we help you choose fabrics, match colours and develop silhouettes.

You can customise the fit and construction, the fabric and materials, the features, the colour and finish, and your branding and logos. This lets you build a complete custom-designed collection, including new styles developed just for your brand.
You choose the materials, designs, prints and colours, and we adapt the styles, colourways and size ranges to match the look you want for your label.

Standard branding on each piece is a heat-transfer label, a hygiene liner and a hang tag. We heat-press your logo on the inside back of every item, together with washing instructions and the size breakdown. Your logo can also go on bikini clips, hygiene liners and custom packaging. Other branding options include woven neck labels, silicone logos, branded fabric tags, logo cards and hang tags.

If you are starting a new label, our starter pack includes three finished samples, twenty fabric swatches, a catalogue of the ready-made styles we keep in stock and a short guide to launching your own swimwear brand. For your first collection, we also offer separate startup packages that cover design, development and manufacturing. Many new labels use these together with our consulting service.
Most partnerships begin with samples so quality can be judged first, and the bulk order follows once they are approved.

A typical order moves from your brief or tech pack to a sample in 10 to 15 days, then to your approval and deposit, 35 to 40 days of bulk production depending on size and season, a full final inspection, and shipment on FOB, CIF or DDP terms.

Every order runs through the same set of steps. We begin with a concept call or design consultation to review your brief. Next we confirm the technical specifications, including fabric and stretch, and develop the design and patterns, with digital mockups sent to you for approval. Then we source and prepare the fabric and make samples, which we revise and fit-test until you approve the fit. Bulk production follows: precision cutting, sewing and assembly, sublimation printing or embroidery where needed, then washing and functional finishing, with checks during each stage. After a final quality inspection, the goods are packed and stored until they ship, and we stay available for after-sales support. Once you place the order, we handle the sourcing and the inspections for you.
A standard sample is ready in 10 to 15 days.
Once the sample is approved and the deposit received, bulk production usually needs 35 to 40 days, depending on order size and season.

Quotes cost nothing. To get one, tell us your preferred materials, designs, prints and colours, and send your tech pack or design with the order quantity, size chart and packing needs; if you have no tech pack, front and back screenshots or line drawings marked with style codes and your chosen fabrics and colours also work. You can send everything by email or WhatsApp. We check that the style can be made, reply with an estimated price and timing on a quotation sheet, and usually set up a phone call to go over the products, artwork, sizing, quantities, pricing and minimums. Once you confirm quantities, colours and customisation, we confirm availability and lead times and agree every detail before the order is placed.
Orders start at 50 pieces per style in each colour, a level set so that small and growing labels can order.
A first trial run is agreed case by case, and we are as flexible on its quantity as production allows.
Each sample costs USD 50, and the design fee is USD 50 per design (its pattern or print, with all colourways); these fees are not refunded or credited against the bulk order.
Shipments go out on FOB, CIF or DDP terms; DDP is available worldwide, and under DDP one all-in price covers delivery to your door, with duties, customs and freight handled by us.
We take a 50% deposit when the order is confirmed, and the remaining 50% is paid before shipment.
Courier delivery of samples costs USD 50, paid by the buyer in addition to the sample fee.

If you find a quality problem, report it within 7 days of receiving the goods and include photos or videos. After assessing the defect, we repair, remake or replace the pieces, or credit you for their cost. Shipping and handling charges are not refunded.

If you would rather not start from scratch, you can choose from ready-to-brand collections for women, men, kids and plus sizes. We keep developing these alongside our fully custom work. The styles are already designed and patterned, and they are graded in advance to international body sizes. Bottoms come in full, medium or cheeky coverage, and our designers refresh the collections every season to follow trends. You select styles from the range, specify your fabrics and colours, and we produce and label them under your brand, adding your custom heat-pressed logo.
You can mix our ready-to-order styles with your own custom shapes in one collection, so you don't have to design every piece from scratch.

Because these designs are already developed, you can skip sampling and place a bulk PO directly in the colours and prints you want. Production starts as soon as you approve the digital proofs in writing, so these styles reach shipment quickly.
Our in-stock styles leave within 24 hours, or within 7 business days at the latest. Ask us by email and we will send you more of the models and colours we have in stock.
Alongside made-to-order production, some styles are held in stock for wholesale buyers.
Some styles are held in stock for wholesale buyers, and we keep their supply steady so that you can place repeat orders with confidence.

On request we send a catalogue of our existing designs, and after your enquiry we follow up with line sheets showing the available styles and their wholesale prices. These designs are most often personalised with screen or heat-transfer printing, embroidery or fabric logo labels. Samples of styles we hold in stock can be arranged within 1 to 2 days.

We’ve run our [factory and export business](/about-us/) since 2011, so quality, cost and delivery stay under our direct control. We check quality all the way through each order. We agree every B2B order directly with you through our website and team, never through online or third-party shops.

sections.heading: Inclusive Fits for Every Body: Extended Sizes, Cup Grading and Long Torsos

items.title: Extended sizing
items.text: For your collection, we make large-bust OEM/ODM swimwear in a range of colours, in sizes up to 3XL.

items.title: Band-and-cup grading
items.text: We grade tops to your own size chart, for example 32D to 38G. Our structured underwire tops cover D to DD+ and go up to G cup.

items.title: Size allocation
items.text: Each band-and-cup combination counts as one size. A wider cup range splits your order across more sizes and needs more fit approvals than letter sizing does.

items.title: Dedicated fit blocks
items.text: Stretching one letter-size pattern across different bust and torso shapes leaves cups gaping and straps digging in. We use band-and-cup grading and dedicated torso lengths instead.

items.title: Long-torso adjustment
items.text: You can have long-torso grading on every one-piece and tankini. It adds roughly 5 cm in total above and below the waist, and the bust and leg lines stay where they are.

items.title: Measurements to send
items.text: Send us your customer’s bust, waist, hip, height and torso girth. If the girth is more than 4 cm over our chart, we switch to the long-torso block.

items.title: Measuring torso girth
items.text: Stand straight. Run the tape from one shoulder down the front, between the legs and up the back to where it started, keeping it snug against bare skin or a thin layer.

items.title: Detail-specific samples
items.text: Any style with cut-outs, cross-back straps or placed prints gets its own fit sample, so those details stay in the right place.

items.title: Shaping construction
items.text: Our wholesale tummy-control one-pieces and bikinis, high-waisted cuts included, use power mesh front panels, double front linings or full compression bodies, either alone or combined.

items.title: Control levels
items.text: You choose the level: light control with 160 GSM mesh, medium with a 200 GSM panel, or firm with a 240 GSM panel plus a double lining.

items.title: Control by use
items.text: We use firm compression for structured shaping one-pieces and lighter control for everyday styles and high-waisted bottoms. If a shaping piece has too little compression, it won’t give the smoothing it was designed for.

items.title: Compression trade-offs
items.text: Too much compression makes comfort styles hard to put on and uncomfortable to wear all day. Firmer control also adds layers, warmth, drying time and manufacturing cost.

items.title: Maternity silhouettes
items.text: We develop maternity one-pieces, tankinis and bikinis. They have high-waisted bottoms that sit above or below the bump, ruched side panels that expand, and fronts cut 4 to 6 cm longer.

items.title: Bust and nursing support
items.text: Shelf bras or soft cups provide maternity support. For nursing, we add pull-aside or clip-down cups to your design.

items.title: Maternity one-piece comfort
items.text: Our maternity one-pieces have adjustable straps and a full soft lining, and they’re made without underwire.

items.title: Contoured shaping
items.text: In our [Plus Size Swimwear](/plus-size-swimwear-manufacturer/) range, we shape the silhouette for your collection with contoured seam lines.

sections.heading: Performance Features Built for Comfort, Support and Durability

items.title: Functional options
items.text: We add UPF50+ sun protection, underwire support, quick-dry fabric and chlorine-resistant stitching to match your swimwear specification.

items.title: Construction compatibility
items.text: Underwire needs the right channel and padding. Chlorine-resistant stitching needs chlorine-resistant elastic underneath it, or the construction won’t stand up to chlorine.

items.title: Sample confirmation
items.text: We confirm all the features together on your fit sample, checking the padding system, sewing method and adjustable straps for fit and comfort.

items.title: Development trade-offs
items.text: Each feature you add brings more materials to check and test, so it raises the cost and adds sampling time for those checks.

sections.heading: Premium and Recycled Fabrics With Water-Based Digital Prints
sections.body: We cut custom bikinis and one-pieces from premium fabrics. For sustainable lines, we pair recycled nylon with water-based digital printing.

items.title: Actual-fabric approval
items.text: Before bulk production, we get your approval on a printed strike-off. Recycled and virgin bases take ink differently, so the actual fabric is what sets the colour and sharpness.

items.title: Cost and timing
items.text: Recycled fabric and strike-off approval cost more and take longer than stock fabric and screen-printed colours.

items.title: Fabric sourcing
items.text: Our [Swimwear Fabrics & Sourcing service](/swimwear-fabrics-sourcing/) supplies lined nylon/polyester-spandex options, including 80% nylon 20% spandex. Branded or recycled fabrics, textures, metallic yarns and custom dyeing are each quoted as a separate premium. Italian fabric carries the largest premium when you order below a full minimum run.

items.title: Production credentials
items.text: Our [sustainability credentials](/sustainability/) cover OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for tested fabrics and trims, GRS and RCS for recycled fabrics, bluesign for chemistry, ISO 9001 for quality management and WRAP for social compliance.

items.title: Custom print development
items.text: Our [Custom Printing service](/custom-swimwear-printing/) gives you chlorine-proof, high-resolution sublimation, digital printing and nearly any colour or print that can be sourced. Exclusive patterns add cost and lead time.

sections.heading: Custom Swimwear Embellishment: Rhinestones, Beads and Trims

items.title: Decoration placement
items.text: We place rhinestones, handcrafted beading and built-in hardware away from spots where they would rub skin or catch on fabric. Dense hand-beading is kept for statement styles.

items.title: Design-specific pricing
items.text: Embellishment raises the unit price and the lead time. We quote each design on its stone count, beading density and choice of hardware, and we put most of the decoration on styles where looks come first.

items.title: Custom bead minimums
items.text: Custom-moulded, colour-matched beads start at 1,000 pieces per design and colour. This minimum is separate from the garment order minimum.

items.title: Hand-beading schedule
items.text: Hand-beading adds 1 to 2 weeks to bulk production. Denser work takes longer.

items.title: Hand-finished care
items.text: Hand-finished pieces need gentler care, so we recommend them for resort and statement styles rather than active swimming.

items.title: Branded metal hardware
items.text: Our [Swimwear Hardware service](/swimwear-hardware/) supplies branded metal components that resist saltwater and chlorine. Standard hardware starts at 100 to 500 pieces per colour or size. Logo, embossed or special-finish items start at 1,000 pieces per item.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions

qa.question: Can you grade women's plus-size swimwear above 3XL, and up to what size and cup size?
qa.answer: Yes. Our standard grading runs from XS to 3XL, and our Plus Size Swimwear range goes past that, up to 5XL. Our structured underwire tops go up to G cup.

qa.question: How do you stop removable cups from moving or folding inside the suit after washing?
qa.answer: We cut the cup pockets to the exact shape of the cup and give them side openings with a 1 cm overlap. The cup edges are rounded and tapered, so they sit flat against the lining. If you ask, we add a stitched tack point or a small hook-and-loop tab at the base of each pocket. We then wash the sample 5 times to confirm the cups stay flat and don't shift or fold.

qa.question: Which outer-fabric and lining combinations do you use to keep white and pale swimwear opaque when wet and stretched?
qa.answer: We pair a dense 190 to 220 GSM warp-knit tricot shell with a self-fabric double layer, a 140 GSM stretch tricot lining or a lined front panel. Being opaque when dry doesn't prove a fabric covers when it's wet. That's why we check your sample wet and stretched, along with the removable-cup wash test.

facts.text: We manufacture swimwear ourselves in a single factory of our own in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China.
We make women's bikinis, one-piece swimsuits, tankinis and performance athletic swimsuits, and our bikinis come in a wide choice of cuts and colors.
We also produce long-sleeve swimwear designed for sun protection.
The factory has been running since 2011.

We are a business-to-business manufacturer: this website and our own team are our only sales channels. We have no online shop and no store on any third-party marketplace or platform, and every order is agreed directly with our team.
Production and export sit in one company that owns its factory, so quality, cost and delivery stay under our direct control.
For large-bust customers, we offer OEM/ODM swimwear in a range of colors, with sizing up to 3XL.

Yes, we can grade large-bust tops by band and cup size to your own size chart instead of letter sizes, for example 32D to 38G, and each band-and-cup combination counts as one size. Our structured underwire tops run from D to DD+ and up to G cup.

Every one-piece and tankini in our range can be graded to a long-torso fit. This adds roughly 5 cm of body length, split between the areas above and below the waist so the bust and leg lines don't move. Tell us your target customer's bust, waist, hip, height and torso girth. If the torso girth is more than 4 cm over our chart for that size, we switch to our long-torso block. Styles with cut-outs, cross-back straps or placed prints get their own fit sample so those details stay where they belong. To measure torso girth, stand straight and start the tape at the top of one shoulder. Take it over the front of the body, between the legs and up the back to where you began. Keep it snug against bare skin or a thin layer.
Our tummy control range covers shaping one-piece and bikini designs, including high-waisted cuts, and is available for your wholesale orders.

Tummy control in our shaping one-pieces and high-waisted bottoms comes from a power mesh front panel, a double front lining or a full compression fabric body, used alone or together. You choose how firm it is: light control with a 160 GSM mesh panel, medium with a 200 GSM panel, or firm with a 240 GSM panel plus double lining.

We develop maternity swimwear as one-pieces, tankinis and bikinis, including high-waisted bottoms that can sit either above or below the bump. Ruched stretch panels at the sides expand as the bump grows, and the front is cut 4 to 6 cm longer. Bust support comes from a built-in shelf bra or soft cups, and for nursing we add pull-aside or clip-down cups. Our maternity one-pieces also have adjustable straps and a full soft lining with no underwire.
We use contoured seam lines to shape the silhouette.
We can add UPF50+ sun protection, underwire support, quick-dry fabric and chlorine-resistant stitching to your swimwear.
We check the details that decide fit and comfort in every piece: the padding system, the sewing method and adjustable straps.
We cut your custom bikinis and one-piece swimsuits from premium fabrics.
For sustainable bikinis and swimsuits, we work with recycled nylon and apply prints by water-based digital printing.

We make swimwear from nylon and polyester swimwear fabrics blended with spandex, such as 80% nylon 20% spandex, with matching linings. On request we source chlorine-resistant LYCRA Xtra Life, recycled nylon such as ECONYL, recycled polyester such as REPREVE, and Italian Carvico fabrics.

Branded and recycled options such as LYCRA Xtra Life, Carvico, ECONYL and REPREVE are priced above our standard nylon or polyester spandex blends. Your quotation shows the fabric difference on its own line, so you can weigh both choices for each style. Italian fabric adds the most to your cost when your order is too small to use a full minimum run. Metallic yarns, textured surfaces and custom dyeing also cost more than stock colours.
Our production holds OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for tested fabrics and trims, GRS and RCS for recycled fabrics, bluesign for chemistry, ISO 9001 for quality management and WRAP for social compliance.
Our high-resolution sublimation prints are chlorine proof.

For custom designs we can source nearly any colour or print, and we offer digital printing for your swimwear range. Available print themes include floral, paisley, retro, zigzag, animal, strawberry, lemon and watercolour. We can also develop exclusive prints and patterns just for you, though these cost more and add to the lead time.
We decorate custom bikinis and swimsuits with rhinestones, hand-bead swimwear with handcrafted embellishments, and can build hardware and beads into your designs.

Rhinestones, hand-beading and built-in hardware each raise the unit price of your bikini or swimsuit, and we quote that extra cost for each design based on the number of stones, how dense the beading is and which hardware pieces you use. Hand-beaded styles start at our standard 50 pieces per style in each colour, while custom-moulded, colour-matched beads start at 1,000 pieces per design and colour, and hand-beading adds 1 to 2 weeks to our usual 35 to 40 day bulk lead time, depending on how dense the work is.

You can add custom-branded metal hardware that stands up to salt water and chlorine. Standard hardware usually starts at 100 to 500 pieces per colour or size. Stoppers, clasps, hooks, sliders and rings with your own logo or emboss start at 1,000 pieces per item, as do special finishes.
A standard sample is ready in 10 to 15 days.
Each sample costs USD 50, and the design fee is USD 50 per design (its pattern or print, with all colourways); these fees are not refunded or credited against the bulk order.
We support OEM and ODM for bikinis, one-pieces and athletic styles, and we can customize one-piece swimsuits for your private label and bulk orders.

We can make your women's swimwear with fabric, cups, elastic and other trims you supply. Fabric should be a nylon or polyester blend with spandex, like our 180–200 GSM 80/20 nylon-spandex, and it must come with its composition, weight and stretch data so we can test shrinkage, colour fastness and stretch before cutting; cups and elastic must be swim-grade and chlorine-resistant, and we check 2 pieces of each on your sample first.
Both OEM and ODM work is possible: a new style can start from your own design, a picture or just an idea.
An in-house design team handles pattern design, grading and fit development, which saves you rounds of back-and-forth on the design.
Courier delivery of samples costs USD 50, paid by the buyer in addition to the sample fee.

For new and established brands alike, we take custom bikinis and one-piece suits through a single full-package service, from your first brief to after-sales support. It begins with a consultation and design development, then tech pack and pattern creation, pattern adjustments, print development and placement, and sourcing of fabrics and trims from suppliers worldwide, with our technical advice at every step. Next come prototypes and full samples, a fit review, grading and pre-production samples. In bulk we handle precise cutting, sewing, printing or embroidery, washing, finishing and trimming, followed by label printing and private-label branding, quality control, retail-ready packaging and shipping to any destination, with logistics arranged by our in-house team. Every element can be customised, from fabric and silhouette to branded labels and packaging.

Each item comes retail-ready with biodegradable packaging, branded accessories and your logo heat-pressed inside. Pieces can have cardboard tags with connectors and be wrapped by hand, one by one, in their own packaging. Where possible, we make labels and packaging in-house.
Orders start at 50 pieces per style in each colour, a level set so that small and growing labels can order.
A first trial run is agreed case by case, and we are as flexible on its quantity as production allows.
Once the sample is approved and the deposit received, bulk production usually needs 35 to 40 days, depending on order size and season.
We take a 50% deposit when the order is confirmed, and the remaining 50% is paid before shipment.
Shipments go out on FOB, CIF or DDP terms; DDP is available worldwide, and under DDP one all-in price covers delivery to your door, with duties, customs and freight handled by us.

A typical order moves from your brief or tech pack to a sample in 10 to 15 days, then to your approval and deposit, 35 to 40 days of bulk production depending on size and season, a full final inspection, and shipment on FOB, CIF or DDP terms.
You buy factory-direct from us. Our MOQs are flexible and our production scales up as your order volume grows.
Quality is checked at every stage of an order: fabric on arrival, cutting, sewing, then random checks and a full final inspection.

If you find a quality problem, report it within 7 days of receiving the goods and include photos or videos. After assessing the defect, we repair, remake or replace the pieces, or credit you for their cost. Shipping and handling charges are not refunded.

Once we have all your design information, we prepare a detailed quotation within 2 to 3 working days. It covers everything from sampling to manufacturing, including fabrics, accessories, branding, labelling, production and shipping, and can be based on front and back images, tech packs or clear line drawings.
We reply to every enquiry within one business day.
Our standard women's swimwear is graded XS to 3XL, and our Plus Size Swimwear range goes above that up to 5XL.

We keep removable cups in place with a pocket cut to the exact cup shape, a side opening with a 1 cm overlap, and cups with rounded, tapered edges that lie flat against the lining. On request we add a stitched tack point or a small hook-and-loop tab at the base of each pocket, and we wash-test the sample 5 times to confirm the cups stay flat and do not shift or fold.

For white and pale swimwear we cut the shell from dense warp-knit tricot of 190 to 220 GSM and back it with a self-fabric double layer, a 140 GSM stretch tricot lining or a lined front panel, so the piece stays opaque once wet.

pages.title: One-Piece Swimsuit Manufacturer, OEM & ODM | Strandmill
pages.meta_description: One-piece swimsuit manufacturer with its own Guangzhou factory: necklines, backs and cut-outs to your spec, XS to 3XL, from 50 pieces per style and colour.
pages.h1: Custom One-Piece Swimsuit Manufacturer for Your Brand
pages.hero_lead: Whether you bring your own designs for OEM or build on our styles through ODM, your range can include monokinis and cut-out designs made in our Guangzhou factory.

sections.heading: OEM One-Piece Swimsuits and ODM Programs
sections.body: We build custom one-piece swimsuits for you in two ways. OEM programs are made from your own designs, and ODM programs are developed from our styles. Whether you start from your design or one of ours, your range can include monokinis and cut-out designs.

sections.heading: One-Piece Styles From Our Block Library
sections.body: For ODM styles, we start from the library block closest to your target market and adapt it.

items.title: Classic maillot
items.text: You can start from our classic one-piece block, which has a clean square or scoop neckline.

items.title: Sculpting monokini
items.text: This sculpting silhouette has cut-outs shaped at the side or front and joined with connecting hardware.

items.title: One-shoulder silhouette
items.text: We develop asymmetric one-shoulder styles for your range, finished with either a single strap or a ruffle detail.

items.title: Deep-V plunge
items.text: An internal power-mesh layer holds the deep-V plunge silhouette and supports the shape of the suit.

items.title: Surf and active styles
items.text: For surf and modest-leaning markets, we offer long-sleeve swim tops and zip-front styles. We also offer sport-cut racerbacks with wide straps and more back coverage.

items.title: Specialist fit ranges
items.text: Our [women’s swimwear range](/women-s-swimwear-manufacturer/) includes wholesale tummy-control styles and maternity fronts cut 4 to 6 cm longer. It also includes long-torso fits that add roughly 5 cm when torso girth exceeds our chart by more than 4 cm.

sections.heading: Our Own Swimwear Factory in Guangzhou, China

items.title: Our own factory
items.text: We make your swimwear ourselves, in our single factory in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China.

items.title: Direct factory control
items.text: We have run as a [factory-owned business](/about-us/) since 2011, handling production and export ourselves. We sell only directly, through our team and website, and we check quality at every stage from incoming fabric to final inspection.

items.title: Inspection and sample delivery
items.text: Under our [inspection and sample arrangements](/faq/), you're welcome to bring in SGS or BV before shipment. Courier delivery of samples costs you USD 50, which is charged separately from sample fees.

items.title: Production credentials
items.text: Our [production certifications](/sustainability/) cover OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for tested fabrics and trims, GRS/RCS for recycled fabrics, bluesign chemistry, ISO 9001 quality management and WRAP social compliance.

items.title: Full-package Launch service
items.text: Our [Launch service](/swimwear-launch-services/) takes your custom one-pieces all the way from consultation and development through sampling, production, branding, quality control, packaging, worldwide shipping and after-sales support.

items.title: Labels and branding
items.text: With our [Swimwear Packaging & Custom Brand Labels service](/swimwear-packaging-custom-brand-labels/), your branding goes in during manufacture. Options are tagless heat transfers, recycled woven or printed labels, and logo printing after sewing.

items.title: Embroidery service minimums
items.text: Our [Embroidery service](/swimwear-embroidery/) needs 50 pieces per design for embroidery or screen printing and 1,000 pieces for custom woven labels. Thread colours come from the available libraries.

sections.heading: Private Label One-Piece Orders: MOQ, Samples, Lead Times and Payment

items.title: Order quantities
items.text: Orders start at 50 pieces per style in each colour. For a first trial, we agree the quantity with you case by case, within production limits.

items.title: Samples and design fees
items.text: A standard sample takes 10 to 15 days and costs USD 50. Design costs USD 50 per pattern or print and covers all colourways. Neither fee is refunded or credited against bulk.

items.title: Bulk production timing
items.text: Once you approve the sample and we receive your deposit, bulk production takes 35 to 40 days, depending on order size and season.

items.title: Payment schedule
items.text: You pay a 50% deposit when we confirm your order and the remaining 50% before shipment.

items.title: Shipping terms
items.text: We ship FOB, CIF or DDP. Worldwide DDP gives you one all-in price delivered to your door, and we handle duties, customs and freight.

items.title: Development and fit approval
items.text: Our [Development service](/development/) handles patterns and grading in-house. We revise samples based on your feedback, sign off fit against the measurements and check every graded size before production.

items.title: Quotation before sampling
items.text: Through our [quotation process](/request-a-quote/), you get detailed costs from sampling to shipping within 2 to 3 working days of sending us complete front-and-back images, tech packs or clear drawings. Sampling starts once we agree on the price.

items.title: Enquiry response time
items.text: We [reply to every enquiry](/contact-us/) within one business day, whether you're discussing a trial run or your next production order.

sections.heading: Custom One-Piece Design Options: Neckline, Back, Leg Line and Cut-Outs
sections.body: You can customise every design, print, colour, cut and detail of your one-piece. We choose the neckline, back and leg line together so the support stays balanced.

items.title: Neckline and back
items.text: Pick a scoop, square, plunge, halter, one-shoulder or high-neck neckline and pair it with an open, cross-back, racerback, zip-back or low-back design.

items.title: Leg line choices
items.text: Your one-piece range can use classic, high-cut, French-cut or sport leg lines.

items.title: Reinforced cut-outs
items.text: Cut-outs go at the side, front or underbust, and we reinforce every stress point with bar tacks.

items.title: Mixed fabric panels
items.text: When the fabrics have similar stretch, we combine power mesh, rib or crinkle knits and compression fabric up to 220 gsm. This includes mesh insets, or textured fronts with compression backs.

items.title: Different stretch levels
items.text: When two fabrics differ in stretch by more than 15%, we back the softer panel with body lining, sew the joins with stretch coverstitching and fit-sample the seams before bulk.

items.title: Custom Printing service
items.text: Our [Custom Printing service](/custom-swimwear-printing/) maps your motifs across the pattern pieces. Tight curves and high-stretch areas shift the alignment, so we check fitted samples and keep key motifs away from tight curves.

sections.heading: Shaping Fabrics, Linings and Performance Options

items.title: Base fabric and sourcing
items.text: Our default is 80% nylon 20% spandex with a matching lining. Through our [fabric sourcing](/swimwear-fabrics-sourcing/), you can also ask for polyester blends, chlorine-resistant LYCRA Xtra Life, recycled ECONYL nylon, REPREVE polyester and Italian Carvico fabrics.

items.title: Sculpting shell weight
items.text: Sculpting and shaping styles get a heavier 200–220 gsm shell plus a second layer of fabric.

items.title: Lining weight and coverage
items.text: Your lining is a matching nylon-spandex or polyester-spandex of about 120–140 gsm, in the main colour, nude, white or black. Most styles are fully lined. For lighter-weight or lower-price dark styles, you can choose front-only lining.

items.title: Pool and training performance
items.text: For pool and training ranges, we pick chlorine-resistant spandex. You can also add quick-dry performance and four-way stretch to your suits.

items.title: Beach and surf performance
items.text: For beach and surf ranges, we pick UPF 50+ UV-blocking yarns and salt-fade proofing to handle sun exposure and saltwater wear.

sections.heading: Construction, Bust Support and Trim Details
sections.body:
We match bust support to your cup sizes and neckline. Small-bust fashion styles get shelf linings or light padding, and fuller-bust and cup-sized ranges get underwire or foam cups. Your options include removable cups in sewn-in pockets, fixed padding, power-mesh shelf linings, built-in shelf bras and underwire channels. Underwire styles can also take foam cups or power mesh.

We flatlock the side seams and finish the edges with fold-over elastic or turned, coverstitched picot elastic, depending on your price point. High-cut styles get silicone-backed leg elastic so they don't ride up. Our [swimwear hardware options](/swimwear-hardware/) include zinc-alloy rings and sliders with gold or silver plating.

sections.heading: Size Range and Grading Specs from XS to 3XL
sections.body:
Send us your target size chart and customer profile before grading, and we'll set the base size and grading steps for your market.

| Specification | Our standard or custom option |
|---|---|
| Size range | XS to 3XL, with custom grading to your chart. We send the full chart on request. |
| Block measurements | Bust, waist, high hip, hip and vertical torso girth, which we measure from the shoulder through the crotch and back. |
| Size M reference | About 88 cm bust, 70 cm waist, 96 cm hip and 152 cm torso girth. |

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions

qa.question: Can you manufacture one-pieces using fabric we supply, and what stretch and recovery requirements must that fabric meet?
qa.answer: Yes. We make one-pieces from your fabric if it has at least 15% spandex, at least 60% four-way stretch in each direction and at least 90% recovery.

qa.question: Which one-piece construction choices push the unit price up, such as underwire cups, rings and sliders, cut-outs, double-layer fabric, zips or long sleeves?
qa.answer: Each of these adds construction steps, trims or fabric, so each one raises your unit price. The more of them you combine, the higher the price goes. Your quote also depends on your fabric and whether it's available, the printing method, where the print goes and how many panels are printed, custom trims, branding, and how many pieces you order per style and colour.

qa.question: How do you make sure a white or pastel one-piece is not see-through when it gets wet?
qa.answer: We keep white and pastel one-pieces opaque when wet by adding lining, a double layer or a lined front panel, or by using a heavier fabric.

qa.question: How do you size a one-piece offered in cup sizes, and up to which cup size can you go?
qa.answer: We make cup-sized one-pieces on request. We grade each band-and-cup combination to your chart and count each combination as one size. Our Plus Size Swimwear programme supports up to G cups, and our standard one-piece range runs from XS to 3XL.

qa.question: How do you prevent laser-cut hollow-out edges from curling or tearing during repeated stretching and wear?
qa.answer: We only laser-cut fabrics with at least 18% spandex, so the heat seals the edges and they don't fray. Inside each opening we bond 1 cm clear elastic or heat-seal tape to stop the edges curling. To stop tears when the suit stretches, we leave at least 1.5 cm between openings and round every corner to a radius of at least 3 mm.

facts.text: We develop custom one-piece swimsuits for you, including monokinis and cut-out designs. We support OEM programs built on your own designs as well as ODM programs developed from our styles.

Our block library gives you starting points across the main one-piece families: a classic maillot finished with a clean square or scoop neckline; a sculpting monokini with shaped cut-outs at the side or front, joined by connecting hardware; an asymmetric one-shoulder silhouette detailed with either a single strap or a ruffle; a deep-V plunge held by an internal power-mesh layer; long-sleeve swim tops and zip-front styles aimed at surf and modest-leaning markets; and a sport-cut racerback for active brands, made with wide straps and more back coverage.
Our tummy control range covers shaping one-piece and bikini designs, including high-waisted cuts, and is available for your wholesale orders.

We develop maternity swimwear as one-pieces, tankinis and bikinis, including high-waisted bottoms that can sit either above or below the bump. Ruched stretch panels at the sides expand as the bump grows, and the front is cut 4 to 6 cm longer. Bust support comes from a built-in shelf bra or soft cups, and for nursing we add pull-aside or clip-down cups. Our maternity one-pieces also have adjustable straps and a full soft lining with no underwire.
We manufacture swimwear ourselves in a single factory of our own in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China.
Production and export sit in one company that owns its factory, so quality, cost and delivery stay under our direct control.
The factory has been running since 2011.

Every element can be customised, from fabric and silhouette to branded labels and packaging.

We build your branding into the garments while they are being made. For labels you can choose woven main and neck labels, satin, cotton or transparent labels, stamped or printed labels, heat-transfer labels and silicone labels. Care, wash and size labels can also be woven, printed or heat-transferred. A heat-transfer care label leaves the suit tagless. Woven and printed labels are also available in recycled materials. If you want a logo on the finished piece, we can print it after the garment has been sewn.

For a longer-lasting result, we can embroider your logo by machine or by hand in standard, 3D, reflective or stone embroidery. Embroidery and screen printing each have a minimum of 50 pieces per design, and thread colours are limited to the thread libraries available. Custom woven labels have a minimum of 1,000 pieces.

Every one-piece and tankini in our range can be graded to a long-torso fit. This adds roughly 5 cm of body length, split between the areas above and below the waist so the bust and leg lines don't move. Tell us your target customer's bust, waist, hip, height and torso girth. If the torso girth is more than 4 cm over our chart for that size, we switch to our long-torso block. Styles with cut-outs, cross-back straps or placed prints get their own fit sample so those details stay where they belong. To measure torso girth, stand straight and start the tape at the top of one shoulder. Take it over the front of the body, between the legs and up the back to where you began. Keep it snug against bare skin or a thin layer.

Fit is signed off against a measurement sheet rather than photos alone. Each private label style is fit-tested, with strap tension, leg openings, symmetry and stretch recovery all kept under control, and each sample is reviewed for fit, drape, coverage, measurements and appearance; on structured styles we also check the underwires, the cup shape and how the hardware is fixed. Once fit is approved we grade the whole size range, sew and measure the remaining sizes, and confirm the grading in each size before production begins. At every round we revise the patterns and construction according to your feedback.

sections.heading: Bikini Sets and Separates in Sizes XS to 5XL
sections.body:
| Order or fit choice | What we make and how you allocate sizes |
|---|---|
| Matched sets | A matching top and bottom count as one piece with a single size split. You skip separate minimums, so sets cost less when you're starting with a small range. |
| Separate tops and bottoms | Each separate needs 50 pieces per style in each colour, split across 3 to 4 sizes. Our standard S:M:L:XL ratio is 1:2:2:1, and your sales data sets your actual split. |
| Different cup and hip sizes | Separates let you order different ratios for tops and bottoms, such as more larger-cup tops alongside S and M bottoms. When your customers' top and bottom sizes differ, this cuts your unsold stock. |
| Size range | Our standard grading runs from XS to 3XL, and our plus-size line goes up to 4XL and 5XL. Underwired tops cover bands 30 through 46, including the larger bands in our plus-size line. |
| Fit development | Before grading, we check each style against your measurement sheet on a size M fit model, or a 2XL model for plus sizes. Your chart sets the band and cup grading, and every pairing counts as a separate size. |
| Plus-size support | Our [plus-size bikinis](/plus-size-swimwear-manufacturer/) are built with wider straps, secure elastics and supportive construction. |

sections.heading: Custom Bikini Fabrics, Linings and Support

items.title: Fabric feel
items.text: Nylon-spandex feels softer and smoother on wet skin, with a close, sculpting stretch and quick recovery. Polyester-spandex dries faster, stays more stable and is easier to look after.

items.title: Chlorine and sun
items.text: Polyester-spandex holds its shape better through repeated chlorine and sun exposure. For nylon styles, we offer chlorine-resistant LYCRA Xtra Life to extend stretch recovery.

items.title: Support construction
items.text: We match the construction to cup size and use. Foam cups or power mesh give lighter support. Larger cups and active styles need underwire, reinforced elastics and adjustable straps and hardware to keep their shape when wet.

items.title: Structure trade-offs
items.text: Lighter builds stretch out quickly under heavier busts. Underwire and extra hardware add cost and development time, and they make lounging tops less soft and packable.

items.title: Lining and coverage
items.text: You can choose full or front-only swim lining in nude, white, black or a shade matched to the shell, and you can ask for recycled lining. White and pale colours need full lining, double layers, a lined front panel or a heavier shell fabric.

items.title: Your supplied components
items.text: We work with your own fabric, cups and underwires. Send 2 cups and 2 underwires per cup size for sample fit, chlorine and salt-water checks. Then supply the bulk components with 3% extra cups and underwires.

items.title: Sourcing choices
items.text: Through [Swimwear Fabrics & Sourcing](/swimwear-fabrics-sourcing/), we offer 80% nylon 20% spandex, matching linings, and ECONYL, REPREVE and Italian Carvico on request. We also offer textured, ribbed, satin, glitter, metallic, sequin, towel and leather fabrics.

items.title: Branded hardware
items.text: Through [Swimwear Hardware](/swimwear-hardware/), custom moulds cost USD 200 each. Resin O-rings need 100 pieces per colour, and logo tags need 100 pieces. For trims you supply, send 2 test pieces of each, then 3% extra that arrives at least 7 days before cutting.

sections.heading: Bikini Reinforcement, Edge Finishes and Lacing Details

items.title: Reinforced stress points
items.text: We reinforce the straps, side seams and crotch on every style. Putting a bikini on and wearing it wet puts strain on these points, and once one of them fails, the garment is finished.

items.title: Stitched elastic edges
items.text: We fold rubber or swim-grade elastic into a binding, or turn it and coverstitch it. Stitched elastic gives your ties and leg openings the firmest grip and lasts the longest.

items.title: Bonded minimal finishes
items.text: Bonded and laser-cut edges lie flatter and can't be seen under clothing. They hold less tension, though, so they suit lighter-support tops and cheeky bottoms. We keep the reinforcement flat and narrow so it adds as little bulk as possible.

items.title: Eyelets and lacing
items.text: You can add eyelets and lacing as embellishments or special finishes. We choose each edge finish to match the tension that part of the garment carries.

items.title: Hand-applied decoration
items.text: Our [Embroidery service](/swimwear-embroidery/) adds beads, sequins, stones, rhinestones, beaded chains, appliqués, embroidered patches and crochet trims to your bikinis and cover-ups. We work the crochet by hand and sew on each bead and sequin one at a time. We never use glue or heat-press application.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions

qa.question: Does the sample fee cover a full bikini set, or are the top and bottom charged as separate samples?
qa.answer: If we develop a matching top and bottom together, they count as one sample at USD 50, plus USD 50 for courier delivery. A top or bottom developed on its own is charged as its own sample. Each physical fit revision costs another USD 50 and adds courier time. We don't refund these fees or credit them against your bulk order. Minor digital adjustments are free. You'll avoid extra rounds if you finalise your size chart, measurement sheet and construction details before sampling starts. Underwire, reversible and laced builds need at least one physical revision for a wear check.

qa.question: Which construction and trim choices on a bikini add the most to the price, compared with a basic lined triangle set?
qa.answer: Cup construction adds the most: underwire, moulded or removable cups, and power mesh. Next come extra hardware, reversible or double-layer builds, hand-applied embellishment, sublimation printing and the packaging format you choose. Branded or recycled fabrics also raise the price.

qa.question: Which of your metallic, glitter, velvet and other fashion-finish bikini fabrics suit repeated pool or sea swimming rather than mainly dry resort wear?
qa.answer: Our swim velvet suits regular sea swimming. It's a 240 g/m² blend of 90% polyamide and 10% spandex that resists salt water and gives UV protection. Metallic foil, glitter and other surface coatings are for mainly dry resort wear, because repeated chlorine exposure dulls their sparkle. For styles that will see a lot of pool swimming, we use solid-dyed or printed nylon and polyester, including chlorine-resistant LYCRA Xtra Life.

qa.question: How do you construct reversible bikinis so seams, padding and closures work with either side worn outward?
qa.answer: We sew layers with matching stretch as two finished outer faces and enclose the seam allowances, so no overlocking shows on either side. The inner cup pocket has a 6 cm opening, so the padding comes out whichever side is facing outward. We use double-sided rings, slides or tie strings in place of one-sided hooks, and we wear-check both sides before bulk production.

qa.question: How are the ends of your bikini strings and lacing finished so they don't fray or slip out of the eyelets?
qa.answer: We turn in and bar-tack the ends of self-fabric tubes, or heat-seal the cord tips. You can also choose metal or silicone tips, or beads. Lacing ends get knots or stoppers at least 3 mm wider than the eyelet opening. Before packing, we pull-test the strings and eyelets at 70 N.

For construction, you can choose reinforced elastics, underwire integration, and specialized lining. We also help you select the fabric and lining for each style.
For technical styles, we use supportive construction and fit adjustable straps and hardware.

We line bikinis either fully or on the front only, with swim lining in nude, white, black or a shade matched to your shell fabric, and recycled lining is available on request. For white and pale colours we add a full lining, a double layer, a lined front panel or a heavier shell fabric.

Our nylon-spandex bases, such as 80% nylon 20% spandex, feel softer and smoother against wet skin and give a close, sculpting stretch that springs back quickly, while our polyester-spandex bases dry faster, stay more stable and are easier to care for. For shape recovery over many wears, polyester-spandex holds its shape better in chlorine and sun, and on nylon styles we can switch to chlorine-resistant LYCRA Xtra Life to keep the stretch recovering for longer.

We can build your bikinis from fabric, cups and underwires you supply. Send 2 cups and 2 underwires in each cup size first so we can check their fit on your sample and their resistance to chlorine and salt water, then ship the bulk with 3% extra cups and underwires.
For underwire bikinis, we build support with underwire, foam cups, or power mesh.

We make swimwear from nylon and polyester swimwear fabrics blended with spandex, such as 80% nylon 20% spandex, with matching linings. On request we source chlorine-resistant LYCRA Xtra Life, recycled nylon such as ECONYL, recycled polyester such as REPREVE, and Italian Carvico fabrics.
Besides standard swim fabrics, we can make your styles in textured, ribbed, satin, glitter, metallic, sequin, towel and leather fabrics.

For sustainable collections we also source, on request, imported certified recycled fabrics carrying GRS or OEKO-TEX certification, regenerated nylon and regenerated Lycra, and fabrics regenerated from waste that the mill dyes with OEKO-TEX certified dyes. Recycled polyester helps your line reduce plastic waste, and in our own production we manage waste strictly.

Rings, sliders, hooks, clasps and stoppers can carry your logo; each custom item has a mold development fee of USD 200, and its unit price is set according to the design. Resin O-rings start at 100 pieces per colour, and metal tags with your logo or an embossed label start at 100 pieces.
We reinforce the stress points, including the straps, the side seams, and the crotch area, and we keep the edge finishing flat.

You can choose rubber or swim-grade elastic edges, either folded into a binding or turned and coverstitched, or bonded and laser-cut raw edges for a seamless look. Stitched elastic edges give the firmest grip and the longest wear on ties and leg openings, while bonded and laser-cut edges lie flatter and stay invisible under clothing but hold slightly less tension, so we suggest them for lighter-support tops and cheeky bottoms.
You can add eyelets and lacing as embellishments or special finishes.

We fit your own branded hardware and trims to your swimwear: send us 2 pieces of each item first so we can check fit and chlorine and salt-water resistance on your sample, then ship the bulk with 3% extra so it reaches our factory at least 7 days before the scheduled cutting date. Our own hardware is supplied as part of garment production and can also be bought on its own at its minimums.

On request we decorate bikinis and cover-ups with hand-beaded details, sequin work, stones and rhinestone details, beaded chains, sequin appliqués, embroidered patches and crochet trims. All crochet is done by hand, and we sew on each bead and sequin one by one. We never glue or heat-press them.

A bikini top and its matching bottom made together count as one sample at USD 50, plus USD 50 for courier delivery, while a top or bottom developed as a separate style is charged as its own sample. Each revised fit sample round is a new sample at USD 50, these fees are not refunded or credited against the bulk order, and minor adjustments we make digitally are free.

Compared with a simple lined triangle set, the price rises most with cup construction such as underwire, moulded or removable cups and power mesh, followed by extra hardware, reversible or double-layer builds, hand-applied embellishment, sublimation printing and the packaging format you choose. Branded or recycled fabrics also raise the price.

Our swim velvet, a 240 g/m² blend of 90% polyamide and 10% spandex, resists salt water and offers UV protection, so it suits regular sea swimming as well as resort wear. Metallic foil, glitter and other surface-coated finishes are best for mostly dry resort and beach wear because their coatings can lose sparkle with repeated chlorine exposure, while solid-dyed or printed nylon and polyester fabrics, including chlorine-resistant LYCRA Xtra Life, are our choice for frequent pool swimming.

We build reversible bikinis with both layers sewn as finished outer faces in fabrics of matching stretch, enclosing every seam allowance between them so no overlocking shows on either side, and we place cups in an inner pocket with a 6 cm opening so padding sits correctly and can be removed whichever side is worn out. Closures use double-sided hardware such as metal rings, slides or tie strings instead of one-sided hooks, and we wear-check each fit sample with both sides out before bulk production.

We make tie strings as self-fabric tubes with the ends turned in and bar-tacked, or as cords with heat-sealed tips, and you can also choose metal or silicone end tips or beads. For lacing, we finish each end with a knot or end stopper at least 3 mm wider than the eyelet opening, and we pull-test strings and eyelets at 70 N before packing so the ends don't fray or slip through.

pages.title: Men's Swimwear Manufacturer in Guangzhou | Strandmill

pages.h1: Custom Men's Swimwear Manufacturer in Guangzhou
pages.hero_lead: You source your whole men's collection from one supplier, with swim shorts, briefs, jammers and boxers through to tank tops and casual beach shorts made in our own factory.

sections.heading: A Full Men's Swimwear Range from One Supplier
sections.body: You can source your full men's swimwear collection from us, with bottoms and tops all made by one supplier. We make swim trunks, swim shorts, board shorts, briefs, jammers, boxers and casual beach shorts. We also make rash guards, rash guard T-shirts, tank tops and casual swimwear.

sections.heading: Men's Swim Trunk Fabrics and Inseam Styles

items.title: Regular pool use
items.text: Chlorine and sun break down standard stretch fibres fastest, so our 85/15 polyester-spandex shell resists both chlorine and UV. It dries fast and keeps its colour, print clarity and shape.

items.title: Beach and casual wear
items.text: Fast drying matters more than chlorine resistance for beach trunks, so for these we offer UPF 50+ quick-dry polyester blends with mesh-lined pockets.

items.title: Inseam choices
items.text: Our [swim trunks range](/swim-trunks-manufacturer/) covers classic elastic-waist, drawcord styles in 5, 7 and 9 inch inseams. It also includes a retro short trunk with a 3 inch inseam.

sections.heading: Our Own Men's Swimwear Factory in Guangzhou, China
sections.body:
We make your swimwear in our own factory, a single site in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China. Our checks follow each order from production through to shipment.

We have been operating since 2011. Our [factory and in-house team](/about-us/) keep production and export under our direct control. We run around the clock with a capacity of about 100,000 pieces a month, and our 65-person sampling studio completes about 55 custom samples a day.

We reply to every [enquiry to our team](/contact-us/) within one business day.
