sections.heading: Wholesale Men's Swimwear MOQ, Trial Runs and Payment

items.title: Minimum order
items.text: Our minimums start at 50 pieces per style in each colour, which supports small and growing labels.

items.title: First trial run
items.text: We agree your first trial quantity with you case by case. Production requirements set the limit on how flexible we can be.

items.title: Payment split
items.text: You pay a 50% deposit when you confirm the order and the remaining 50% before shipment.

sections.heading: From Tech Pack to Delivery: Lead Times and Shipping Terms
sections.body: For new labels, our [Launch service](/swimwear-launch-services/) starter pack gives you three finished samples, twenty fabric swatches, a stock-style catalogue and a launch guide.

items.title: Send your brief
items.text: To get a [free quote](/request-a-quote/), email or WhatsApp us your design, fabrics, colours, quantity, sizing and packing needs. We check feasibility and send back estimated pricing and timing.

items.title: Develop the sample
items.text: We turn your brief into a sample for you to approve, so the product is settled before you commit to bulk production.

items.title: Confirm order details
items.text: Before the order is placed, we agree quantities, colours, customisation, availability and lead times with you.

items.title: Run bulk production
items.text: Once you approve the sample and we receive your deposit, bulk production takes 35 to 40 days. Your order size and the season set where it falls in that range.

items.title: Supply your packaging
items.text: For [Swimwear Packaging & Custom Brand Labels](/swimwear-packaging-custom-brand-labels/), send your labels, tags and bags, plus 3% extra, at least 7 days before cutting. We report any shortages or defects within 3 business days.

items.title: Ship your order
items.text: Choose FOB, CIF or worldwide DDP. With DDP, you pay one all-in price for delivery to your door, and we handle duties, customs and freight.

sections.heading: OEM Men's Swimwear Patterns, Samples and Fees
sections.body:
| Item | What happens |
|---|---|
| Pattern development | We build custom patterns from your sketch, reference garment or tech pack. A sketch or reference garment takes more sample rounds than a complete tech pack. |
| Fit approval | We lock the pattern before grading or bulk cutting, while fit and construction are still cheaper to correct. |
| Sample timing | Your standard sample is ready in 10 to 15 days. |
| Sample and design fees | Each sample costs USD 50, and the design fee is USD 50 per design, covering its pattern or print and all its colourways. Neither fee is refunded or credited against your bulk order. |
| Sample courier | Courier delivery costs you USD 50 on top of the sample fee. |
| Size grading | Through our [Development service](/development/), we grade each style from XS to 3XL free of charge against US, EU or UK charts, or we develop sizing from your measurements and target market. |

sections.heading: Construction Options: Linings, Waistbands and Trims
sections.body: We match fabrics, linings and trims to the way your garments are worn and washed.

items.title: Lining and panel options
items.text: You can choose Sport Mesh, Powernet or compression liners. Reinforced seams and cut-out panels are also available for your construction.

items.title: Waistband structures
items.text: For trunks, we use either full elastic with an internal drawcord or a flat front with back elastic. Board shorts get a fixed waistband with a lace-up fly.

items.title: Secure fly closures
items.text: Choose marine-grade hook-and-loop backed with soft tape, snaps, or flat woven lace-up cords with sealed tips running through metal-reinforced eyelets. These secure closures keep the fly shut in surf.

items.title: Pocket layouts
items.text: Specify mesh-lined side pockets, key pockets, cargo pockets or back pockets with drainage eyelets. Trapped water makes trunks drag and balloon.

items.title: Higher-spec fastening
items.text: On higher-spec builds, we fit corrosion-resistant pocket zips under storm flaps, so you get secure fastening along with drainage for swimming and surf.

items.title: Matched hardware
items.text: Our [Swimwear Hardware service](/swimwear-hardware/) supplies colour-matched straps, rings, sliders, hooks and buckles in metal, plastic, resin or eco-friendly materials, as well as drawstrings, eyelets and zippers.

sections.heading: Shell Fabrics, Linings and Supplied Materials for Men's Swimwear
sections.body: Your fabric choice comes down to your print method, style and target price.

items.title: Printing compatibility
items.text: Sublimation needs polyester, because the dye bonds with that fibre. If you want a softer nylon shell, we use digital pigment printing instead.

items.title: Fabric choices
items.text: We offer solid, printable and sustainable options, including polyester-spandex, nylon-spandex, PBT, jacquard, compression, UV-protective, chlorine-resistant and athleisure fabrics.

items.title: Your supplied materials
items.text: We sew the shells and linings you supply, or we import from your mill using its supplier name and fabric code.

items.title: Specialist fabric sourcing
items.text: Through our [fabric sourcing](/swimwear-fabrics-sourcing/), we offer 80% nylon 20% spandex with matching linings. On request, we also source chlorine-resistant LYCRA Xtra Life, ECONYL, REPREVE and Italian Carvico.

items.title: Boardshort shell options
items.text: The standard shells for our [boardshorts](/boardshorts-manufacturer/) are 100% polyester microfiber in peach twill or 95% polyester / 5% spandex 4-way stretch.

items.title: Production certifications
items.text: Our [production certifications](/sustainability/) cover OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for tested fabrics/trims, GRS/RCS for recycled fabrics, bluesign for chemistry, ISO 9001 for quality management and WRAP for social compliance.

sections.heading: Custom Prints and Colour Matching
sections.body:
Before we start bulk printing, you approve a printed strike-off on the production fabric, with placement set across seams and panels. Colours shift between screens, paper and stretch fabric, and seam alignment becomes visible once garments are cut and sewn. We match colours and align patterns so your whole order stays consistent.

Our [Custom Printing service](/custom-swimwear-printing/) works from your AI or PDF artwork to produce high-resolution all-over or placement designs. The prints hold up for over 200 hours in chlorinated and salt water.

Our [Embroidery service](/swimwear-embroidery/) gives you machine or hand decoration in colours from our thread library. Embroidery and screen printing start at 50 pieces per design, and custom woven labels start at 1000 pieces.

visuals.purpose: Shows the minimum order quantities for decoration and labelling options.
visuals.caption: Minimum quantities for embroidery, screen printing and woven labels

sections.heading: Quality Checks from Approved Sample to Bulk Order
sections.body: We check fit, construction and finishing against your approved sample. We test wet opacity, liner seams, drawcord anchoring and ballooning before grading and again during bulk production.

items.title: Liner seam strength
items.text: We join soft mesh liners with flat-lock seams and add bar-tacks at the crotch and leg stress points so they don't tear.

items.title: Drawcord anchoring
items.text: We stitch drawcords to the waistband at centre back and finish them with sealed or silicone tips so they cannot pull out.

items.title: Water drainage
items.text: We add mesh drainage panels or eyelets to liners and pockets so water drains out and the garment doesn't balloon.

items.title: Light-colour coverage
items.text: For light colours, we use fabric of 190 to 220 GSM or a full lining to keep coverage.

items.title: Print base colour
items.text: We sublimate onto fabric pre-dyed close to the main print colour, so white doesn't show through when the fabric stretches.

items.title: Wet fit testing
items.text: Before grading, we fit each style on a base-size model and wear-test it wet for stretch, coverage and opacity.

items.title: Independent inspection
items.text: We welcome [independent pre-shipment inspections](/faq/) by SGS or BV, so your appointed inspector can check the goods before dispatch.

items.title: Defect remedies
items.text: Under our [quality terms](/terms-and-conditions/), you report defects with photos/videos within 7 days of receipt. After we assess them, we repair, remake, replace or credit the pieces. Shipping and handling charges are not refunded.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions

qa.question: Are any of your men's jammers or racing suits World Aquatics-approved for competition, or are they supplied only as training and recreational styles?
qa.answer: We don't hold World Aquatics approval, so our jammers and racing suits are training and recreational styles and aren't labelled as competition-approved. If you apply for approval for your own design, we supply the samples and fabric data the application needs.

qa.question: How do you construct swim-short liners to prevent inner-thigh chafing and liner ride-up during prolonged swimming or walking?
qa.answer: We keep flat-lock seams away from the inner thigh and secure the leg openings with soft elastic or a 1 cm silicone gripper. We also tack the liner to the shell's side seams so it can't twist or ride up. For casual shorts we use soft four-way-stretch sport mesh, and for active wear we use brief-style compression liners with a 2 to 3 inch leg.

qa.question: Can you build contoured support pouches or separate front-support panels into men's briefs, jammers and swim-short liners?
qa.answer: Yes. In briefs and jammers we sew double-lined front pouches shaped with 2 to 3 seams, or we add separate support panels in powernet or compression fabric. Swim-short liners get the same pouch construction, in brief or boxer-brief cuts made to your measurements.

sections.heading: Send Us Your Men's Swimwear Enquiry
sections.body: Send us your men's swimwear designs, fabrics, colours, quantities, sizing and packing needs. We check feasibility and prepare estimated pricing and timing; you hear from us within one business day.

cta.label: Request a quote for men's swimwear

facts.text: We make men's swim bottoms in a wide range of cuts: swim trunks, swim shorts, board shorts, swim briefs, jammers, boxers and casual beach shorts. For tops, we produce rash guards, including rash guard T-shirts, and tank tops. We also make one-piece men's swimsuits and casual swimwear, so you can source a full collection from a single supplier.

UPF 50+ fabrics are available for your custom men's swimwear. Your swim trunks can use UPF50+ quick-dry polyester blends, with mesh-lined pockets. Our main shell fabric is an 85/15 polyester-spandex that stands up to chlorine and UV, holds its color and keeps prints crisp wash after wash. The finished trunks dry fast, resist chlorine and keep their shape.
We make classic elastic-waist trunks with a drawcord in 5, 7 and 9 inch inseams. For fashion-led ranges, we also cut a retro short trunk with a 3 inch inseam.
We manufacture swimwear ourselves in a single factory of our own in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China.

Our bulk lines run around the clock with a capacity of about 100,000 pieces a month, scaling from small runs to large volumes. Alongside them, our in-house design team handles pattern design, grading and fit development, and our sampling studio has a team of 65 that completes about 55 custom samples a day.
We reply to every enquiry within one business day.
Production and export sit in one company that owns its factory, so quality, cost and delivery stay under our direct control.
The factory has been running since 2011.

We are a business-to-business manufacturer: this website and our own team are our only sales channels. We have no online shop and no store on any third-party marketplace or platform, and every order is agreed directly with our team.
Orders start at 50 pieces per style in each colour, a level set so that small and growing labels can order.
A first trial run is agreed case by case, and we are as flexible on its quantity as production allows.
We take a 50% deposit when the order is confirmed, and the remaining 50% is paid before shipment.
Once the sample is approved and the deposit received, bulk production usually needs 35 to 40 days, depending on order size and season.
Shipments go out on FOB, CIF or DDP terms; DDP is available worldwide, and under DDP one all-in price covers delivery to your door, with duties, customs and freight handled by us.

A typical order moves from your brief or tech pack to a sample in 10 to 15 days, then to your approval and deposit, 35 to 40 days of bulk production depending on size and season, a full final inspection, and shipment on FOB, CIF or DDP terms.

If you are starting a new label, our starter pack includes three finished samples, twenty fabric swatches, a catalogue of the ready-made styles we keep in stock and a short guide to launching your own swimwear brand. For your first collection, we also offer separate startup packages that cover design, development and manufacturing. Many new labels use these together with our consulting service.

Quotes cost nothing. To get one, tell us your preferred materials, designs, prints and colours, and send your tech pack or design with the order quantity, size chart and packing needs; if you have no tech pack, front and back screenshots or line drawings marked with style codes and your chosen fabrics and colours also work. You can send everything by email or WhatsApp. We check that the style can be made, reply with an estimated price and timing on a quotation sheet, and usually set up a phone call to go over the products, artwork, sizing, quantities, pricing and minimums. Once you confirm quantities, colours and customisation, we confirm availability and lead times and agree every detail before the order is placed.

If you supply your own labels, hang tags and bags, send 3% extra of each to cover wastage, and make sure everything reaches our factory at least 7 days before the scheduled cutting date. We count and check them on arrival and report any shortages or defects to you within 3 business days, before cutting.

If you would rather not start from scratch, you can choose from ready-to-brand collections for women, men, kids and plus sizes. We keep developing these alongside our fully custom work. The styles are already designed and patterned, and they are graded in advance to international body sizes. Bottoms come in full, medium or cheeky coverage, and our designers refresh the collections every season to follow trends. You select styles from the range, specify your fabrics and colours, and we produce and label them under your brand, adding your custom heat-pressed logo.
A standard sample is ready in 10 to 15 days.
Each sample costs USD 50, and the design fee is USD 50 per design (its pattern or print, with all colourways); these fees are not refunded or credited against the bulk order.
Courier delivery of samples costs USD 50, paid by the buyer in addition to the sample fee.

Whether you are a new label or an established brand, we take your men's swimwear from pattern development through sampling and quality control to bulk production. You can send us sketches, reference samples or a full tech pack, and we turn them into custom patterns.

We size your swimwear for the markets you sell into, grading each style from XS to 3XL against US, EU or UK size charts and refining the fit as the sizes are built, with no charge for grading any size. You can send us your own size chart, measurement sheet or a reference garment and we will cut to it; once a chart is based on your fit model, every piece in the production run is checked against it, and the grading rules are fixed separately for each style. If you have no chart yet, our pattern makers draw one up for your target market, covering buyers in the EU, UK, US, Australia and the Middle East, and we can also prepare team size charts for club and school programmes. Our styles are made for women, men and children.

For construction, you can choose a Sport Mesh or Powernet lining, compression liners, and different waistband structures, including adjustable waistbands on swim trunks and beach shorts. Drawcord systems, reinforced seams and cut-out panels are also available.

For men's trunks and board shorts you can choose a fully elasticated waistband with a drawcord inside, a flat front with elastic across the back only, or a fixed, non-stretch waistband closed with a lace-up fly plus a hook-and-loop or snap fastening. Trunks usually take the full or half-elastic waist, while board shorts most often use the fixed waist with a fly.

On your trunks and board shorts you can specify a marine-grade hook-and-loop fly backed with soft tape, a lace-up front using flat woven cord and sealed tips threaded through metal-reinforced eyelets, or a snap closure. For pockets, choose mesh-lined side pockets, a key pocket, cargo pockets or back pockets with drainage eyelets, with a corrosion-resistant zip under a storm flap on higher-spec builds so water clears quickly.
We advise you on adjusting fabrics, linings and trims based on how the garments will actually be worn and washed.
We supply straps, rings, sliders, hooks and buckles in metal, plastic, resin or eco-friendly materials, colour-matched to your fabric and prints. We also supply drawstrings, eyelets and zippers.

We offer solid, printable and sustainable swimwear fabrics chosen for comfort, durability and colour retention. Options include polyester-spandex and nylon-spandex, recycled and other eco-friendly fabrics, PBT, jacquard, compression swim fabrics, UV-protective fabrics, durable chlorine-resistant high-performance fabrics, and athleisure blends. The right choice depends on your style and target price.

Yes, we make your men's swimwear from shell fabrics and linings you send us, or we import fabric from your own mill if you give us the supplier name and fabric code. Sublimation printing needs polyester fabric, and we print nylon fabric with digital pigment.

We make swimwear from nylon and polyester swimwear fabrics blended with spandex, such as 80% nylon 20% spandex, with matching linings. On request we source chlorine-resistant LYCRA Xtra Life, recycled nylon such as ECONYL, recycled polyester such as REPREVE, and Italian Carvico fabrics.
Our standard shell fabrics are 100% polyester microfiber in a peach twill and a 95% polyester / 5% spandex 4-way stretch.
Our production holds OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for tested fabrics and trims, GRS and RCS for recycled fabrics, bluesign for chemistry, ISO 9001 for quality management and WRAP for social compliance.
We print your custom designs using high-resolution sublimation and digital printing. We match colours and align patterns so your artwork reproduces consistently across the order.

For custom prints we offer sublimation on polyester fabrics and digital pigment printing on nylon fabrics, as either all-over or placement designs, and embroidery is available as an extra decoration. Send your artwork in AI or PDF format and we print it photo-sharp, with results that hold up for over 200 hours in chlorinated and salt water.

For a longer-lasting result, we can embroider your logo by machine or by hand in standard, 3D, reflective or stone embroidery. Embroidery and screen printing each have a minimum of 50 pieces per design, and thread colours are limited to the thread libraries available. Custom woven labels have a minimum of 1,000 pieces.
We check every men's swimwear collection from the approved sample through bulk production to keep fit, construction and finishing consistent.

To stop liner tears, we join soft mesh liners with flat-lock seams and add bar-tacks at the crotch and leg stress points. Drawcords are stitched at the centre back of the waistband with sealed or silicone tips so they cannot pull out. To prevent ballooning, we add mesh drainage panels or eyelets in the liner and pockets. For light colours we use fabric of 190 to 220 GSM or a full lining. We print sublimation designs on a base fabric pre-dyed close to the main print colour so no white shows when it stretches. We also fit each style on a base-size fit model and wear-test it wet to check stretch, coverage and opacity before grading the full size range.

We supply barcodes for every product. We apply SKU or barcode stickers to the tag or pouch of each piece and prepare the packing method you specify, and each piece is barcoded and boxed before it leaves our factory.
Independent inspectors such as SGS or BV are welcome to check the goods before they ship.

If you find a quality problem, report it within 7 days of receiving the goods and include photos or videos. After assessing the defect, we repair, remake or replace the pieces, or credit you for their cost. Shipping and handling charges are not refunded.
Quality is checked at every stage of an order: fabric on arrival, cutting, sewing, then random checks and a full final inspection.

We do not hold World Aquatics approval for any style, so our men's jammers and racing suits are supplied as training and recreational styles and are not labelled as approved for competition. If you apply for approval for your own design, we supply the samples and fabric data the application needs.

We cut swim-short liners in soft four-way-stretch sport mesh or as a brief-style compression liner with a 2 to 3 inch leg. We sew them with flat-lock seams placed away from the inner thigh and finish the leg openings with soft elastic or a 1 cm silicone gripper so the liner stays in place while you swim or walk. We also tack the liner to the shell at the side seams to stop it twisting or riding up.

We can sew a contoured front pouch, shaped with 2 to 3 seams and double-lined, into men's briefs and jammers, or add a separate front-support panel in powernet or compression fabric. Swim-short liners can take the same pouch construction in a brief or boxer-brief liner cut to your measurements.

pages.meta_description: Make your own boardshorts with a Guangzhou boardshorts manufacturer: OEM/ODM design, fabric and lining choices, printed artwork, logos and packaging.
pages.h1: Boardshorts Manufacturer for Custom OEM and ODM Orders
pages.hero_lead: You decide the fabric, waistband, drawcord, pockets, logo and fit, and we build lightweight stretch boardshorts with chafe-reducing seams for surf labels, or tailored quick-dry styles for lifestyle labels.

sections.heading: Custom Boardshorts for Surf, Resort and Merchandise Labels
sections.body:
You decide the fabric, waistband, drawcord, pockets, logo and fit of your solid boardshorts. We make boardshorts for men and boys, knitted swim shorts for men, knitted swim trunks for boys, and swim trunks for women.

Surf and performance labels get lightweight stretch builds with chafe-reducing seams. Resort and lifestyle labels get tailored casual looks in quick-dry technical fabrics. We also make branded boardshorts for corporate and event merchandise.

sections.heading: Our Boardshorts Factory in China and the Styles We Make
sections.body: We make our swimwear in our own factory, a single site in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China.

items.title: Woven boardshorts
items.text: These use woven shells such as polyester microfiber twill or a polyester/spandex stretch weave, with a fixed waistband, faux fly and drawcord. Mesh lining is optional.

items.title: Knitted swim styles
items.text: Our knitted swim shorts and trunks are made from nylon or polyester spandex fabric, with a full elastic waist, an internal drawcord and standard mesh lining.

items.title: Adult lengths
items.text: Men's outseams come in 17, 19 and 21 inches, with inseams of about 5, 7 and 9 inches. Women's come in 12 and 15 inches, with inseams of about 3 and 5 inches.

items.title: Kids and custom lengths
items.text: Kids' outseams are 13 and 15 inches. We also cut custom outseams from 10 to 22 inches to your brand's measurement sheet.

items.title: Waist sizing
items.text: Men's waists run from 28 to 44 inches in 2-inch steps. That covers S to 3XL, plus the extension up to 5XL.

items.title: Sample before grading
items.text: We choose woven or knit construction based on end use. Outseam and waist sizing are then approved on one sample before we grade the range.

items.title: Your size chart

items.title: Factory ownership
items.text: Our [factory-owning production and export company](/about-us/) has been running since 2011. We control quality, cost and delivery directly, with inspections at incoming fabric, cutting and sewing, plus random and full final inspections.

sections.heading: Wholesale Boardshorts: MOQ, Samples, Lead Times and Payment

items.title: Order minimum
items.text: Orders start at 50 pieces per style in each colour. First-trial quantities are agreed case by case within production limits.

items.title: Sample timing
items.text: A standard sample takes 10 to 15 days and costs USD 50. Design costs USD 50 per pattern or print, covering all colourways. Neither fee is refunded or credited.

items.title: Bulk and payment
items.text: Once the sample is approved and you've paid a 50% deposit, production takes 35 to 40 days, depending on size and season. The remaining 50% is due before shipment.

items.title: Shipping terms
items.text: We ship FOB, CIF or DDP worldwide. With DDP you get an all-in door-delivery price, and we handle duties, customs and freight.

items.title: Courier and inspection
items.text: Under our [sample delivery and inspection terms](/faq/), you pay USD 50 for courier delivery on top of the sample fee. Independent pre-shipment inspectors such as SGS or BV are welcome.

items.title: Free quote inputs
items.text: For a [free quotation](/request-a-quote/), email or WhatsApp us your tech pack or coded front and back drawings, along with your materials, designs, prints, colours, quantities, sizing and packing needs.

items.title: Quote confirmation
items.text: We check feasibility, send you estimated pricing and timing, and go over the specifications with you by phone. Then we confirm availability, lead times and every detail before you place the order.

items.title: Enquiry response
items.text: We [reply to every enquiry](/contact-us/) within one business day, so you know exactly when you'll hear back.

sections.heading: OEM and ODM Boardshorts Customization
sections.body: If you're working to a target price, we spend your budget on one or two distinguishing features and keep the rest of the build standard.

items.title: OEM and ODM choices
items.text: We take on your own swim-short designs and customise fabrics, prints, colours, logos, fit, embroidery, functional features and finishing details.

items.title: Higher-cost features
items.text: Branded or recycled fabrics push the unit price up the most. Next come exclusive all-over prints, compression liners, extra zip or cargo pockets, and embroidered or silicone logos.

items.title: Lowest-cost build
items.text: Unit prices stay lowest with standard polyester or polyester-spandex shells, existing prints, unlined or mesh-lined construction, simple drawcord waists, woven labels and larger quantities per style and colour.

items.title: In-house development
items.text: Our [design and development team](/development/) handles patterns, grading and fit in-house, so your collection goes through fewer rounds of design back-and-forth.

items.title: New-label support
items.text: Our [Launch service](/swimwear-launch-services/) offers a starter pack with three finished samples, twenty fabric swatches, a stocked-style catalogue and a launch guide. We also offer separate design-to-manufacturing startup packages and consulting.

sections.heading: Boardshort Shell Fabrics and Liner Options
sections.body: We pick the shell and liner together, so the fabric's stretch and weight suit how the liner will be used.

items.title: Standard shell specifications
items.text: For your specification sheet, our 100% polyester microfiber peach twill weighs about 120 GSM, and our 95% polyester / 5% spandex 4-way stretch weighs about 150 GSM.

items.title: Other performance shells
items.text: Quick-dry nylon weighs about 110 GSM and is lightweight, durable and water-resistant. You can also choose 4-way stretch polyester, quick-dry and UV-resistant fabrics, with DWR specified to AATCC 22 spray rating 80.

items.title: Recycled polyester options
items.text: If your collection is positioned as eco-friendly, we offer recycled polyester shells for your boardshorts, including recycled microfiber as a performance fabric.

items.title: UPF test conditions
items.text: Our UPF 50+ fabrics are tested dry and relaxed to AS/NZS 4399, and we supply the documentation. If you want wet and stretched testing, an accredited lab does it at your cost.

items.title: Liner by use
items.text: For long surf and performance sessions, compression liners and unlined shells reduce chafing and bulk. For resort and lifestyle styles worn as everyday swim shorts, mesh liners suit best.

items.title: Fabric sourcing
items.text: Our [Swimwear Fabrics & Sourcing service](/swimwear-fabrics-sourcing/) supplies blends such as 80% nylon 20% spandex with matching linings. On request, it sources chlorine-resistant LYCRA Xtra Life, ECONYL, REPREVE and Italian Carvico.

items.title: Production certifications
items.text: Our [production credentials](/sustainability/) cover OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for tested fabrics and trims, GRS and RCS for recycled fabrics, bluesign for chemistry, ISO 9001 for quality management and WRAP for social compliance.

sections.heading: Waist, Seam, Hem and Pocket Construction
sections.body: For surf use, we pair secure fixed or hybrid waists with closed pockets. For lifestyle wear, we use easier elastic waists.

items.title: Waist constructions
items.text: You can choose a flat-front lace-up fly secured with hook-and-loop or snaps, a hybrid flat-front waist with an elastic back, or a full elastic waist with an internal drawcord.

items.title: Stitching alignment
items.text: We reinforce the stitching and keep stitch lines precisely aligned across the whole pair of shorts.

items.title: Main pocket choices
items.text: Pick a back flap pocket, a concealed back pocket with an elastic closure, side-seam pockets, or a back pocket closed with a zip or hook-and-loop.

items.title: Additional pocket details
items.text: We add drain eyelets, inner key pockets, leg cargo pockets and key loops inside the waistband to your specification.

items.title: Matching hardware
items.text: Our [Swimwear Hardware service](/swimwear-hardware/) supplies drawstrings, eyelets and zippers, along with colour-matched straps, rings, sliders, hooks and buckles in metal, plastic, resin or eco-friendly materials.

sections.body: Every colour and print is customised to your design, and we take your artwork through colour approval, printing and cutting. With our [Custom Printing service](/custom-swimwear-printing/), all of this stays inside the factory, right alongside the rest of your boardshort manufacturing.

items.title: Logo method and placement
items.text: Woven labels go inside the back. Embroidery or raised, waterproof 3D silicone badges go on the waistband or hem, where your branding shows.

items.title: Embroidery service minimums
items.text: Our [Embroidery service](/swimwear-embroidery/) offers durable machine or hand embroidery, including standard, 3D, reflective and stone options. Embroidery and screen printing need 50 pieces per design, colours come from our thread library, and custom woven labels need 1,000 pieces.

items.title: Labels and packaging
items.text: Our [Swimwear Packaging & Custom Brand Labels service](/swimwear-packaging-custom-brand-labels/) takes care of product branding, chlorine-resistant screen-printed care labels, hang tags, poly bags, retail packaging and printed cartons, including branded size labels and packaging for kids.

sections.heading: Preventing Common Boardshort Defects
sections.body: We build defect prevention into sampling, so you test drawcords, eyelets, seams, print fastness and closures before bulk production starts. Every drawcord is bar-tacked at the centre so it can't pull out. Eyelets are rust-proof stainless steel or plastic, so they don't corrode. Inner seams are triple-stitched and flat-finished to reduce chafing. To stop sublimated colours bleeding or fading, we fix the inks at around 200°C and check every print colour for wash fastness on the sample. Closures are soft, low-profile hook-and-loop, with a fabric-flap option, so they don't snag other fabrics.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions

qa.question: Is your DWR finish fluorine-free (PFC/PFAS-free), so the shorts can be sold in markets that restrict PFAS?
qa.answer: Yes. The optional DWR finish we offer for trunk and boardshort shells is PFC-free and PFAS-free. It uses fluorine-free chemistry with no fluorinated repellents, so it works for markets that restrict PFAS. Applied over quick-drying fabric, it makes water bead up and run off rather than soak in. We provide the finish supplier's declaration on request.

qa.question: How do you adapt waistband drawcords on boys' boardshorts for the age group and destination market's cord-safety requirements?
qa.answer: Our boys' boardshorts follow EN 14682 and ASTM F1816. We bar-tack waist drawcords at the centre and leave the ends with no toggles or knots. For under-7s, drawcords don't hang outside the garment. For ages 7 to 14, free ends are 14 cm long at most.

qa.question: On stretch boardshorts with all-over sublimation, how do you stop white base fabric showing through at the seams and when the fabric stretches?
qa.answer: We extend the artwork at least 1 cm past the seam allowance on every cut panel, so no white shows at the seams after sewing or when they open. For dark or strong backgrounds, we use a base fabric dyed close to the main print colour and stretch-test the printed panels to 20% before sewing, so white doesn't grin through in wear.

qa.question: Which shell and lining combinations prevent lightweight or pale-coloured boardshorts from becoming see-through when wet?
qa.answer: We specify the shell weight together with a full lining, a double layer or a lined front panel, so lightweight or pale boardshorts stay opaque in and out of the water. We check the finished shorts wet and stretched, not just flat and dry.

facts.text: We make board shorts for men and for boys, knitted swim shorts for men, knitted swim trunks for boys, and swim trunks for women.
For solid board shorts, you choose the fabric, the waistband, the drawcord, the pockets, the logo and the fit.

For surf and performance labels, we offer lightweight 4-way stretch fabric, seams built to reduce chafing, and DWR coatings. For resort and lifestyle labels, we make tailored casual looks in quick-dry technical fabrics. We also produce branded boardshorts for corporate merchandise and event merchandise.
We manufacture swimwear ourselves in a single factory of our own in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China.

Our board shorts are cut from woven shell fabric, such as polyester microfiber twill or a polyester/spandex stretch weave, with a fixed waistband, a faux fly and a drawcord, and they come unlined or with an optional mesh liner. Our knitted swim shorts and swim trunks use knit nylon or polyester spandex fabric with a full elastic waist and an internal drawcord, and a mesh lining is standard.

Men's boardshorts come in 17, 19 and 21 inch outseams (about 5, 7 and 9 inch inseams), women's in 12 and 15 inch outseams (about 3 and 5 inch inseams), and kids' in 13 and 15 inch outseams. We can also cut any custom outseam from 10 to 22 inches to your measurement sheet for your brand.

Yes, we can size men's boardshorts by waist in inches, from 28 to 44 in 2-inch steps, covering our boardshort range from S to 3XL and its extension up to 5XL. You can also send your own waist-size chart or a reference garment, and we grade every size to it at no charge.
Production and export sit in one company that owns its factory, so quality, cost and delivery stay under our direct control.
The factory has been running since 2011.

Shipments go out on FOB, CIF or DDP terms; DDP is available worldwide, and under DDP one all-in price covers delivery to your door, with duties, customs and freight handled by us.

A typical order moves from your brief or tech pack to a sample in 10 to 15 days, then to your approval and deposit, 35 to 40 days of bulk production depending on size and season, a full final inspection, and shipment on FOB, CIF or DDP terms.
We take a 50% deposit when the order is confirmed, and the remaining 50% is paid before shipment.
Courier delivery of samples costs USD 50, paid by the buyer in addition to the sample fee.

Quotes cost nothing. To get one, tell us your preferred materials, designs, prints and colours, and send your tech pack or design with the order quantity, size chart and packing needs; if you have no tech pack, front and back screenshots or line drawings marked with style codes and your chosen fabrics and colours also work. You can send everything by email or WhatsApp. We check that the style can be made, reply with an estimated price and timing on a quotation sheet, and usually set up a phone call to go over the products, artwork, sizing, quantities, pricing and minimums. Once you confirm quantities, colours and customisation, we confirm availability and lead times and agree every detail before the order is placed.
We reply to every enquiry within one business day.

Through OEM and ODM, you can customize fabrics, prints, colors, logos and functional details, plus fit, embroidery and finishing details. We work from your own swim short designs and accept any kind of custom design.

The options that raise your unit price most are branded or recycled fabrics, followed by exclusive all-over prints, compression liners, extra zip or cargo pockets, and embroidered or silicone logos. Our standard polyester or polyester-spandex shells, existing prints, an unlined or mesh-lined build, a simple drawcord waist, woven labels and larger quantities per style and colour keep it lowest.
An in-house design team handles pattern design, grading and fit development, which saves you rounds of back-and-forth on the design.

Our standard shell fabrics are 100% polyester microfiber in a peach twill and a 95% polyester / 5% spandex 4-way stretch.
Other shell options include lightweight, durable nylon that dries fast and resists water, 4-way stretch polyester, other quick-dry fabrics, and materials that resist UV and water.
For eco-positioned collections, we offer recycled polyester fabric. This includes recycled microfiber as a performance fabric.

Our 100% polyester microfiber peach twill weighs about 120 GSM, our 95% polyester / 5% spandex 4-way stretch about 150 GSM, and our quick-dry nylon about 110 GSM, so you can list these weights on your spec sheet. You can choose a mesh liner, a compression short liner or an unlined build for each boardshort style. We make swimwear from nylon and polyester swimwear fabrics blended with spandex, such as 80% nylon 20% spandex, with matching linings. On request we source chlorine-resistant LYCRA Xtra Life, recycled nylon such as ECONYL, recycled polyester such as REPREVE, and Italian Carvico fabrics.
Our production holds OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for tested fabrics and trims, GRS and RCS for recycled fabrics, bluesign for chemistry, ISO 9001 for quality management and WRAP for social compliance.

Besides the drawstring with a faux fly, we make fixed flat-front waists with a lace-up fly fastened by hook-and-loop or a snap, hybrid waists that are flat at the front with elastic across the back, and full elastic waistbands with a drawcord inside.

Yes: alongside our back flap pocket and the concealed back pocket with an elastic closure, you can add side-seam pockets, a zip or hook-and-loop back pocket, a drain eyelet and an inner key pocket. We can also add a cargo pocket on the leg and a key loop inside the waistband.

You can put your logo on the waistband and at the hem. We can also sew a personalized label inside the back of the shorts.

The usual failures on boardshorts are drawcords pulling out, eyelets corroding, inner seams chafing, sublimated colours bleeding or fading, and hook-and-loop snagging other fabrics. We prevent them by bar-tacking every drawcord at the centre, fitting rust-proof stainless steel or plastic eyelets, triple-stitching and flat-finishing the inner seams, fixing sublimation inks at around 200°C and checking each print colour for wash fastness on the sample, and using soft low-profile hook-and-loop that can sit under a fabric flap.

Our boys' boardshorts follow EN 14682 and ASTM F1816, with the waist drawcord bar-tacked at the centre and no toggles or knots on its ends. On sizes for under-7s the drawcord does not hang outside the garment, and for ages 7 to 14 the free ends are no longer than 14 cm.

On all-over sublimated stretch boardshorts we print each cut panel with the artwork running at least 1 cm past the seam allowance, so no white base fabric shows at the seams once they are sewn and opened. For dark or strong backgrounds we sublimate onto base fabric dyed close to the main print colour and stretch-test the printed panel to 20% before sewing, so white grin-through does not appear when the shorts stretch in wear.

For lightweight or pale boardshorts we specify the shell weight and the lining together, adding a full lining, a double layer or a lined front panel so the shorts stay opaque both in and out of the water.

sections.heading: Quick-Dry Shell Fabrics and Liner Options

items.title: Fast-drying polyester
items.text: If fast drying matters most, go for our 85/15 polyester spandex. It has around 0.4% moisture regain, dries in about 20–30 minutes in the sun and clings less when wet.

items.title: Softer recycled nylon
items.text: Our recycled nylon absorbs around 4%, dries about 10 minutes slower and sits closer to the body when wet. You give up some drying speed and get a softer feel and stronger stretch recovery in return. We colour it with water-saving dyes.

items.title: Print compatibility
items.text: Nylon doesn't take sublimation printing, so for busy all-over sublimation prints we use polyester, not recycled nylon.

items.title: Movement and shape
items.text: For longer, boardshort-style cuts, tightly woven non-stretch quick-dry polyester holds a crisp shape. For paddling and hard swimming, 4-way stretch with spandex moves with you. Short-inseam trunks use a lighter quick-dry fabric with a built-in liner.

items.text: With our [trunk and boardshort DWR finish](/boardshorts-manufacturer/), water beads up and runs off. The chemistry is fluorine-free, PFC-free and PFAS-free, so the finish works for PFAS-restricted markets, and we can send you a declaration from the finish supplier on request.

sections.heading: Waistband, Seam and Pocket Construction

items.title: Waistband components
items.text: We enclose 35–40 mm elastic in the waistband and fit adjustable nylon drawcords with metal or moulded tips. Metal eyelets always sit on reinforced backing and never on raw fabric.

items.title: Lining attachment
items.text: We anchor the mesh at the waistband and tack it at the side seams. Between those points it hangs free, so it drains, dries on its own and doesn't twist.

items.title: Seams and hems
items.text: We flatlock the inner seams to stop thigh chafing and finish the leg hems with soft elastic or a 1 cm silicone gripper.

items.title: Sewing cost trade-off
items.text: Tacked linings and flatlock seams take more sewing time than overlocked, fully bagged linings, and that raises your unit cost.

items.title: Pocket closure choices
items.text: For your trunk design, you can specify corrosion-resistant zips, marine-grade hook-and-loop or mesh-lined zip pockets.

items.title: Fixed-waist fly options
items.text: You can choose a lace-up fly with hook-and-loop or a waistband snap, a corrosion-resistant zip with a metal snap or moulded button, or a stitched-down faux fly.

items.title: Hybrid fly details
items.text: Hybrid trunks take a topstitched faux fly or a working zip, snap or hook-and-loop fly. We offer five 1.2 cm belt loops around the waist.

items.title: Walk-short construction
items.text: For trunks that go from the water to the street, we build a 4 cm flat-front waistband with a button or snap closure, elastic at the back and quick-dry stretch fabric.

sections.heading: Private Label Swim Trunks: Prints and Branding

items.title: Private-label branding
items.text: On volume orders, we offer silicone patches at the hem or waistband, heat-transfer logos, embroidered marks, centre-back woven labels, logo drawcord tips and branded eyelet hardware.

items.title: Pocket pattern matching
items.text: Before cutting, we map your print across the patch pockets and the panels underneath. Then we check on a pre-production sample that it lines up to within 3–5 mm. Curves and stretch zones shift motifs, so we keep your key artwork clear of them.

items.title: Branding cost trade-offs
items.text: Pattern-matched pockets create more cutting waste, and every extra branding point raises the unit price. On a simple style, a single woven label or patch keeps your branding costs lower.

items.title: Style-specific pricing
items.text: Liners, zip pockets, colour-block panels and branded hardware all raise unit prices. We quote from your specification, fabric, trims, logos and quantity, and we confirm bulk pricing after review. Taking details out or swapping them for others brings the cost down.

items.title: Logo finish durability
items.text: Our [Custom Printing service](/custom-swimwear-printing/) offers three logo finishes. Thin, flexible transfers suit low-wear areas. Raised silicone holds its shape. Embroidery is durable but stretches the least, so we give it a soft backing and use it on low-stretch areas.

items.title: Embroidery and label minimums
items.text: Our [Embroidery service](/swimwear-embroidery/) offers machine or hand work in standard, 3D, reflective or stone finishes, with thread colours from our available library. Embroidery and screen printing need 50 pieces per design. Custom woven labels need 1,000 pieces.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions

qa.question: Can you manufacture trunks using shell and lining fabric that we supply, and what material limitations would prevent you from accepting them?
qa.answer: Yes. We cut and sew shell and lining fabrics you supply, or we import them from your mill using its supplier name and fabric code. Sublimation printing needs polyester, so on nylon we use digital pigment printing instead.

qa.question: If I order light or white colours, how do you stop the trunks from going see-through when wet?
qa.answer: We use a dense 190–220 GSM warp-knit tricot for the shell and add a lining, a double layer of self fabric or a lined front panel. When there's a separate lining, we make it from 140 GSM stretch tricot.

qa.question: Is the drawcord secured inside the waistband, or can it slip out through the eyelets in use or in the wash?
qa.answer: We secure it with a 1 cm bar-tack at centre back inside the waistband, so it can't pull through when the trunks are worn or washed. The metal or moulded tips are bigger than the eyelet opening, which gives you a second stop.

qa.question: What minimum order do you need before you can put my logo on the drawcord tips and make branded eyelets?
qa.answer: Logo hardware starts at 1,000 pieces per item. Before we add a logo to the tips, we review your artwork and the tip material. Branded eyelets need their own tooling, so we quote once we've confirmed the tooling, finish, size and quantity.

qa.question: Can you add vents or other drainage features to release trapped air and water from loose-fitting trunks?
qa.answer: Yes. We build drainage into loose-fitting trunks so trapped air and water can get out, which stops ballooning and drag. You can choose two reinforced 6 mm metal grommets at the rear rise, mesh panels up to 8 cm high in each side seam, or mesh-lined pockets, on their own or together. Open-mesh side and back pocket bags have eyelets at the base, so they drain even when the zip or hook-and-loop is closed. We mark the vent positions on your sample for you to approve before bulk production starts. Visible vents and mesh change the look and let light through, so they suit light-coloured or close-fitting styles less well.

cta.label: Request a quote for swim trunks

facts.text: We customise men's swim trunks across fabric, print and color, so you can build a range around your own market.
We make classic elastic-waist trunks with a drawcord in 5, 7 and 9 inch inseams. For fashion-led ranges, we also cut a retro short trunk with a 3 inch inseam.
For European markets, where shorter cuts are the norm, we produce square-leg and trunk-brief styles. If you want a cleaner front line, we can build a fixed waist with a partial elastic back.
We construct color-block panel trunks. We can place pockets in the side seam or at the back, with or without closures.

Our full-elastic waistband stretches across about 10 cm of waist variation within each size, and the drawcord pulls it tight so the trunks stay put through dives and laps. Our fixed-front waistband with a partial elastic back gives a flat, tailored front with about 4–5 cm of give at the back, and a front closure holds it securely in the water.

Our trunks are graded S to 3XL and extend to 5XL, covering a body waist of 71–76 cm at S up to 119–127 cm at 5XL and a hip of 89–94 cm up to 132–140 cm, in steps of about 5–8 cm per size. Finished inseams are held within ±1 cm, or ±0.5 cm on our 3 inch retro cut, and we can grade to your own size chart instead. Our trunk sizes fit these body measurements: M fits a 76–81 cm waist and 94–99 cm hip, L 81–89 cm and 99–104 cm, XL 89–97 cm and 104–112 cm, 2XL 97–104 cm and 112–119 cm, 3XL 104–112 cm and 119–125 cm, and 4XL 112–119 cm and 125–132 cm.

Alongside made-to-order production we hold some trunk styles in stock for wholesale, usually classic elastic-waist cuts in core solid colours, plus a ready-to-brand men's collection that we label with your logo; ask us for the current trunks line sheet to see which cuts and colours are available now.
We manufacture swimwear ourselves in a single factory of our own in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China.
Production and export sit in one company that owns its factory, so quality, cost and delivery stay under our direct control.
Both OEM and ODM work is possible: a new style can start from your own design, a picture or just an idea.
An in-house design team handles pattern design, grading and fit development, which saves you rounds of back-and-forth on the design.
Quality is checked at every stage of an order: fabric on arrival, cutting, sewing, then random checks and a full final inspection.
The factory has been running since 2011.
We reply to every enquiry within one business day.

If you are starting a new label, our starter pack includes three finished samples, twenty fabric swatches, a catalogue of the ready-made styles we keep in stock and a short guide to launching your own swimwear brand. For your first collection, we also offer separate startup packages that cover design, development and manufacturing. Many new labels use these together with our consulting service.
Report any shortages, defects, damages from late delivery or returns to us in writing within 7 days of receiving the goods.

Your goods are packed retail-ready in 5-ply export cartons printed with your shipping marks and labelled with the style, colour and size breakdown inside, so they can go directly into your own warehouse, your 3PL or an FBA warehouse.
Orders start at 50 pieces per style in each colour, a level set so that small and growing labels can order.
A first trial run is agreed case by case, and we are as flexible on its quantity as production allows.
Once the sample is approved and the deposit received, bulk production usually needs 35 to 40 days, depending on order size and season.
A standard sample is ready in 10 to 15 days.
Each sample costs USD 50, and the design fee is USD 50 per design (its pattern or print, with all colourways); these fees are not refunded or credited against the bulk order.
Shipments go out on FOB, CIF or DDP terms; DDP is available worldwide, and under DDP one all-in price covers delivery to your door, with duties, customs and freight handled by us.

A typical order moves from your brief or tech pack to a sample in 10 to 15 days, then to your approval and deposit, 35 to 40 days of bulk production depending on size and season, a full final inspection, and shipment on FOB, CIF or DDP terms.
We take a 50% deposit when the order is confirmed, and the remaining 50% is paid before shipment.
Courier delivery of samples costs USD 50, paid by the buyer in addition to the sample fee.
Most partnerships begin with samples so quality can be judged first, and the bulk order follows once they are approved.
We quote first: once the price is agreed, we move on to making the sample.

Quotes cost nothing. To get one, tell us your preferred materials, designs, prints and colours, and send your tech pack or design with the order quantity, size chart and packing needs; if you have no tech pack, front and back screenshots or line drawings marked with style codes and your chosen fabrics and colours also work. You can send everything by email or WhatsApp. We check that the style can be made, reply with an estimated price and timing on a quotation sheet, and usually set up a phone call to go over the products, artwork, sizing, quantities, pricing and minimums. Once you confirm quantities, colours and customisation, we confirm availability and lead times and agree every detail before the order is placed.
For sustainable swim shorts, we use recycled nylon and dye it with water-saving dyes.

Our standard inner lining is a soft polyester mesh. If you prefer not to use mesh, we can fit a soft knit brief-style lining, and compression liners are also available. For markets that want it, we supply an unlined version.

Yes, we cut trunks in a tightly woven non-stretch quick-dry polyester that keeps a crisp shape for longer, boardshort-style cuts, and in 4-way stretch fabric with added spandex for easy movement when you paddle or swim hard. For short-inseam trunks we suggest a lighter quick-dry fabric paired with a built-in liner.

Our 85/15 polyester spandex takes up very little water (around 0.4% moisture regain), so it dries in about 20–30 minutes in the sun and clings less when wet. Our recycled nylon shell absorbs more (around 4%), dries about 10 minutes slower and sits closer to the body when wet, in return for a softer hand and stronger stretch recovery.

We make swimwear from nylon and polyester swimwear fabrics blended with spandex, such as 80% nylon 20% spandex, with matching linings. On request we source chlorine-resistant LYCRA Xtra Life, recycled nylon such as ECONYL, recycled polyester such as REPREVE, and Italian Carvico fabrics.
Our production holds OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for tested fabrics and trims, GRS and RCS for recycled fabrics, bluesign for chemistry, ISO 9001 for quality management and WRAP for social compliance.

The recycled fibres we can work with are made from waste such as plastic items and old carpets. This waste is cleaned, sorted, liquefied and reformed, so the material is regenerated before it becomes fabric.

We can add a DWR water-repellent finish to the shells of your trunks and boardshorts, on top of the quick-drying fabric. Water then beads up and runs off instead of soaking in. The finish is PFC-free and PFAS-free. It uses fluorine-free chemistry with no fluorinated repellents, so the shorts can be sold in markets that restrict PFAS. On request, we provide a declaration from the finish supplier.
Our waistbands enclose elastic 35–40 mm wide and carry an adjustable nylon drawcord with metal or moulded tips. Our eyelets are metal on a reinforced backing, never punched through raw fabric.

We attach the mesh lining at the waistband and tack it to the shell at the side seams, so it dries on its own and never twists. We flatlock the seams to stop chafing on the inner thigh, and we finish the leg hems with soft elastic or a 1 cm silicone gripper.
For pocket closures, you can choose corrosion-resistant zips or marine-grade velcro. We also make mesh-lined zip pockets.

For fixed-waist trunks with a partial elastic back, you can choose a lace-up fly closed with hook-and-loop or a snap at the waistband. We can also fit a corrosion-resistant zip fly with a metal snap or a moulded button, or stitch down a faux fly for a clean front without an opening.

Yes, we make hybrid trunks with a topstitched faux fly or a working fly closed by a corrosion-resistant zip, snap or hook-and-loop tab, and we can add 1.2 cm wide belt loops, usually five around the waist. For a walk-short look, we build a flat-front fixed waistband 4 cm high with a button or snap closure and elastic at the back, cut in quick-dry stretch fabric so the trunks go from water to street.

We produce trunks under your private label. For branding, we offer silicone logo patches at the hem or waistband, heat-transfer logos, embroidered marks and a woven label at the center back. We can also put your logo on the drawcord tips, and on volume orders we supply branded eyelet hardware.

Yes, we map your print file to each patch pocket and the panel beneath it before cutting, so the motif runs on across the pocket, and we check the match on a sample before bulk, typically holding it within 3–5 mm. Where a pocket sits on a curve or a stretch zone the motif can shift slightly, so we keep key motifs away from those edges.

Yes, a liner, zip pockets, colour-block panels and branded hardware each raise the unit price, because the quote reflects your style's construction, lining, trims, logos and order quantity. We price each style from your spec sheet and confirm the bulk price after reviewing your design and fabric choice, and you can drop or swap any of these details to bring the price down.

Heat-transfer logos are the thinnest and most flexible on the skin side, but they can crack and peel over time from chlorine, salt water, sun and repeated washing. Silicone patches flex with the fabric and hold their shape well though they sit slightly raised, while embroidery is the most durable but the least stretchy, so we back it with a soft facing on the skin side and keep it to low-stretch areas such as the leg hem or waistband.

For a longer-lasting result, we can embroider your logo by machine or by hand in standard, 3D, reflective or stone embroidery. Embroidery and screen printing each have a minimum of 50 pieces per design, and thread colours are limited to the thread libraries available. Custom woven labels have a minimum of 1,000 pieces.

Yes, we cut and sew trunks from shell and lining fabric you supply, or import it from your own mill if you give us the supplier name and fabric code; for sublimation prints it must be polyester, while nylon is printed with digital pigment.

For light or white trunks we cut the shell from a dense warp-knit tricot of 190–220 GSM and add a lining, a double self-fabric layer or a lined front panel, using a 140 GSM stretch tricot where you choose a separate lining.

We fix the drawcord to the inside of the waistband at centre back with a 1 cm bar-tack, so it cannot be pulled out through the eyelets during wear or in the wash. Its metal or moulded tips are also larger than the eyelet opening, which gives it a second stop.

We put your logo on drawcord tips once we have reviewed your artwork and the tip material, and we quote custom logo eyelets after confirming the tooling, finish, size and quantity. Branded eyelets need their own tooling, and logo hardware starts at 1,000 pieces per item.

We can add drainage to loose-fitting trunks so they do not balloon in the water. You can choose two 6 mm metal grommets backed with reinforcement at the rear rise, a mesh panel up to 8 cm high inserted into each side seam, or mesh-lined pockets that release trapped air and water. These options can be used together. We cut side and back pocket bags from open mesh and place drainage eyelets at the base of every bag, so water runs out from the bottom even while the zip or velcro closure stays fastened. Before bulk production begins, we mark where the vents sit on your sample so you can check the placement.

pages.h1: Children's Swimwear Manufacturer in Guangzhou
pages.hero_lead: For each age group from toddlers to tweens, we cut girls' bikinis, two-piece sets and one-pieces and boys' printed or solid shorts with elastic drawstring waists to your design.

sections.heading: Kids' Swimwear for Boys, Girls and Tweens
sections.body: We cut every style to suit its age group, from toddlers up to tweens. For girls, we make bikinis, two-piece sets and one-pieces, with open backs, front zips or sun-protective long sleeves. For boys, we make solid or printed trunks and shorts with elastic drawstring waists. You can add shaped front panels, curved hemlines, side pockets or bound hems.

items.title: Coordinated swim assortments
items.text: We make rash guard sets, sun-protective long-sleeve suits and printed beach sets. If you use the same fabric base and print across your assortment, the pieces match when they're sold together.

items.title: Baby swimwear
items.text: Our [baby swimwear](/baby-swimwear-manufacturer/) covers reusable swim nappies and nappy-friendly suits. We use separate infant blocks for 0–3, 3–6, 6–12, 12–18 and 18–24 months, and we offer toddler options in 2T.

sections.heading: Our Own Children's Swimwear Factory in Guangzhou, China
sections.body: We make your swimwear ourselves, in a single factory in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China. Our checks run from production through to dispatch. Our [factory and export company](/about-us/) has been running since 2011. That keeps quality, cost and delivery under our direct control, and you agree every order directly with our team.

Your quotation shows these differences. Size-band pricing suits runs weighted toward larger sizes, and one flat price suits runs spread evenly across sizes. You choose which quotation format we use.

items.text: We fully inspect your finished order before it ships.

sections.heading: UPF 50+ Swim Fabrics and Chlorine Resistance

items.title: Fabric choices
items.text: We offer quick-dry polyester/spandex, nylon/spandex, soft stretch knits and recycled-fibre fabrics. They hold their colour through frequent washing, and we supply chlorine- and salt-water-resistant options on request.

items.title: Fabric by use
items.text: For pool and swim-school ranges, we use chlorine-resistant PBT or elastane blends. For holiday and beach styles, we use softer standard stretch knits.

items.title: Pool durability trade-off
items.text: PBT polyester and chlorine-resistant elastane such as LYCRA Xtra Life hold their shape longer than standard spandex, but they give up some softness and stretch. PBT is firmer and resists chlorine better. Elastane stays softer and stretchier, and it keeps a close fit through weekly lessons.

items.title: Skin and sun coverage
items.text: We choose skin-friendly fabrics, including UPF 50+ materials that block UV rays. Long sleeves give more coverage, and that includes our made-to-order girls' one-pieces.

items.title: Standard UPF testing
items.text: Our UPF 50+ fabrics are tested to AS/NZS 4399, and we supply the documentation. The rating applies to the fabric dry and relaxed, as it was tested.

items.title: Additional performance tests
items.text: If you want to make claims about performance after washing, we arrange accredited-lab testing after 20 or 40 wash cycles, plus wet and stretched testing. You pay the lab fees at cost.

items.title: Sourcing and toddler certification
items.text: Through [Swimwear Fabrics & Sourcing](/swimwear-fabrics-sourcing/), we offer 80% nylon 20% spandex with matching linings. For toddler styles, we confirm that the fabric, lining and trims are covered under OEKO-TEX Standard 100 Product Class I and meet EU REACH and US CPSIA requirements.

items.title: Certified sustainable options
items.text: Our [sustainability work](/sustainability/) includes certified recycled sourcing and production certifications: OEKO-TEX Standard 100, GRS, RCS, bluesign, ISO 9001 and WRAP. Together they cover tested materials, recycled content, chemistry, quality management and social compliance.

sections.heading: Soft Linings, Seams and Secure Trims for Comfort

items.title: Comfort against skin
items.text: We use smooth linings, secure elastic and waistbands, and soft seams that won't chafe children's skin.

items.title: Soft boxer-brief liners
items.text: For younger children and long pool sessions, our stretch nylon-spandex boxer-brief liner has flatlock seams and covered leg elastic, so it lies flat and doesn't rub.

items.title: Mesh or unlined shorts
items.text: Mesh briefs suit older boys and fast-drying beachwear. Unlined shorts fit over a swim nappy or separate undershorts.

items.title: Secure attached components
items.text: We sew or rivet on every snap, ring, slider, buckle, bead and trim, and each one has to pass a 90 N pull test.

items.title: Decoration restrictions
items.text: Under-3 sizes have no removable decorations. None of our children's designs use hanging charms, glued or heat-fixed stones, or beads small enough to swallow.

items.title: Patches and appliqués
items.text: We stitch rubber patches and appliqués all the way around the edge instead of relying on glue, so they don't lift with repeated chlorine exposure and washing.

items.title: Metal hardware testing
items.text: Our hardware meets the EN 1811 nickel-release limit and the CPSIA lead limits of 100 ppm in base metal and 90 ppm in coatings. Accredited testing for your specific order is charged at cost.

items.title: Hardware sourcing service
items.text: Through [Swimwear Hardware](/swimwear-hardware/), standard stocked components are ready in 3 to 7 days. Sample sets are available for most items, and we check quality before dispatch.

sections.heading: CPSIA Tracking Labels and Traceability for Kids' Swimwear

items.title: US tracking requirement
items.text: For children's swimwear going to the US, we sew in permanent tracking labels under CPSIA Section 103.

items.title: Brand and date
items.text: Your tracking label shows your brand and the month and year of manufacture.

items.title: Location and batch
items.text: We add Guangzhou, China, and the batch or PO number. We also keep production records so every order can be traced.

items.title: Wash-durable identification
items.text: We use wash-durable ink on sewn-in care labels or separate labels, so the details stay readable through repeated washing and chlorine exposure.

items.title: Label placement
items.text: Where the construction allows, we put the tracking and care details together at a side seam, away from the neck.

items.title: Launch planning service
items.text: Our [Launch service](/swimwear-launch-services/) checks your testing, documents, sampling and production schedules against your destination market, launch date, design and materials.

sections.heading: Children's Size Range from Infant to Tween and Custom Size Spreads

items.title: Overall size range
items.text: We make children's swimwear and beachwear from infant sizes up to size 14.

items.title: Your size spread
items.text: Within that range, we make whatever size spread your collection needs.

items.title: Dedicated children's blocks
items.text: Every children's style starts from its own children's block, not a scaled-down women's pattern.

items.title: Proportional size grading
items.text: We grade proportionally across the 2T to 14-year range, so your sample's proportions carry through every size.

sections.heading: Custom Prints, Logos and Private Label Options

items.title: Print method selection
items.text: For colour that lasts, we use sublimation on light polyester-based fabrics and digital printing on nylon bases or darker grounds.

items.title: Solid and contrast designs
items.text: As well as custom prints, we make solid colours, and we add contrast panels and trims to your design.

items.text: Our [Development service](/development/) supports OEM and ODM projects, starting from your design, picture or idea. We do patterns, grading and fit work in-house, along with any sizing, construction and material changes your project needs.

items.text: Through [Custom Printing](/custom-swimwear-printing/), we print your fabrics with OEKO-TEX certified, environmentally responsible inks, and that includes digital printing.

items.title: Packaging and supplied labels
items.text: We handle your branding and packaging through [Swimwear Packaging & Custom Brand Labels](/swimwear-packaging-custom-brand-labels/). If you supply your own labels, tags and bags, send them with 3% extra at least 7 days before cutting. We report any shortages or defects within 3 business days of receiving them.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions

qa.question: Do the drawstrings on your kids' swim trunks meet children's cord and drawstring safety rules for the EU and US, and can you make the waist without a free cord?
qa.answer: Yes. Our trunks and beach sets follow EN 14682 and ASTM F1816, and we offer a covered flat elastic waistband, 2 to 3 cm wide, with no drawcord. There are no drawstrings at the hood or neck. Waist drawcords are bar-tacked at the centre, with no toggles or knots. On under-7 sizes the drawcord stays inside the garment, and for ages 7 to 14 the free ends are 14 cm long at most.

qa.question: How do you make sure white and pastel kids' swimsuits are not see-through when wet?
qa.answer: To keep white and pastel suits opaque when wet, we use heavier fabric, a lining, a double layer or a lined front panel. During sampling, we check the suit wet and stretched, and that tells us which construction to use.

qa.question: Can you print licensed cartoon or character artwork on kids' swimwear, and what licence authorisation do I need to provide?
qa.answer: We print licensed characters, logos and trademarks only when you give us a written licence from the rights holder that covers the product type and sales territory. Send it to us before sampling. Without it, we can't sample or produce the artwork.

qa.question: On front-zip kids' swimsuits, how do you stop the zip from pinching or rubbing the child's chin and skin?
qa.answer: On children's one-pieces and rash guards, a fabric zip garage covers the puller under the chin, and a soft, full-length inner placket sits behind the zip. For toddlers, you can choose a 3-snap crotch or a front or back entry zip. Snaps have soft backing behind them, zips are guarded, and snap and puller attachments are tested to 90 N. For infants, the options are crotch or shoulder snaps and full-length front or back zips. Every zip has a soft guard running the full length of the track, so the teeth and metal stay off the skin.
