sections.heading: Tell Us About Your Kids' Swimwear Order
sections.body: Send us your children's swimwear designs, fabrics, quantities, size chart and packing needs. We review your requirements for a quotation, and your dedicated swimwear specialist replies within one business day.

cta.label: Request a quote for children's swimwear

facts.text: We make swimwear for boys, girls and tweens, and we cut each style to suit its age group, from toddlers up to the tween years.
Our girls' styles include children's bikinis, two-piece sets and one-piece suits. We can build the one-pieces with an open back, a front zip or sun-protective long sleeves.

For boys, we make swim trunks and swim shorts with an elastic drawstring waist, in solid colors or prints. These styles can have shaped front panels, curved hemlines, side pockets and bound hem edges.
We also make rash guard sets, sun-protective long-sleeve suits and printed beach sets, so you can fill out a complete kids' swim assortment.

We make reusable swim nappies, as well as baby one-pieces and swim trunks with a built-in swim nappy liner that has snug, soft-bound elastic at the waist and legs. They come in baby sizes from newborn to toddler, usually 0–3, 3–6, 6–12, 12–18 and 18–24 months, plus 2T.
Alongside made-to-order production, some styles are held in stock for wholesale buyers.
We manufacture swimwear ourselves in a single factory of our own in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China.
Production and export sit in one company that owns its factory, so quality, cost and delivery stay under our direct control.
The factory has been running since 2011.

We are a business-to-business manufacturer: this website and our own team are our only sales channels. We have no online shop and no store on any third-party marketplace or platform, and every order is agreed directly with our team.
Orders start at 50 pieces per style in each colour, a level set so that small and growing labels can order.
A first trial run is agreed case by case, and we are as flexible on its quantity as production allows.
We take a 50% deposit when the order is confirmed, and the remaining 50% is paid before shipment.

Quotes cost nothing. To get one, tell us your preferred materials, designs, prints and colours, and send your tech pack or design with the order quantity, size chart and packing needs; if you have no tech pack, front and back screenshots or line drawings marked with style codes and your chosen fabrics and colours also work. You can send everything by email or WhatsApp. We check that the style can be made, reply with an estimated price and timing on a quotation sheet, and usually set up a phone call to go over the products, artwork, sizing, quantities, pricing and minimums. Once you confirm quantities, colours and customisation, we confirm availability and lead times and agree every detail before the order is placed.

We do not list prices online. Each style is priced from your spec sheets, detailed photos or reference images. The quote depends on the style and how complex its construction is, the level of coverage, the fabric and lining, the print method and any custom printing, your labels, branding and packaging, and the quantity you order. We confirm the bulk price after reviewing your design and fabric choice, and you pay factory-direct prices.

A front zip adds the zip, a placket and extra sewing time, so it raises the unit price compared with a pull-on style, and larger sizes use more fabric, so they can cost a little more than the smaller sizes. We show these differences for each style in your quotation, either as one price across the whole size run or as separate prices by size band, whichever you prefer.
A standard sample is ready in 10 to 15 days.
Each sample costs USD 50, and the design fee is USD 50 per design (its pattern or print, with all colourways); these fees are not refunded or credited against the bulk order.
Courier delivery of samples costs USD 50, paid by the buyer in addition to the sample fee.
Most partnerships begin with samples so quality can be judged first, and the bulk order follows once they are approved.
We quote first: once the price is agreed, we move on to making the sample.
Once the sample is approved and the deposit received, bulk production usually needs 35 to 40 days, depending on order size and season.

A typical order moves from your brief or tech pack to a sample in 10 to 15 days, then to your approval and deposit, 35 to 40 days of bulk production depending on size and season, a full final inspection, and shipment on FOB, CIF or DDP terms.
Shipments go out on FOB, CIF or DDP terms; DDP is available worldwide, and under DDP one all-in price covers delivery to your door, with duties, customs and freight handled by us.
Quality is checked at every stage of an order: fabric on arrival, cutting, sewing, then random checks and a full final inspection.
Independent inspectors such as SGS or BV are welcome to check the goods before they ship.

If you find a quality problem, report it within 7 days of receiving the goods and include photos or videos. After assessing the defect, we repair, remake or replace the pieces, or credit you for their cost. Shipping and handling charges are not refunded.

Our shipping department takes care of customs declaration, and declaration together with dispatch normally takes 4 to 7 days. We prepare the commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin and every other customs document, plus compliance paperwork for children's products when it is needed, and complete export documents are available whichever freight mode you use. We also advise you on the best way to move your bulk order, and you can follow it with tracking from the day it leaves us until it reaches you.
We reply to every enquiry within one business day.
When you enquire, we assign a dedicated swimwear specialist to your project, who arranges a call back to talk it through with you.

We choose fabrics that are kind to sensitive skin. UPF 50+ fabric is available and blocks UV rays while children play outdoors. For maximum coverage we offer long-sleeve swimsuits, including long-sleeved, sun-protective one-pieces made to order for girls.
Our fabric options include quick-dry polyester/spandex, nylon/spandex, soft stretch knits, recycled-fiber choices and UPF-rated sun-protective materials.
Our fabrics keep their colour through frequent washing, and chlorine- and salt-water-resistant fabrics are available on request.

Our UPF 50+ fabrics are tested to AS/NZS 4399 and we supply the UPF test documentation, and the standard rating applies to dry, relaxed fabric as tested. If you need to show the rating after repeated laundering, we can add a test after 20 or 40 wash cycles at an accredited lab, along with wet and stretched tests, with fees paid by you at cost.

For swim-school ranges, we offer both PBT polyester and chlorine-resistant elastane blends such as LYCRA Xtra Life, and both hold their shape far longer in chlorinated pools than standard spandex fabrics, at the price of some softness and stretch. PBT is the firmer and more chlorine-proof of the two, while the chlorine-resistant elastane blend stays softer and stretchier and keeps a closer fit over a season of weekly lessons.

We make swimwear from nylon and polyester swimwear fabrics blended with spandex, such as 80% nylon 20% spandex, with matching linings. On request we source chlorine-resistant LYCRA Xtra Life, recycled nylon such as ECONYL, recycled polyester such as REPREVE, and Italian Carvico fabrics.

For sustainable collections we also source, on request, imported certified recycled fabrics carrying GRS or OEKO-TEX certification, regenerated nylon and regenerated Lycra, and fabrics regenerated from waste that the mill dyes with OEKO-TEX certified dyes. Recycled polyester helps your line reduce plastic waste, and in our own production we manage waste strictly.

For toddler suits we supply fabrics, linings and trims certified to OEKO-TEX Standard 100 Product Class I for baby articles, which also meet EU REACH and US CPSIA requirements and suit infants' delicate skin. We confirm Class I coverage for each fabric and trim you choose before sampling and send the certificates with your order documents.
We line our suits with smooth, comfortable linings, use secure elastic and waistbands, and sew soft, chafe-free seams that suit children's skin.

For boys' swim shorts there are three liner choices: a mesh brief, a stretch nylon-spandex boxer-brief, or no liner for wearing over a swim nappy or separate undershorts. For younger children and long pool sessions, we recommend the soft boxer-brief. It has flatlock seams and covered leg elastic, so it lies flat without rubbing. Mesh suits older boys and fast-drying beachwear.

On all our children's styles, every snap, ring, slider, buckle, bead and trim is sewn or riveted on and must pass a 90 N pull test. Sizes for under-3s have no removable decorations at all. Kids' designs never include hanging charms, stones fixed with glue or heat, or beads small enough to swallow. We stitch rubber patches and appliqués down around their whole edge instead of only gluing them, so repeated chlorine and washing can't lift them. Our metal hardware is tested against the EN 1811 nickel-release limit and keeps lead under the CPSIA limits: 100 ppm in the base metal and 90 ppm in any coating. We can arrange order-specific testing at an accredited lab, with the fees passed to you at cost.

We cut our infant one-pieces with extra room in the seat and soft leg elastic, so they fit comfortably over a separate swim nappy. We can add a snap-fastened opening at the crotch, so you can change a nappy or take a toilet break without taking off the whole suit.

Standard hardware we keep in stock is ready in 3 to 7 days. Sample sets are available for most items, and you can ask for physical samples after browsing our hardware catalogue. Our hardware complies with OEKO-TEX and international safety standards for swimwear, and every item is quality-checked before it ships.

Yes. For kids' swimwear sold in the US, we sew in a permanent tracking label showing your brand name, the month and year of manufacture, our production location in Guangzhou, China, and the batch or PO number, as required under CPSIA Section 103. We print it in wash-durable ink on a sewn-in care label or a separate label so it stays legible through repeated washing and chlorine, and we keep the batch records so each piece can be traced back to its production run.
Our production holds OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for tested fabrics and trims, GRS and RCS for recycled fabrics, bluesign for chemistry, ISO 9001 for quality management and WRAP for social compliance.

We also hold GB 18401 and REACH certification, and our factory is BSCI certified. Our production is audited against CPSIA, CCPSA and SASO requirements as well, and every step from fabric through to the finished garment runs to international quality-system certification standards.
Based on your destination market and launch date, we confirm the testing, documents, sampling and production schedule for your chosen design and materials.
Our swim and beachwear sizes run from infant through size 14. Within that infant and children's range, we can produce any size spread you need.

Every kids' style starts from a dedicated children's block rather than a shrunken women's pattern. We grade each block proportionally across the full 2T to 14-year range, so all sizes in your run keep the proportions of your sample.

For babies under 2T, we use a separate infant block sized by age in months, usually 0–3, 3–6, 6–12, 12–18 and 18–24 months, with extra seat room for a swim nappy, and we grade it in proportion to body length and weight instead of scaling down the toddler pattern. We can change the size steps and size labels to suit your target market.
We look at requests for special sizing, changes to construction, custom materials and other needs specific to your project, and we can change the size label to suit your target market.
We apply your custom prints by digital or sublimation printing so the color lasts. We can also produce solid colors and add contrast panels and trims to your design.
Both OEM and ODM work is possible: a new style can start from your own design, a picture or just an idea.
An in-house design team handles pattern design, grading and fit development, which saves you rounds of back-and-forth on the design.
We use OEKO-TEX certified, environmentally responsible inks for our fabric prints, including digital printing.

For a longer-lasting result, we can embroider your logo by machine or by hand in standard, 3D, reflective or stone embroidery. Embroidery and screen printing each have a minimum of 50 pieces per design, and thread colours are limited to the thread libraries available. Custom woven labels have a minimum of 1,000 pieces.

We can put your logo on the swimwear using heat transfer, embroidery, screen printing, silicone printing or a silicone patch, or sublimation. It can also go on a sewn-in label or a woven waistband, and we can add branding made for a particular product. For club programmes we recommend sublimation. Labels and care instructions are screen printed with a chlorine-resistant method. We also take care of labelling and packaging, including branded hang tags, poly bags, retail packaging and printed cartons. For kids' swimwear we provide branded size labels and packaging.

If you supply your own labels, hang tags and bags, send 3% extra of each to cover wastage, and make sure everything reaches our factory at least 7 days before the scheduled cutting date. We count and check them on arrival and report any shortages or defects to you within 3 business days, before cutting.

Our kids' swim trunks and beach sets follow EN 14682 and ASTM F1816: there are no drawstrings at the hood or neck, waist drawcords are bar-tacked at the centre with no toggles or knots, drawcords on sizes for under-7s do not hang outside the garment, and free ends on ages 7 to 14 are at most 14 cm. If you want no free cord at all, we make the waist with a flat covered elastic band, 2 to 3 cm wide, with no drawcord.
For white and pastel kids' swimsuits we use a heavier fabric or add a lining, a double layer or a lined front panel so the suit stays opaque when wet.

We print licensed cartoon characters, logos and trademarks on kids' swimwear only if you have a written licence from the rights holder. Please send it to us before sampling starts, covering the product type and sales territory; without it, we cannot sample or produce the artwork.

We design the openings on our children's swimwear so the pieces are easy to put on and no hardware sits against the skin. On front-zip kids' one-pieces and rash guards, a fabric zip garage closes over the puller at the top, so the puller stays covered under the chin. A soft inner placket runs the full length behind the zip, which keeps the teeth off the child's skin. For toddler suits we can build in a 3-snap crotch opening, or an easy-entry zip at the front or back. Each row of snaps is backed with a soft fabric placket, and the zip has an inner guard and a fabric garage at the top. On these toddler styles, every snap and zip pull is stitched or riveted on and tested to withstand a 90 N pull. For infant suits, we can add snap crotches, shoulder snaps, or a front or back zip that runs the whole length of the suit, so dressing and nappy changes are quicker for you. A soft inner guard lines the entire track of every zip, so neither the teeth nor any metal part rests on the baby's skin.

pages.h1: Teen Swimwear Manufacturer for Custom Brand Collections
pages.hero_lead: Order your teen styles by age or by height, the chart we recommend for European markets, and approve fit samples from both ends of the size range before bulk production starts.

sections.heading: Custom Teen Swimsuits Sized by Age or Height
sections.body: You can order your teen swimsuits by age, in sizes 8-10 to 12-14 for tweens and young teens, or by height up to 164 cm, which is the chart we recommend for European markets. Before bulk production starts, you approve fit samples in two sizes: one from the younger end of the range and one from the older end.

visuals.purpose: Shows the age span the age-based size range covers.

sections.heading: OEM Teen Swimwear Pattern Drafting, Grading and Design
sections.body:
We draft every teen style on its own block instead of enlarging a children's pattern. That way it allows for a developing bust, a defined waist, fuller hips and a longer torso. We grade each of those areas separately to keep proportions, coverage, support and tension right. We also check fit in movement, where riding up and gaping show.

Our in-house team handles [OEM and ODM development](/development/) from your design, picture or idea. We take care of patterns, grading and fit, so there's less back-and-forth on the design.

sections.heading: Our Own Teen Swimwear Factory in Guangzhou, China
sections.body: We make your teen swimwear in our own factory, a single site in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China, and we check quality throughout production. We've been running since 2011, and through [our factory and export business](/about-us/) we keep quality, cost and delivery under our direct control. You agree every B2B order directly with our team, not through online shops or marketplaces.

sections.heading: Quotes, Sample Timing and Sample Fees

items.title: Quote first

items.title: Sample timing

items.title: Sample charge
items.text: Each sample costs USD 50. It isn't refunded or credited against your bulk order.

items.title: Design charge
items.text: Each design, whether it's a pattern or a print, costs USD 50 and covers all its colourways. This fee isn't refunded or credited against bulk orders either.

items.title: Courier and stock
items.text: Our [sample delivery and wholesale information](/faq/) covers courier delivery, which you pay for at USD 50 extra, and the selected styles we keep in stock.

items.title: Launch service
items.text: With our [Launch service](/swimwear-launch-services/), we confirm testing, documents, sampling and production schedules against your market, launch date, design and materials.

sections.heading: Wholesale Teen Swimwear Orders: MOQ, Trial Runs and Payment

items.title: Order minimum
items.text: We start orders at 50 pieces per style in each colour, so small and growing labels can order with us.

items.title: Trial runs
items.text: We agree your first trial quantity with you case by case. How flexible we can be depends on production requirements.

items.title: Payment terms
items.text: You pay a 50% deposit when you confirm the order and the other 50% before shipment.

items.title: Enquiry response
items.text: We reply to every [enquiry to our team](/contact-us/) within one business day.

sections.heading: Bulk Lead Time and Shipping Terms
sections.body: Your order starts with your brief or tech pack. Bulk production begins once you've approved the sample and we've received your deposit.

items.title: Bulk production
items.text: We allow 35 to 40 days for bulk production. Your order size and the season decide where your schedule falls in that range.

items.title: Final inspection
items.text: We do a full final inspection of your finished goods before they ship.

items.title: Shipping terms
items.text: We ship on FOB, CIF or DDP terms. With worldwide DDP, you get one all-in price for delivery to your door, and we handle duties, customs and freight.

sections.heading: Teen Swimsuit Styles We Make
sections.body: Training and sun styles are the steady core of a teen range, for lessons, clubs and holidays, while fashion trims follow trends and prints.

items.title: Classic one-pieces
items.text: We make scoop-back suits with adjustable or fixed straps, so you get a choice of straps on a classic silhouette.

items.title: Training cuts
items.text: Our chlorine-resistant cross-back and racerback one-pieces stay secure through active play, dives and turns, for school programmes and club training.

items.title: Sun coverage
items.text: For your outdoor range, we make zip-front long-sleeve UV suits and short-sleeve sun suits with leg coverage.

items.title: Fashion styles
items.text: You can choose frill shoulders, ruffle trims or dress-like skirted one-pieces. Thin straps, frills and skirts suit recreational swimming and learn-to-swim, but not squad training.

items.title: Coordinated sets
items.text: We cut boys' trunks, board shorts, rash guards and matching sets on the same age chart as the girls' styles and grade every piece from one shared base size.

sections.heading: Fabric Performance and Azo-Free Dye Checks
sections.body: We match the fabric to how the suit will be used.

items.title: Pool performance
items.text: Chlorine-resistant fabric lasts longest with frequent swimming and keeps its colour and stretch. It feels firmer and costs more than standard stretch fabric, though.

items.title: Skin and sun
items.text: Our stretchy fabrics feel gentle on the skin. Brushed-back fabric is the softest and warmest, but it holds more water and dries slowest. UPF 50+ adds sun protection and dries as fast as a standard knit.

items.title: Azo-free dyes
items.text: We check the dyes in every fabric to confirm they're azo-free, to meet the children's compliance requirements for your goods.

items.title: Fabric sourcing service
items.text: Through our [Swimwear Fabrics & Sourcing service](/swimwear-fabrics-sourcing/), we supply nylon or polyester blends, including 80% nylon 20% spandex with matching linings. On request, we also supply LYCRA Xtra Life, ECONYL, REPREVE and Italian Carvico fabrics.

items.title: Production certifications
items.text: Our [production certifications](/sustainability/) cover OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for tested fabrics and trims, GRS and RCS for recycled fabrics, bluesign for chemistry, ISO 9001 for quality management and WRAP for social compliance.

sections.heading: Seam Construction and Skin Comfort
sections.body: Soft bindings, backed zips and padding add sewing steps and raise your unit cost.

items.title: Seams and openings
items.text: We overlock seams and topstitch them flat. We bind openings with soft elastic instead of bare elastic, and we loosen the leg elastic slightly so it doesn't rub or leave marks.

items.title: Straps and zips
items.text: Wide straps with bar-tacked ends spread the pressure. On zipped styles, we add a chin guard and back the full length of the zip with soft fabric.

items.title: Padding options
items.text: You can have sewn-in or removable foam padding, removable cup pockets and power mesh in one-pieces, cross-backs, racerbacks, zip-front UV suits, tankinis and bikini tops.

items.title: Structured support
items.text: Underwire channels and moulded cups suit only the older sizes. We use them in structured bikini tops and one-piece bodices.

items.title: Tagless labels
items.text: For kids' swimwear, we recommend heat-transfer tagless labels over sewn-in ones.

items.title: Hardware service
items.text: Our [Swimwear Hardware service](/swimwear-hardware/) has standard stock ready in 3 to 7 days and offers samples of most items. It also covers OEKO-TEX and international swimwear safety compliance, plus checks before shipment.

items.title: Care label service
items.text: With our [Swimwear Packaging & Custom Brand Labels service](/swimwear-packaging-custom-brand-labels/), your care labels say to hand-wash or machine-wash cold on a gentle cycle, with no bleach, tumble-drying or ironing. They also say to rinse in fresh water after swimming and dry flat in the shade.

items.title: Wear recovery
items.text: For teen suits, we use chlorine-resistant elastic and fabrics chosen for strong stretch recovery and colourfastness.

sections.heading: Prints and Artwork Scaled Across Sizes

items.title: Pattern-based checks
items.text: Before strike-off, we check scale, placement and stretch on the garment patterns. If artwork is only judged flat, distortion, seam splits and exposed base fabric don't get resolved.

items.title: Print methods
items.text: We sublimation-print on polyester for full colourfastness. We also offer placement and engineered panel prints, with motifs scaled for each age group.

items.title: Dark print grounds
items.text: For dark sublimation prints, we print on matching pre-dyed grounds instead of white. If you need white, we back the high-stretch zones with dark lining.

items.title: Stretch approval
items.text: Before you approve a strike-off, we stretch-test it at 30% across the bust, seat and leg openings.

items.title: Print themes
items.text: For the print direction of your teen collection, you can choose from tropical, floral, geometric, rainbow and animal designs.

items.title: Price and preparation
items.text: Engineered prints, placement prints, pre-dyed grounds and rescaling add preparation, cost and lead time. Long-sleeve UV construction and frills raise the unit cost too.

items.title: Style quotations
items.text: We confirm bulk prices once we've reviewed the design and fabric. The price takes in the UPF rating, sleeves, construction, print method, artwork complexity, quantity, labels and packaging.

items.title: Custom Printing service
items.text: Our [Custom Printing service](/custom-swimwear-printing/) sources almost any colour or print and offers digital printing. Exclusive artwork adds cost and lead time.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions

qa.question: Can you print licensed character artwork on my teen suits, and what proof of licence do you need?
qa.answer: Yes, as long as you own the artwork or hold the rights to sell it commercially. Before sampling, send us a written licence from the rights holder that covers the product type and the sales territory. Without it, we can't sample or produce licensed characters, logos or trademarks.

qa.question: What restrictions do you apply to functional ties and decorative cords in teen swimwear for different ages and destination markets?
qa.answer: Our teen and kids' styles follow EN 14682 for Europe and ASTM F1816 for the US. That means no drawstrings at the hood or neck, and waist drawcords are bar-tacked at the centre with no toggles or knots. For ages 7 to 14, the free ends of functional ties and decorative cords are no longer than 14 cm.

qa.question: How do you select lining and coverage to keep light-coloured teen suits opaque when wet and stretched?
qa.answer: For light-coloured and white teen suits, we use double shell fabric, a 140 GSM stretch tricot lining or a fully lined front panel. That keeps them fully opaque after complete immersion.

qa.question: Besides one-pieces and sun suits, can you make teen bikinis and tankinis with modest coverage, and what cuts do you offer?
qa.answer: Yes, we make modest tankinis, including cross-strap tops with swim shorts, and age-appropriate bikinis too. You can choose high-neck or sporty crop tops, with full-coverage or mid-rise bottoms, swim shorts or skirted bottoms.

Yes, we cut boys' trunks, board shorts, rash guards and matching kids' sets on the same size chart as our teen girls' suits: by age from 8-10 up to 12-14, or by height up to 164 cm, so coordinated sets match size for size. We grade every piece in a set from one shared base size, and you approve fit samples in the youngest and oldest sizes before bulk production.

We run dedicated children's swimwear lines and handle every step ourselves, from printing the fabric to the finishing details. Boys' swimwear can carry custom rubber patch labels, and we also make kids' shorts and matching kids' sets. We can also make coordinated family looks, such as mother-and-daughter suits cut from one shared print or paired swimwear for couples. For children's pieces we choose soft, skin-friendly fabrics and sew them with smooth stitching and strong seams. Before bulk production starts, we test your samples for stretch and durability.
Our swim fabrics stretch well and feel gentle on the skin, with UPF 50+ and chlorine-resistant fabrics available. For sensitive skin, you can choose a softer brushed-back fabric.
We check the dyes in every fabric to confirm they are azo-free, so your goods meet children's compliance requirements.

Our chlorine-resistant fabric is the longest-lasting choice for teens who swim often, keeping its colour and stretch through frequent training and competition. Brushed-back fabric feels softest and warmest but holds more water and dries slowest, while UPF 50+ fabric dries about as fast as our standard swim knit and adds sun protection, so for frequent swimmers we suggest chlorine-resistant fabric, with UPF 50+ for outdoor pools.

We make swimwear from nylon and polyester swimwear fabrics blended with spandex, such as 80% nylon 20% spandex, with matching linings. On request we source chlorine-resistant LYCRA Xtra Life, recycled nylon such as ECONYL, recycled polyester such as REPREVE, and Italian Carvico fabrics.
Our production holds OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for tested fabrics and trims, GRS and RCS for recycled fabrics, bluesign for chemistry, ISO 9001 for quality management and WRAP for social compliance.

We overlock every seam and then topstitch it flat. Necklines, armholes and leg openings are finished with soft elastic binding instead of bare elastic, so no hard edge rests against the skin. At the leg openings we set the elastic slightly looser so the suit leaves no marks after hours of wear.
We cut straps wide to spread pressure and bar-tack them at each end. On styles with a zip, we add a chin guard at the top and back the zip with soft fabric along its full length.
For kids' swimwear we recommend heat-transfer tagless labels instead of sewn-in labels.

For teen girls, sewn-in or removable foam padding, removable cup pockets and power mesh lining work in our one-pieces, cross-back and racerback suits, zip-front UV suits, tankinis and bikini tops. Underwire channels and molded cups go into structured bikini tops and one-piece bodices, usually in the older sizes of the range.

Standard hardware we keep in stock is ready in 3 to 7 days. Sample sets are available for most items, and you can ask for physical samples after browsing our hardware catalogue. Our hardware complies with OEKO-TEX and international safety standards for swimwear, and every item is quality-checked before it ships.

Our care labels tell wearers to hand wash or machine wash cold on a gentle cycle, and not to bleach, tumble dry or iron the suit. To stop fading and bagging over a season, we also advise rinsing in fresh water after each swim and drying flat in the shade, and we build teen suits with chlorine-resistant elastic and fabrics chosen for strong stretch recovery and colourfastness.
We sublimation-print on polyester bases, which gives the colors full colorfastness.
Our print themes range from tropical, floral and geometric to rainbow and animal designs.
We also offer placement prints and engineered panel prints, and we scale the motif to fit each age group in the range.

For dark sublimation prints on close-fitting teen suits, we print onto a ground fabric pre-dyed in a matching dark tone instead of a white base, so stretched areas show colour rather than white. We stretch-test every strike-off at 30% across the bust, seat and leg openings before you approve it, and where a white base is required we add a dark lining behind the high-stretch zones.

Yes, long-sleeve UV construction, frills and prints rescaled for each age size can raise the unit cost, because each quote reflects the fabric and its UPF rating, the sleeve type, how complex the construction is, the print method and artwork complexity, along with quantity, labels and packaging. We confirm the bulk price for each style after reviewing your design and fabric choice.

For custom designs we can source nearly any colour or print, and we offer digital printing for your swimwear range. Available print themes include floral, paisley, retro, zigzag, animal, strawberry, lemon and watercolour. We can also develop exclusive prints and patterns just for you, though these cost more and add to the lead time.

Yes, we can print licensed characters, logos or trademarks on your teen suits, provided the artwork belongs to you or is licensed to you for commercial sale. Before sampling starts, send us a written licence from the rights holder covering the product type and sales territory; without it, we cannot sample or produce the artwork.

Our teen and kids' styles follow EN 14682 for Europe and ASTM F1816 for the US, so they have no drawstrings at the hood or neck, and waist drawcords are bar-tacked at the centre with no toggles or knots. For ages 7 to 14, the free ends of functional ties and decorative cords are at most 14 cm.

For light-coloured and white teen suits we use a double layer of the shell fabric, a 140 GSM stretch tricot lining or a fully lined front panel, so the suit stays fully opaque even after complete immersion.

Yes, besides one-pieces and sun suits we make modest teen tankinis, including cross-strap tops paired with swim shorts, as well as bikinis with age-appropriate coverage. Cuts include high-neck tops and sporty crop tops, full-coverage or mid-rise bottoms, and swim shorts or skirted bottoms.

pages.h1: Baby Swimwear Manufacturer for Custom and Private Label Orders
pages.hero_lead: Bring us a tech pack, a reference sample or a clear product concept, and we turn it into baby swimwear under OEM or ODM terms, with a standard sample ready in 10 to 15 days.

sections.heading: OEM, ODM and Private Label Baby Swimwear
sections.body: You can start your baby swimwear order with a tech pack, a reference sample or a clearly defined product concept, and we develop the goods from there. We make custom baby and kids’ swimwear for you under OEM, ODM or private label arrangements.

sections.heading: Custom Baby Swimwear Sampling from Your Brief
sections.body:
| Development stage | What happens |
|---|---|
| Brief and fit | We confirm your age range, measurements, styles and branding before we choose materials or cut a sample. Babies grow through narrow size bands, so settling these details first avoids rework on patterns and grading. |
| Design development | Our design team takes your concept, reference image or collection direction and refines the silhouettes, colours, prints and details. |
| Material assessment | We check stretch, hand feel, lining, trims and colours against your design and destination market. Once the design and size range are confirmed, we build and grade the patterns. |
| Price agreement | You get your [quote](/request-a-quote/) first, and we start sampling once you agree to the price. |
| Sample timing and fees | A standard sample is ready in 10 to 15 days. Each sample costs USD 50, and the design fee is USD 50 per design, which covers its pattern or print in all colourways. Neither fee is refunded or credited against bulk orders. |
| Enquiry response | We answer every [enquiry](/contact-us/) within one business day. |
| Launch service | Our [Launch service](/swimwear-launch-services/) confirms testing, documents, sampling and production schedules for the design and materials you choose, checked against your destination market and launch date. |

sections.heading: Wholesale MOQ, Lead Times, Payment and Shipping Terms

items.title: Minimum order
items.text: Orders start at 50 pieces per style in each colour. That keeps production within reach of small and growing labels.

items.title: First trial run
items.text: We agree your first trial quantity case by case, and our flexibility goes as far as production allows.

items.title: Production timing
items.text: Bulk production takes 35 to 40 days from sample approval and receipt of your deposit. Your order size and the season set where your order falls in that range.

items.title: Deposit payment
items.text: We take a 50% deposit when you confirm your order, before bulk production starts.

items.title: Balance payment
items.text: You pay the remaining 50% before shipment, which completes payment for the confirmed order.

items.title: Final inspection
items.text: Your completed bulk order goes through a full final inspection before we ship it.

items.title: Shipping terms
items.text: We ship on FOB, CIF or DDP terms. Worldwide DDP includes delivery to your door, and we handle duties, customs and freight.

sections.heading: Our Own Baby Swimwear Factory in Guangzhou, China

items.title: Factory location
items.text: We manufacture your goods at our baby swimwear factory in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China.

items.title: Our own production
items.text: We make the swimwear ourselves, in a single factory that we own.

items.title: Company control
items.text: Our [factory-owning company](/about-us/) has operated since 2011, and we keep production, export, quality, cost and delivery under our direct control.

items.title: Production certifications
items.text: Our [production certifications](/sustainability/) are OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for tested fabrics and trims, GRS/RCS for recycled fabrics, bluesign for chemistry, ISO 9001 for quality and WRAP for social compliance.

items.title: Buying support
items.text: Our [buyer information](/faq/) covers independent inspection, selected wholesale stock and USD 50 sample courier delivery, which you pay.

items.title: Quality claims
items.text: Under our [quality terms](/terms-and-conditions/), you report defects with photos or videos within 7 days of receipt. Our assessment decides whether we repair, remake or replace the goods or give a goods credit. Shipping and handling are not refunded.

sections.heading: Girls' and Boys' Baby Swim Styles and Size Ranges

items.title: Girls’ and boys’ styles
items.text: For girls, we make crisscross-strap and tank one-pieces, swim dresses and tankinis. For boys, we make swim trunks with an elastic waist and drawstring, in solids or prints.

items.title: Your size run
items.text: We produce any baby, toddler or kids’ size run to your grading rules and size labels, and we set chest and waist measurements from your measurement sheet.

items.title: Baby base chart
items.text: Our baby chart goes by height and weight: 0–3M is 55–62 cm and 4–6 kg; 3–6M is 62–68 cm and 6–8 kg; 6–12M is 68–76 cm and 8–10 kg; 12–18M is 76–82 cm and 10–11.5 kg; 18–24M is 82–88 cm and 11.5–13 kg.

items.title: Toddler base chart
items.text: Our toddler chart goes by height: 2T is 88–94 cm, 3T is 94–100 cm and 4T is 100–106 cm.

items.title: Matching gift sets
items.text: You can pair a swimsuit with one or two matching hats, headbands or swim nappies. The print and size stay consistent, so the pieces make one coordinated gift.

items.title: Gift set packing
items.text: We label every component for packing and restocking and pack it in your gift box, printed pouch or hanger card. Then we ship in 5-ply export cartons marked with the style, colour and size breakdown.

items.title: Matching accessories
items.text: Our [custom bucket hats, scrunchies and headbands](/swimwear-accessories/) start at 50 pieces per style in each colour. We make them in your swimwear fabric or print so they match the range.

items.title: Children’s construction
items.text: Our [children’s swimwear](/children-s-swimwear-manufacturer/) has guarded zips and 3-snap toddler openings, and we test attachments to 90 N. Styles for under-3s have no removable decorations. We test nickel release to EN 1811 and meet the CPSIA lead limits of 100 ppm for base metal and 90 ppm for coatings.

sections.heading: Sun-Protective Fabrics Made for Sensitive Skin
sections.body:
| Fabric choice | What it means for your range |
|---|---|
| Polyester/spandex | For a range aimed at the pool, polyester keeps its colour and shape through repeated swims in chlorinated water. Our blend gives covered areas UPF 50 protection. |
| Nylon/spandex | For softness and beach use, nylon/spandex holds up to saltwater and sunscreen without losing quality. With frequent chlorine exposure, though, it loses colour and shape sooner. |
| Design requirements | We offer fabrics suited to sensitive skin, recycled and custom stretch options, UPF 50+ fabrics and quick-dry choices. We set print scale, lining and stretch recovery to match your design. |
| Specialist sourcing | Through [Swimwear Fabrics & Sourcing](/swimwear-fabrics-sourcing/), we supply blends such as 80% nylon 20% spandex with matching linings, and we source LYCRA Xtra Life, ECONYL, REPREVE and Italian Carvico when you ask for them. For weekly toddler lessons, we specify a firmer 84/16 polyester-spandex or PBT, which has the highest chlorine resistance. We don't use the softest, stretchiest nylon-spandex there, because it's meant for the beach and occasional pool use. Before sampling, we confirm that the baby fabrics, linings and trims you choose are covered by OEKO-TEX Standard 100 Product Class I and meet EU REACH and US CPSIA. The certificates go in your order documents. |

sections.heading: Customization, Decoration and Private Label Branding Options

items.title: Style customisation
items.text: You choose the fabric, colour, print, size, trims, labels and packaging. We make solid or printed styles using cut-and-sew, digital printing, sublimation, embroidery and lining work.

items.title: Comfortable decoration
items.text: On all-over polyester prints, the sublimation dye bonds into the fibre, so the print stretches without cracking. We keep embroidery and heavy logos away from areas that touch the skin, and we use flat printed labels so nothing rubs.

items.title: Brand labels
items.text: Our [Swimwear Packaging & Custom Brand Labels service](/swimwear-packaging-custom-brand-labels/) adds your branding during manufacture. That covers heat-transfer care labels for tagless suits, recycled woven or printed labels, and logos printed after sewing.

items.title: Printing inks
items.text: Our [Custom Printing service](/custom-swimwear-printing/) prints your fabrics, digital prints included, with OEKO-TEX certified, environmentally responsible inks.

sections.heading: Fabrics and Construction That Keep Baby Swimsuits in Shape
sections.body:
To stop the seat sagging when it's wet, we use 180 to 200 gsm nylon or polyester spandex fabric with at least 18% spandex. We add a full lining of 110 to 130 gsm at the seat. A suit gets heavier when it's wet, and stretch recovery and seat support are what hold its shape.

We use chlorine-resistant elastic at the waist and legs. Leg openings are finished with soft, flat elastic at gentle tension. Flatlocked or covered seams sit away from the inner thigh and crotch, so they don't rub while babies crawl and kick. For shape that lasts longer, LYCRA Xtra Life is available.

visuals.purpose: Gives the fabric and lining weights we use so seats keep their shape when wet.
visuals.caption: Fabric and lining weights that stop seats sagging when wet

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions

qa.question: How do you adjust infant patterns to accommodate a swim diaper without making the waist and leg openings loose?
qa.answer: We add 2–3 cm of rise and seat room through the back and crotch. Soft elastic bindings, cut 10–15% shorter than the openings, keep the waist and legs close-fitting. Before grading, we check every infant fit sample over a swim diaper.

qa.question: Can you build a swim nappy layer into baby swimsuits or trunks, or make reusable swim nappies to sell alongside them?
qa.answer: Yes, we make both. Built-in layers use a soft inner brief with snug elasticated waist and leg cuffs. Separate reusable swim nappies come in sizes 0–3M to 24M and start at 50 pieces per style in each colour. We settle built-in nappy features before the first fit sample.

qa.question: For infant swim trunks, what waistband options can replace exposed drawstrings to avoid entanglement risks?
qa.answer: You can choose soft elastic fully enclosed in a 3 cm fabric casing, a flat-front waistband with elastic at the back only, or a drawcord kept entirely inside the waist channel. Our kids’ styles follow EN 14682 and ASTM F1816, and under-7 sizes have no drawcords hanging outside the garment. We settle the enclosed-elastic construction before the first fit sample.

qa.question: Do you make thermal-lined swim warmers as well as standard stretch swimwear?
qa.answer: Yes. We make swim warmers with a soft brushed thermal lining for babies who get cold quickly, starting at 50 pieces per style in each colour. We confirm the thermal lining before the first fit sample.

qa.question: Which baby-specific features, such as a nappy layer, zips, snaps, UPF fabric or matching accessories, add to the unit cost?
qa.answer: Built-in nappy layers, guarded zips, snap closures, UPF 50+ fabric, all-over custom prints and matching hats or accessories all raise your unit cost above a plain lined suit, because each one adds materials and sewing time. Branded or recycled fabrics also cost more than our standard blends.

visuals.caption: How we adjust infant patterns to fit over a swim diaper

For younger children and long pool sessions, we recommend the soft boxer-brief. It has flatlock seams and covered leg elastic, so it lies flat without rubbing. Mesh suits older boys and fast-drying beachwear.
We also make rash guard sets, sun-protective long-sleeve suits and printed beach sets, so you can fill out a complete kids' swim assortment.

You can choose recycled swim fabric, nylon/spandex, polyester/spandex or a custom stretch fabric. Our polyester/spandex blend gives UPF 50 protection to the areas it covers, and our nylon/spandex blends hold up to saltwater and sunscreen without any loss of quality but lose colour and shape sooner with frequent chlorine exposure. Our fabrics are suitable for sensitive skin, and UPF 50+ fabrics are available.
We set print scale, lining and stretch recovery to suit your design, and quick-dry fabric options are available.

We make swimwear from nylon and polyester swimwear fabrics blended with spandex, such as 80% nylon 20% spandex, with matching linings. On request we source chlorine-resistant LYCRA Xtra Life, recycled nylon such as ECONYL, recycled polyester such as REPREVE, and Italian Carvico fabrics.

For toddler suits, nylon-spandex is the softest and stretchiest of the three but loses colour and shape sooner with frequent chlorine exposure, polyester-spandex such as our 84/16 blend feels slightly firmer but keeps its colour and fit far longer in the pool, and PBT combines a soft natural stretch with the highest chlorine resistance of the three. For toddler lines worn to weekly swim lessons we recommend PBT or polyester-spandex, and nylon-spandex for beach and occasional pool wear.

For toddler suits we supply fabrics, linings and trims certified to OEKO-TEX Standard 100 Product Class I for baby articles, which also meet EU REACH and US CPSIA requirements and suit infants' delicate skin. We confirm Class I coverage for each fabric and trim you choose before sampling and send the certificates with your order documents.

For sustainable collections we also source, on request, imported certified recycled fabrics carrying GRS or OEKO-TEX certification, regenerated nylon and regenerated Lycra, and fabrics regenerated from waste that the mill dyes with OEKO-TEX certified dyes. You can customize each style by fabric, colour, print, size, trims, labels and packaging. We take custom prints or solid colours, add embroidery, and produce your own labels and packaging. Our production techniques cover cut and sew, digital printing, sublimation printing and lining work.

We build your branding into the garments while they are being made. For labels you can choose woven main and neck labels, satin, cotton or transparent labels, stamped or printed labels, heat-transfer labels and silicone labels. Care, wash and size labels can also be woven, printed or heat-transferred. A heat-transfer care label leaves the suit tagless. Woven and printed labels are also available in recycled materials. If you want a logo on the finished piece, we can print it after the garment has been sewn.
We use OEKO-TEX certified, environmentally responsible inks for our fabric prints, including digital printing.

We design the openings on our children's swimwear so the pieces are easy to put on and no hardware sits against the skin. On front-zip kids' one-pieces and rash guards, a fabric zip garage closes over the puller at the top, so the puller stays covered under the chin. A soft inner placket runs the full length behind the zip, which keeps the teeth off the child's skin. For toddler suits we can build in a 3-snap crotch opening, or an easy-entry zip at the front or back. Each row of snaps is backed with a soft fabric placket, and the zip has an inner guard and a fabric garage at the top. On these toddler styles, every snap and zip pull is stitched or riveted on and tested to withstand a 90 N pull. For infant suits, we can add snap crotches, shoulder snaps, or a front or back zip that runs the whole length of the suit, so dressing and nappy changes are quicker for you. A soft inner guard lines the entire track of every zip, so neither the teeth nor any metal part rests on the baby's skin.

On all our children's styles, every snap, ring, slider, buckle, bead and trim is sewn or riveted on and must pass a 90 N pull test. Sizes for under-3s have no removable decorations at all. Kids' designs never include hanging charms, stones fixed with glue or heat, or beads small enough to swallow. We stitch rubber patches and appliqués down around their whole edge instead of only gluing them, so repeated chlorine and washing can't lift them. Our metal hardware is tested against the EN 1811 nickel-release limit and keeps lead under the CPSIA limits: 100 ppm in the base metal and 90 ppm in any coating. We can build a swim nappy layer into baby one-pieces and trunks, using a soft inner brief with snug elasticated leg and waist cuffs. We also make reusable swim nappies as a separate product in sizes 0–3M to 24M, starting at 50 pieces per style in each colour.

For infant and toddler swim trunks, we can replace exposed drawstrings with soft elastic fully enclosed in a 3 cm fabric casing, a flat-front waistband with elastic in the back only, or a drawcord that stays completely inside the waist channel. Kids' styles follow EN 14682 and ASTM F1816, and on sizes for under-7s, drawcords do not hang outside the garment.
We make swim warmers with a soft brushed thermal lining for babies who get cold quickly, starting at 50 pieces per style in each colour.

A built-in nappy layer, zips with zip guards, snap closures, UPF 50+ fabric, all-over custom prints and matching hats or accessories each add materials and sewing time, so they raise the unit cost compared with a plain lined suit. | Development | Our in-house team handles [OEM and ODM development](/development/) and turns your design, picture or idea into patterns, grading and fit. |
| Quotes and inspection | Our [quotation, sample-delivery and inspection terms](/faq/) cover three things. We give factory-direct pricing after we review your design and fabric, and we don't list prices online. You pay USD 50 for courier delivery of samples. Independent inspectors such as SGS or BV can come in to inspect. |
| Certifications | Our [production certifications and sourcing](/sustainability/) cover OEKO-TEX Standard 100, GRS, RCS, bluesign, ISO 9001 and WRAP. We source sustainable fabrics only from certified suppliers. |

sections.heading: Chlorine- and Salt-Resistant Fabrics for Little Swimmers
sections.body:
| Fabric consideration | What it means for your collection |
|---|---|
| Water and washing | Our chlorine- and salt-resistant fabrics hold up to active play and repeated washing without fading, and they're gentle on sensitive skin. |
| Sun protection | You can choose UPF 50+ fabric to block UV rays while toddlers play outdoors. |
| Fabric selection and compliance | Through our [Swimwear Fabrics & Sourcing service](/swimwear-fabrics-sourcing/), we offer matching linings and blends such as 80% nylon 20% spandex. Softer nylon-spandex suits the beach and occasional pool wear, because frequent chlorine exposure reduces how well it keeps its colour and shape. Firmer polyester-spandex, such as our 84/16 blend, keeps its pool fit longer. PBT has the highest chlorine resistance, so it suits weekly lessons. Before sampling, we confirm OEKO-TEX Standard 100 Product Class I coverage for toddler fabrics and trims that meet EU REACH and US CPSIA requirements. The certificates come with your order documents. |

sections.heading: Soft, Secure Construction for Every Splash

items.title: Skin-contact finishes
items.text: We line the front and seat, finish skin-contact seams flat or covered, and enclose the waist and leg elastic. These finishes deal with friction as toddlers crawl, sit and move around in wet suits.

items.title: Lining trade-off
items.text: Full linings and covered seams add fabric, sewing time and cost, and they make suits a little slower to dry.

items.title: Children’s construction options
items.text: Our [children’s swimwear](/children-s-swimwear-manufacturer/) comes with guarded zips, 3-snap crotches and a choice of liners. We carry out 90 N attachment testing and EN 1811 nickel testing, and we put no removable decorations on styles for under-3s. Lead stays within CPSIA limits of 100 ppm for metal and 90 ppm for coatings.

items.title: Baby fit construction
items.text: Our [baby swimwear construction](/baby-swimwear-manufacturer/) pairs gentle elastic and covered seams with 180 to 200 gsm fabric, at least 18% spandex and a full lining. A 110 to 130 gsm seat lining keeps the seat from sagging when it gets wet.

sections.heading: Styles for Girls and Boys

items.title: Girls’ core shapes
items.text: You can pick from crisscross-strap one-pieces, tank one-pieces that stay in place without tugging, swim dresses with attached shorts, and tankini tops and bottoms you can mix and match.

items.title: Boys’ swim trunks
items.text: We make boys’ trunks with an elastic waist and a drawstring, in solid colours or in prints for your collection.

items.title: Repeat approved shapes
items.text: Reordering or recolouring a core shape that has already passed its fit and safety checks is quicker. Every new shape needs its own pattern, sample and approval.

items.title: Seasonal variety
items.text: A narrow range of shapes looks repetitive. If your brand sells on newness, add one or two fashion shapes each season so your customers get familiar fits alongside fresh silhouettes.

sections.heading: Toddler Sizes and Custom Size Runs
sections.body:
Before your first sample, choose our standard 2T to 4T chart or send us your own. That way we cut and grade to the sizing your labels promise.

| Size option | Age | Height | Weight |

| 2T | About 2 years | 88 to 94 cm | 12 to 14 kg |
| 3T | About 3 years | 94 to 100 cm | 14 to 16 kg |

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions

qa.question: Do the drawstrings on your toddler trunks and the ties on girls’ styles meet children’s drawstring safety rules for the US and EU?
qa.answer: Yes. Our toddler trunks and girls’ tie styles follow EN 14682 and ASTM F1816 for the US and EU. There are no neck drawstrings, and waist drawcords are bar-tacked at the centre with no toggles or knots. Every toddler size falls under the under-7s rules, so drawcords and ties don't hang outside the garment.

qa.question: Can you manufacture toddler swimsuits with an integrated reusable swim-diaper layer designed for solid-waste containment, rather than ordinary swimsuit lining?
qa.answer: Yes. We build in a reusable swim-diaper layer that holds solids and lets water drain out. It's a snug inner brief with elasticated waist and leg cuffs, not ordinary lining. You can also choose a unisex design with adjustable snaps that fits securely across several sizes.

qa.question: Can you develop separate fits for toddlers wearing swim diapers and toilet-trained toddlers, rather than simply increasing the overall garment size?
qa.answer: Yes, we make separate patterns. The swim-diaper fit adds 2 to 3 cm to the standard seat and rise and widens the leg openings. The toilet-trained fit keeps the standard seat, rise and leg openings. We sample both for your approval before bulk production. If you just add a diaper layer to a standard pattern, the suit leaks or pulls, because the extra room and cuffs change the fit.

sections.heading: Start Your Private Label Toddler Swimwear Collection
sections.body: Send us your toddler swimwear design, reference images or tech pack to start. We review your design and fabric choice to confirm bulk pricing, and reply to your enquiry within one business day.

cta.label: Request a quote for toddler swimwear

facts.text: We manufacture swimwear ourselves in a single factory of our own in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China.
Orders start at 50 pieces per style in each colour, a level set so that small and growing labels can order.
A first trial run is agreed case by case, and we are as flexible on its quantity as production allows.
Once the sample is approved and the deposit received, bulk production usually needs 35 to 40 days, depending on order size and season.
A standard sample is ready in 10 to 15 days.
Each sample costs USD 50, and the design fee is USD 50 per design (its pattern or print, with all colourways); these fees are not refunded or credited against the bulk order.
Shipments go out on FOB, CIF or DDP terms; DDP is available worldwide, and under DDP one all-in price covers delivery to your door, with duties, customs and freight handled by us.

A typical order moves from your brief or tech pack to a sample in 10 to 15 days, then to your approval and deposit, 35 to 40 days of bulk production depending on size and season, a full final inspection, and shipment on FOB, CIF or DDP terms.
We take a 50% deposit when the order is confirmed, and the remaining 50% is paid before shipment.
Production and export sit in one company that owns its factory, so quality, cost and delivery stay under our direct control.
Both OEM and ODM work is possible: a new style can start from your own design, a picture or just an idea.
Courier delivery of samples costs USD 50, paid by the buyer in addition to the sample fee.
Quality is checked at every stage of an order: fabric on arrival, cutting, sewing, then random checks and a full final inspection.
Independent inspectors such as SGS or BV are welcome to check the goods before they ship.
An in-house design team handles pattern design, grading and fit development, which saves you rounds of back-and-forth on the design.
Our production holds OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for tested fabrics and trims, GRS and RCS for recycled fabrics, bluesign for chemistry, ISO 9001 for quality management and WRAP for social compliance.
We reply to every enquiry within one business day.
Based on your destination market and launch date, we confirm the testing, documents, sampling and production schedule for your chosen design and materials.
Report any shortages, defects, damages from late delivery or returns to us in writing within 7 days of receiving the goods.
Our sustainable fabrics come only from certified material suppliers.

We do not list prices online. Each style is priced from your spec sheets, detailed photos or reference images. The quote depends on the style and how complex its construction is, the level of coverage, the fabric and lining, the print method and any custom printing, your labels, branding and packaging, and the quantity you order. We confirm the bulk price after reviewing your design and fabric choice, and you pay factory-direct prices.
We also make rash guard sets, sun-protective long-sleeve suits and printed beach sets, so you can fill out a complete kids' swim assortment.

We offer fabrics that resist chlorine and salt water. Your suits will stand up to active play and repeated washing without the colors fading. The fabrics are also gentle on sensitive skin and protect against the sun.
UPF 50+ fabric is available for our toddler swimwear, so it blocks UV rays while children play outdoors.

We make swimwear from nylon and polyester swimwear fabrics blended with spandex, such as 80% nylon 20% spandex, with matching linings. On request we source chlorine-resistant LYCRA Xtra Life, recycled nylon such as ECONYL, recycled polyester such as REPREVE, and Italian Carvico fabrics.

For toddler suits, nylon-spandex is the softest and stretchiest of the three but loses colour and shape sooner with frequent chlorine exposure, polyester-spandex such as our 84/16 blend feels slightly firmer but keeps its colour and fit far longer in the pool, and PBT combines a soft natural stretch with the highest chlorine resistance of the three. For toddler lines worn to weekly swim lessons we recommend PBT or polyester-spandex, and nylon-spandex for beach and occasional pool wear.

For toddler suits we supply fabrics, linings and trims certified to OEKO-TEX Standard 100 Product Class I for baby articles, which also meet EU REACH and US CPSIA requirements and suit infants' delicate skin. We confirm Class I coverage for each fabric and trim you choose before sampling and send the certificates with your order documents.
We build every toddler suit for comfort. Each one has soft linings, a waistband that stays securely in place, and seams finished to prevent chafing.

On all our children's styles, every snap, ring, slider, buckle, bead and trim is sewn or riveted on and must pass a 90 N pull test. Sizes for under-3s have no removable decorations at all. Kids' designs never include hanging charms, stones fixed with glue or heat, or beads small enough to swallow. We stitch rubber patches and appliqués down around their whole edge instead of only gluing them, so repeated chlorine and washing can't lift them. Our metal hardware is tested against the EN 1811 nickel-release limit and keeps lead under the CPSIA limits: 100 ppm in the base metal and 90 ppm in any coating. We can arrange order-specific testing at an accredited lab, with the fees passed to you at cost.

We design the openings on our children's swimwear so the pieces are easy to put on and no hardware sits against the skin. On front-zip kids' one-pieces and rash guards, a fabric zip garage closes over the puller at the top, so the puller stays covered under the chin. A soft inner placket runs the full length behind the zip, which keeps the teeth off the child's skin. For toddler suits we can build in a 3-snap crotch opening, or an easy-entry zip at the front or back. Each row of snaps is backed with a soft fabric placket, and the zip has an inner guard and a fabric garage at the top. On these toddler styles, every snap and zip pull is stitched or riveted on and tested to withstand a 90 N pull. For infant suits, we can add snap crotches, shoulder snaps, or a front or back zip that runs the whole length of the suit, so dressing and nappy changes are quicker for you. A soft inner guard lines the entire track of every zip, so neither the teeth nor any metal part rests on the baby's skin.

We finish leg openings with soft, flat elastic at a gentle tension. Seams are flatlocked or covered and placed away from the inner thigh and crotch, so nothing rubs as babies crawl and kick. To keep seats from sagging when wet, we use 180 to 200 gsm nylon or polyester spandex fabric with at least 18% spandex, for good stretch recovery. We add a full lining, which is 110 to 130 gsm at the seat, and chlorine-resistant elastic at the waist and leg openings. LYCRA Xtra Life is available if you want the shape to last longer.

For girls, you can choose from:
- One-pieces with crisscross straps
- Tank one-pieces that stay put without tugging
- Swim dresses with attached shorts
- Tankini tops and bottoms you can mix and match
Our boys' swim trunks have an elastic waist with a drawstring and come in solid colors or prints.

For boys' swim shorts there are three liner choices: a mesh brief, a stretch nylon-spandex boxer-brief, or no liner for wearing over a swim nappy or separate undershorts. For younger children and long pool sessions, we recommend the soft boxer-brief. It has flatlock seams and covered leg elastic, so it lies flat without rubbing. Mesh suits older boys and fast-drying beachwear.
We can produce any size run you need across our infant and children's range.

Our standard toddler sizes are 2T for about 2 years, 88 to 94 cm and 12 to 14 kg; 3T for about 3 years, 94 to 100 cm and 14 to 16 kg; and 4T for about 4 years, 100 to 106 cm and 16 to 18 kg. We can also grade your styles to your own size chart.

Our toddler trunks and girls' tie styles follow EN 14682 and ASTM F1816 for the US and EU, so there are no drawstrings at the neck, and waist drawcords are bar-tacked at the centre with no toggles or knots. All toddler sizes fall under the rules for under-7s, so drawcords and ties do not hang outside the garment.

Yes, we can build toddler swimsuits with an integrated reusable swim-diaper layer that holds solids in while letting water drain out, using a snug inner brief with elasticated waist and leg cuffs instead of an ordinary lining. The design can be made unisex for boys and girls, with adjustable snap closures that keep it secure and comfortable over several sizes.

Yes, our in-house pattern team can develop a separate swim-diaper fit for each toddler size, adding 2 to 3 cm to the seat and rise and widening the leg openings, while the toilet-trained fit keeps a standard seat and rise. We sample both fits so you can approve each one before bulk production.

pages.h1: Modest Swimwear Manufacturer for Full-Coverage Swim Sets
pages.hero_lead: You get two- or three-piece sets pairing a long-sleeve tunic or swim dress with full-length leggings and a hood or separate hijab, or single-garment body suits with leg coverage.

sections.heading: Modest Swim Sets and Full-Coverage Styles We Make
sections.body: We make burkinis and modest swim sets as two-piece or three-piece outfits. Each one pairs a long-sleeve tunic or swim dress with full-length leggings and either a hood or a separate hijab. Our swim dresses are cut to layer over leggings. If you want a single-garment range, we also make full-coverage one-piece swimsuits and integrated body suits with leg coverage built in.

sections.heading: Custom Modest Swimwear Styles We Produce

items.title: Coordinated core range
items.text: Start with a core burkini and add matching extensions. Fabric, colourway and fit block stay consistent, so the range is easier to reorder than a collection of unrelated pieces.

items.title: Training and water sports
items.text: We make custom sport burkinis for training, sportswear with two-tone panels, long-sleeve rash guards, and swim leggings for surfing and other water sports.

items.title: Headwear and cover-ups
items.text: We make swim hijabs and caps, as well as beach and poolside cover-ups, kaftans and robes in fast-drying fabric.

sections.heading: Wholesale Stock and Ready-Made Modest Designs
sections.body:
Our ready-made designs are built on established patterns. That means your first order or market test skips new development and the sampling risk that comes with it. Once you have proven sellers, you can move on to custom development.

Ask us for our latest Modest Swimwear and Burkinis line sheet to see current wholesale stock and ready-made options. You can add your own labels and branding without developing a new design. The underlying style stays available to every buyer, but the prints, artwork and branding you supply stay exclusive to you.

sections.heading: Matching Prints Across Tunic, Leggings and Hijab

items.title: Colour across pieces
items.text: We print the tunic, leggings and hijab for each set together so their shades match. We line up motifs across side seams and shoulder joins during cutting, because that's the stage that controls seam matching.

items.title: Custom print service
items.text: Our [Custom Printing service](/custom-swimwear-printing/) works from your AI or PDF artwork. You can choose photo-sharp all-over or placement sublimation on polyester, or digital pigment printing on nylon, and add embroidery if you like. The prints last more than 200 hours in chlorinated and salt water.

items.title: New style development
items.text: With our [OEM and ODM development](/development/), we start your new modest swim style from your own design, a picture or just an idea.

items.title: Labels and packaging
items.text: Our [Swimwear Packaging & Custom Brand Labels service](/swimwear-packaging-custom-brand-labels/) covers branding, tags and packaging that fits your budget. Packaging with your company name and logo is quoted based on the format you choose.

sections.heading: Our Own Modest Swimwear Factory in Guangzhou, China
sections.body:
We make everything in our own single factory in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China. Because we run our own [factory-owned production and export operation](/about-us/), we control quality, cost and delivery directly. We check your goods throughout production and again before dispatch.

Our [production certifications](/sustainability/) include OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for tested fabrics and trims, GRS and RCS for recycled fabrics, bluesign for chemistry, ISO 9001 for quality management and WRAP for social compliance.

sections.heading: Brands, Swim Schools and Teams We Supply
sections.body: Where you sell decides what leads your brief: durability and uniformity, or fashion fit and regional coverage.

items.title: Schools, clubs and teams
items.text: We supply swim schools, clubs, municipal pool programmes, and lifeguard and instructor uniform teams. For these buyers we focus on consistent, hard-wearing pieces you can reorder.

items.title: Athletic and retail labels
items.text: We work with athletic modest swimwear brands and modest-fashion retailers in the Middle East, Southeast Asia and Europe. We adapt lengths, coverage and fit to what each region prefers.

items.title: Market-specific size charts
items.text: We grade to EU, UK, US or Middle East size charts, or to your own chart, so your retail sizing matches your market.

sections.heading: Coverage Levels, Sleeves and Swim Hijab Constructions
sections.body:
Choose coverage and headwear together. Tunic length, neckline and headwear work as a unit to control comfort and security. If you choose them separately, you end up with combinations that shift while the wearer swims.

| Feature | Construction choices |
|---|---|
| Coverage | A mid-thigh tunic, a tunic with an added skirt or cape, or a knee-length swim dress with an overlapping or envelope hem. The swim dress is our longest style. |
| Hijab construction | Pull-on full-neck, tie-back or adjustable, or a two-piece cap and drape. Sets can also take a hood or a separate cap. |
| Face and ears | Soft elastic binding keeps the face opening in shape without digging in, and extra room around the ears makes it more comfortable. |
| Neck and chin | A long, coverstitched drape tucks inside the tunic. A shaped chin panel covers the chin and neck, and an internal drawcord within easy reach adjusts the fit. |
| Headwear fabric | A lighter swim knit breathes better. We dye it in the same dye lot as the tunic and leggings, and all three get approved together before bulk. |
| Sleeves and necklines | Full-length sleeves, with or without thumb-loop cuffs, or three-quarter sleeves. Necklines come as a small stand collar, a high round neck or a hood set into the shoulder seam. |
| Legging shapes | Straight, tapered or flared legs, with an elastic or drawcord waistband. |

sections.heading: Fabric Matched to Pool or Open Water

items.title: Standard fabric weight
items.text: Our 200–210 gsm fabric is rated UPF 50+. It absorbs little water and dries fast, so garments stay light when wet. Sport burkinis also get chlorine resistance.

items.title: Pool or open water
items.text: Where your customers swim sets the specification. For pools we focus on chlorine resistance and colourfastness. For open water we focus on UPF and how the fabric behaves when soaked.

items.title: Wet sample approval
items.text: We swim in every prototype to check drag, shifting, cling and opacity, check it again dry, and show you how it stays down instead of floating up. Before you approve bulk, have your own swimmer try it wet, after washing, through full strokes. That trial shows behaviour that dry swatches don't.

items.title: Lining and silhouette
items.text: Light shades need a front lining. Full or front-only tunic lining, a relaxed A-line with 4 to 6 cm of extra hip ease, and overlays at the chest and hips all reduce cling and hide the body's contours.

items.title: Surface and shade
items.text: Matt or textured fabrics, a heavier 220 gsm tunic option, darker shades and all-over prints all show less of the body's outline when wet.

items.title: Fabric sourcing choices
items.text: Our [Swimwear Fabrics & Sourcing service](/swimwear-fabrics-sourcing/) supplies nylon/polyester-spandex fabrics with matching linings, including 80% nylon 20% spandex. On request it also supplies LYCRA Xtra Life, ECONYL recycled nylon, REPREVE recycled polyester and Italian Carvico.

items.title: Standard UPF evidence
items.text: Our [Swimwear Fabrics & Sourcing service](/swimwear-fabrics-sourcing/) provides documentation for UPF 50+ fabrics tested to Australia/New Zealand's AS/NZS 4399. The rating applies to the fabric when it's dry and relaxed.

items.title: Additional laboratory testing
items.text: Through [Swimwear Fabrics & Sourcing](/swimwear-fabrics-sourcing/) you can order wet/stretched tests, tests on selected colourways, or testing to EU EN 13758-1 or US AATCC 183. You pay the accredited lab's fees at cost.

sections.heading: Construction That Stays Put in the Water
sections.body: To stop floating and ride-up, we don't depend on a single fix. We combine the cut, hems, inner layers and elastic finishes.

items.title: Tunic float control
items.text: Elasticated or weighted hems, vents, a fitted inner layer and a close-cut waist keep the tunic from floating. Split or shaped hems stop it twisting around the legs during strokes.

items.title: Legging security
items.text: Stirrups or cuffs keep leggings from riding up. Leggings sold separately get a wide, encased waistband that doesn't roll while they're worn.

items.title: Elastic and adjustments
items.text: We control the elastic tension at the neck, cuffs and ankles and add silicone-backed elastic at the cuffs and ankles. Ties and drawcords stay within easy reach, and hoods are shaped to stay in place without pressing on the throat.

items.title: Detachable garment parts
items.text: Detachable sleeves and skirts fasten with resin snaps or concealed zips, and each fastening is attached at a reinforced point.

items.title: One-piece access
items.text: You can choose pull-on, full-length front zip, centre-back zip or half neck zip. Zipped styles have a fabric garage at the top and corrosion-resistant swim zips that work easily when wet.

items.title: Built-in light support
items.text: For light shaping, we add a shelf bra with wire-free, removable contour cups inside your tunic or swim dress.

items.title: Integrated lower lining
items.text: An inner brief or short in matching lining means the wearer doesn't need separate underlayers under the garment.

items.title: Loose coverage cuts
items.text: Loose tunics skim the body instead of hugging it. Putting the volume through the shoulders, bust and hips instead of the hem controls drag and keeps full coverage.

sections.heading: Size Ranges, Fit Blocks and Grading
sections.body:
Choose the classic or sport block based on how your customers swim. Your sales figures then show where petite, tall or curvy grading belongs.

| Fit or range | Sizes and grading |
|---|---|
| Classic block | S to 3XL. The size M legging has a 76 cm inseam, and the tunic has 4–6 cm of ease at the bust and hip. |
| Sport block | S to 4XL. The size M legging has a 76 cm inseam, and ease is 0–2 cm for a closer compression fit. |
| Adult inseam grading | Both blocks grade by 1 cm per size. |
| Children's sets | Ages 3 to 12 in five sizes: 3–4, 5–6, 7–8, 9–10 and 11–12 years. |
| Hijab sizing | Adult hijabs come in S/M and L/XL. Children's hijabs follow the set's age sizes. |
| Petite and tall | We adjust the legging inseam, tunic length, torso, hem sweep and slit position together, so the proportions match the regular lengths. |
| Plus-size collections | Our [custom plus-size collections](/plus-size-swimwear-manufacturer/) give you fully customisable styles, curvy fits and larger cup sizes. |

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions

qa.question: Does a complete two-piece or three-piece modest swim set count as one piece toward your 50-piece minimum, or is the minimum applied separately to each component?
qa.answer: If you sell a complete two-piece or three-piece set as one unit, it counts as one piece toward our minimum of 50 pieces per style in each colour. If you sell tunics, leggings and hijabs as separates, each one counts on its own. Decide on sets or separates before you order, because that choice sets your minimum quantities and how mixed sizes are packed.

qa.question: Will burkinis made to your spec be accepted at public pools that only allow swim-specific fabric and close-fitting garments?
qa.answer: Our burkinis use swim-specific nylon or polyester-spandex, with close-fitting leggings and a fitted inner layer in the tunic. They meet the swim-garment rules at most public pools, but not at every pool. For pools with stricter rules, we offer close-fitting mid-thigh tunics and chlorine-resistant fabric such as LYCRA Xtra Life. The fabric composition goes on the label so pool staff can check it.

qa.question: Can one retail set combine different tunic, legging and hijab sizes for customers whose measurements do not fit a single set size?
qa.answer: Yes. We cut each component separately, so your retail set can mix tunic, legging and hijab sizes. We make these to order or pack them from separates. Each set is packed together, and every piece carries its own label.

qa.question: Can you connect the tunic to the leggings to prevent separation in the water, and what attachment constructions can you offer?
qa.answer: Yes. We join them at the inner waist with concealed ties, fabric loops or low-profile resin snaps. Before bulk production, you approve the attachment position, holding strength and comfort on the complete sample set.

qa.question: Which hijab ties, hem weights and detachable fastenings do you modify or exclude from children's modest sets to reduce snagging and small-part risks?
