structured_data.name: Swimwear Packaging & Custom Brand Labels
structured_data.description: We finish your swimwear order with hang tags, garment labels, hygiene liners and bags, so every piece leaves our factory branded and ready to sell.

facts.text: We can finish your swimwear order with hang tags, garment labels, hygiene liners and bags, so each piece leaves our factory branded and ready to sell.

If you already have your own labels or packaging, we can attach them to your order and use them to pack the finished pieces. Your materials need to reach us before production starts so we can add them during the run.

Embroidered or more elaborate labels, logos pressed onto the fabric such as heat transfer or DTF, custom-printed bags, branded hang tags, rubber patches, gift bags and branded hygiene liners each raise the cost per piece, and we show each one as its own line on your quotation.

If you supply your own labels, hang tags and bags, send 3% extra of each to cover wastage, and make sure everything reaches our factory at least 7 days before the scheduled cutting date. We count and check them on arrival and report any shortages or defects to you within 3 business days, before cutting.
We manufacture swimwear ourselves in a single factory of our own in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China.

For new and established brands alike, we take custom bikinis and one-piece suits through a single full-package service, from your first brief to after-sales support. It begins with a consultation and design development, then tech pack and pattern creation, pattern adjustments, print development and placement, and sourcing of fabrics and trims from suppliers worldwide, with our technical advice at every step. Next come prototypes and full samples, a fit review, grading and pre-production samples. In bulk we handle precise cutting, sewing, printing or embroidery, washing, finishing and trimming, followed by label printing and private-label branding, quality control, retail-ready packaging and shipping to any destination, with logistics arranged by our in-house team. Every element can be customised, from fabric and silhouette to branded labels and packaging.
Production and export sit in one company that owns its factory, so quality, cost and delivery stay under our direct control.
Our production holds OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for tested fabrics and trims, GRS and RCS for recycled fabrics, bluesign for chemistry, ISO 9001 for quality management and WRAP for social compliance.
Our production uses water-saving, low-carbon processes, and our packaging follows carbon-neutral strategies.
The factory has been running since 2011.
Orders start at 50 pieces per style in each colour, a level set so that small and growing labels can order.
A first trial run is agreed case by case, and we are as flexible on its quantity as production allows.
A standard sample is ready in 10 to 15 days.
Each sample costs USD 50, and the design fee is USD 50 per design (its pattern or print, with all colourways); these fees are not refunded or credited against the bulk order.
Both OEM and ODM work is possible: a new style can start from your own design, a picture or just an idea.
An in-house design team handles pattern design, grading and fit development, which saves you rounds of back-and-forth on the design.

We make swimwear from nylon and polyester swimwear fabrics blended with spandex, such as 80% nylon 20% spandex, with matching linings. On request we source chlorine-resistant LYCRA Xtra Life, recycled nylon such as ECONYL, recycled polyester such as REPREVE, and Italian Carvico fabrics.
Quality is checked at every stage of an order: fabric on arrival, cutting, sewing, then random checks and a full final inspection.
You can contact our team by email, phone, WhatsApp, Zoom, Messenger, Skype or Viber, or through the contact form on this website.

We build your branding into the garments while they are being made. For labels you can choose woven main and neck labels, satin, cotton or transparent labels, stamped or printed labels, heat-transfer labels and silicone labels. Care, wash and size labels can also be woven, printed or heat-transferred. A heat-transfer care label leaves the suit tagless. Woven and printed labels are also available in recycled materials. If you want a logo on the finished piece, we can print it after the garment has been sewn.
Labelling is treated as an addition to the products you order and does not count towards the minimum order quantity.
For branded packaging, we can print your logo on zip-lock bags from 300 pcs, with a USD 35 screen fee. A printing screen for cotton drawstring bags also costs USD 35.

While we make your samples, we can develop your labels and packaging alongside them, including heat-transfer labels, hang tags, hygiene liners and gift bags, and we can make mockups for you to check. We review your prints, labels, hang tags and packaging during sampling and lock them in before bulk production. Settling the branding early can shorten the production schedule by several weeks.
Labels and hangtag accessories take 7 to 10 days to prepare.
We answer quote requests for screen printing, embroidery and labels within 24 business hours. Cut-and-sew or sublimation projects take up to 3 business days to quote.

We pack your swimwear in biodegradable bags made from corn starch, which we picked after trialling a range of biodegradable options. They are free of harmful chemicals and keep your pieces clean and intact in humid conditions for the whole time your stock sits in storage and on sale; once discarded, they break down in industrial composting facilities within about 180 days, but not in home compost or landfill. We also offer eco zip-lock bags in recyclable material with biodegradable cornstarch, which are waterproof and can be reused, and your logo can be printed on them.

Our corn-starch garment bags contain no conventional plastic: they are made from corn starch bound with a biodegradable PBAT polymer, at roughly 60% starch to 40% PBAT. Our eco zip-lock bags are the blended option, made from about 70% recyclable LDPE with 30% biodegradable cornstarch, which is why they belong in soft-plastic recycling rather than compost.

Our corn-starch garment bags come in 30 µm film in three standard sizes: 20 x 25 cm for bikini sets and swim bottoms, 25 x 35 cm for one-pieces and swim trunks, and 30 x 40 cm for cover-ups and kaftans. We can also cut custom sizes and switch to a heavier 50 µm film for padded pieces or retail programmes that require thicker bags.

On our corn-starch bags we print your logo in 1 or 2 Pantone-matched spot colours within an area of up to 15 x 15 cm per side, single-sided or double-sided. On our eco zip-lock bags we print in up to 3 Pantone-matched colours within an area of up to 18 x 20 cm per side, below the zip, also single-sided or double-sided.

We produce heat transfer labels in our own factory. These soft, tagless labels are heat-pressed with your logo directly onto the inside of each swimwear piece, so they sit comfortably against the skin. Even with proper care, the print can crack, flake or peel over time from chlorine, salt water, sun and repeated washing. You need this label for both your samples and your bulk production.

You can build your heat transfer label from one of our templates or supply your own artwork. All text must be larger than 5pt. Choose one of our standard shapes or have a shape made entirely to your design. Labels print in black or white. Send artwork as a vector file (AI, EPS or PDF) with every font outlined, or as a PNG on a transparent background at 300dpi or higher. Tell us the print width in centimetres, and send your size guide as a separate file.

We can produce inside heat transfer labels from a minimum of 2 x 1 cm up to a maximum of 8 x 6 cm finished size. Within that range, you choose the exact width in centimetres, as long as all text stays larger than 5pt.

We have tested heat transfer labels on swimwear and activewear fabrics and recommend them for all of them except textured swim fabrics, including textured recycled-nylon types. For textured fabrics, please choose a different label option.

For custom prints, branding and branded trims, just send your artwork as a 300 dpi file. All-over prints should repeat cleanly and be drawn to scale, and we adjust the repeat, scale and placement to suit each style.

Our DTF labels are made from PVC resin combined with plasticizer resin, so they last longer than heat transfer labels. We match colours to your Pantone references, and DTF is usually placed on the outside of the fabric.
We have tested DTF and recommend it for all flat swimwear and activewear fabrics, but not for textured fabrics.
We can produce DTF at any size up to 35 x 10.7 cm (13.8 x 4.2 in). A DTF sample takes us 2-3 days.

DTF film stretches much less than swim fabric, so a large solid logo stiffens the area underneath and can lift or crack where the suit stretches most. To keep a close fit, we limit solid DTF areas to 8 x 8 cm on stretch zones, turn larger artwork into outline or open designs with gaps of at least 1 mm, and place logos on lower-stretch areas such as the hip, centre back or leg hem.

Our heat transfer labels are the thinner, softer option at about 0.1 mm and move with the fabric, which is why we place them inside against the skin. DTF is thicker at about 0.2 to 0.3 mm and slightly firmer and less stretchy, but it lasts longer and carries Pantone-matched colour, so we use it on the outside of flat fabrics.

Embroidery works dependably on our standard nylon and polyester spandex blends from 180 gsm upward, for example 80% nylon 20% spandex. It also works on our recycled and chlorine-resistant swim fabrics and on lined or double-layer areas. We always stitch over a stretch stabiliser so the thread moves with the fabric, and we cover the back with a soft facing on the skin side. We place designs in low-stretch areas such as the leg hem or waistband, not in high-stretch zones, where embroidery tends to pucker. On light fabrics below 150 gsm and on mesh, ribbed or crinkle textures, we keep designs to outline or light-fill logos no wider than 5 cm. As an alternative, we can embroider onto a patch or a lined panel. Before sampling, we do a test stitch-out on your fabric.

Our hang tags come in 6 shapes and are made from paper or recycled stock. They are available in black or white, finished in gloss or matte. We print them with your logo and brand details, and they can also carry your brand story and QR codes.

Our 6 hang-tag shapes are a 5 x 9 cm rectangle, a 4 x 10 cm slim rectangle, a 6 x 6 cm square, a 6 x 6 cm rounded-corner square, a 6 cm circle and a 5 x 8 cm oval. We print them on 350gsm, 400gsm or 600gsm paper board, or on 350gsm or 400gsm recycled stock.

Rings, sliders, hooks, clasps and stoppers can carry your logo; each custom item has a mold development fee of USD 200, and its unit price is set according to the design. Resin O-rings start at 100 pieces per colour, and metal tags with your logo or an embossed label start at 100 pieces.
Our eco kraft paper hygiene liners come in 5 shapes and can carry your branding on orders above 3,000 units. We make a digital mockup at no charge.
Our plastic hygiene liners come in 5 shapes and can be custom branded on orders above 3,000 units. We include a digital mockup at no charge.
Our recycled-content hygiene liner is made from 90% recycled materials and comes in 3 shapes. Its water-resistant adhesive comes off without leaving residue. This liner can't be custom branded.

Our kraft paper and plastic liners come in 5 shapes: thong (12 x 3.5 cm, tapered) for narrow thong and Brazilian cuts, kids (9 x 4 cm) for children's bottoms, standard bikini (14 x 5 cm), full coverage (16 x 6.5 cm) for high-waist and one-piece styles, and wide (15 x 7.5 cm) for boy shorts and fuller-coverage bottoms. Our recycled-content liner comes in 3 of these shapes: thong, standard bikini and full coverage.

Our plastic liners hold more firmly during humid storage, because the film does not absorb moisture, and they peel away from swimwear linings cleanly in one piece. Kraft paper liners hold well in normal warehouse conditions, but above about 70% humidity the paper can soften and curl at the edges and may tear when peeled after 6 months, so for stock kept long-term in humid climates we suggest plastic liners.

Our liner adhesive is a low-tack, pressure-sensitive type. Every adhesive we use holds well on the nylon-spandex, polyester-spandex and recycled-nylon linings in our swimwear. We do not advise it on cotton, open mesh or brushed linings. For mesh, crochet, velvet, sequinned or coated surfaces, we suggest a sewn-in gusset instead. In normal storage a liner stays in place for up to 12 months and then peels away cleanly without marking or damaging the fabric. Storing it longer, or above 40°C, can leave adhesive behind on the lining. During sampling we peel-test the liner on your own fabric. This confirms that it lies flat through 8 hours of wear and comes off in one piece, without residue, pilling or colour lift.

A typical order moves from your brief or tech pack to a sample in 10 to 15 days, then to your approval and deposit, 35 to 40 days of bulk production depending on size and season, a full final inspection, and shipment on FOB, CIF or DDP terms.
Once the sample is approved and the deposit received, bulk production usually needs 35 to 40 days, depending on order size and season.
We take a 50% deposit when the order is confirmed, and the remaining 50% is paid before shipment.
Shipments go out on FOB, CIF or DDP terms; DDP is available worldwide, and under DDP one all-in price covers delivery to your door, with duties, customs and freight handled by us.
Independent inspectors such as SGS or BV are welcome to check the goods before they ship.
Courier delivery of samples costs USD 50, paid by the buyer in addition to the sample fee.

Before returning anything, you must get a written return authorization number from us, and we will refuse any package or carton that does not show this number. Authorized returns are charged a 20% restocking fee, with return freight billed separately on top of it. We cannot take back goods that have been altered in any way, such as by screen printing, embroidery, relabelling, washing, dyeing or embellishment. Samples cannot be returned.

Our corn-starch bags are biodegradable and are our compostable option: they break down in industrial composting facilities within about 180 days, but not in home compost or landfill. Our eco zip-lock bags with biodegradable cornstarch are recyclable wherever soft-plastic (LDPE 4) collection is accepted. We supply the material supplier's data for both bags, which covers the bag material rather than the printed finished pack. Disposal claims printed on your packaging, such as 'compostable' or 'recyclable', must follow the rules of your market, and we print only wording you have approved in writing.

Kept sealed in their cartons below 30°C and out of direct sunlight, our corn-starch bags stay strong, clear and suitable for sale for 12 months from production, so plan to sell through your stock within that window. Long exposure to heat above 40°C or to direct sun shortens that life and can make the film brittle or tacky, so we produce the bags for each order close to its shipment date.

Yes, we can print a suffocation warning on any of our bags in the languages you choose, in type of at least 10pt, and for Amazon FBA we make the bags in our 50 µm (about 2 mil) film, clear enough for barcodes to scan through and with the warning on every bag with an opening of 12.7 cm (5 in) or wider. For other retailers, we match the bag thickness, warning text and label placement to the packaging manual you send us.

On dark, bright or sublimated fabrics, we print white labels over an anti-migration blocker layer that stops dye from bleeding into the print, and press them at a lower temperature of about 130°C. We check each fabric with a pressed strike-off before bulk, and if any dye still shows through, we switch that label to black.

For textured, ribbed or crinkle swim fabrics, we recommend an embroidered label placed on a low-stretch area such as the waistband or leg hem, or a heat transfer label pressed onto the smooth inner lining rather than the textured outer fabric. For men's and boys' swim trunks, a sewn-on rubber patch is a third option.

We attach hang tags with a cotton or recycled-polyester string or a ribbon tie looped around a strap or through the care label, so nothing pierces the swim fabric. If you prefer a plastic fastener or safety pin, we put it only through the sewn-in care label or a seam allowance, never through the body fabric, using a fine 1 mm needle to avoid snags.

pages.h1: Custom Swimwear Printing with In-House Sublimation
pages.hero_lead: We print every design on our own industrial digital machines in Guangzhou, so you get a short turnaround and can combine several designs in one production run.

sections.heading: Custom Swimwear Prints Made in Our Own Facility
sections.body: Every swimwear design we print goes through our own facility, so we control each stage and keep your turnaround short. We run industrial digital machines with a sublimation process tuned specifically for printing swimwear fabric. If you have several designs, you can combine them in one production run, and we'll prepare them together.

sections.heading: Factory-Direct Sublimation Printing from Guangzhou
sections.body: Your swimwear is made in our own factory in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China. Because we run a [factory-owned production and export operation](/about-us/), quality, cost and delivery stay under our control. We check your order throughout production and give it a full final inspection. Our [Launch service](/swimwear-launch-services/) covers your project from brief to after-sales support. For [quote requests](/request-a-quote/) covering screen printing, embroidery and labels, you'll hear back within one business day. Cut-and-sew or sublimation quotes take up to 3 business days. Every [enquiry](/contact-us/) gets a reply within one business day.

sections.heading: Printable Swim Fabrics, Including Recycled Options
sections.body: We begin with the colour result and handfeel you need, then match the printing method to the fibre.

items.title: Polyester print bases
items.text: We print full-colour sublimation on durable 100% polyester, performance blends and poly-blends.

items.title: Recycled sublimation microfibre
items.text: We print with eco-friendly ink on a 150 g/m² microfibre made of 86% recycled polyester and 14% elastane. Recycled microfibre is also available for shorts.

items.title: Other recycled options
items.text: You can choose recycled polyamide/elastane swim fabric, performance fabric for swim fit or super-soft recycled nylon. Nylon is printed with digital pigment printing.

items.title: Your supplied fabric
items.text: We accept nylon or polyester blends with spandex. Sublimation requires polyester, and nylon requires digital pigment printing.

items.title: Base fabric requirements
items.text: The base you send must be white or light, with no water-repellent, silicone or other coated finish.

items.title: Testing before cutting
items.text: Before we cut your supplied fabric, we test it for shrinkage, colour fastness and stretch.

items.title: Fabric sourcing
items.text: Our [fabric sourcing](/swimwear-fabrics-sourcing/) covers nylon/spandex and polyester/spandex with matching linings, including 80% nylon 20% spandex. It also covers chlorine-resistant LYCRA Xtra Life, ECONYL recycled nylon, REPREVE recycled polyester and Italian Carvico on request.

sections.heading: Certified Inks That Resist Chlorine, Salt and Fading
sections.body: If your swimwear will be used often in the pool or the sea, we sublimate onto polyester-rich fabric so the print lasts.

items.title: Certified printing inks
items.text: Every print uses ecological inks certified under OEKO-TEX® ECO PASSPORT, along with OEKO-TEX® certified dyes.

items.title: Water-based dyes
items.text: Our dyes are water-based, non-toxic and free from harmful chemicals. They bond into the fibres instead of leaving a thick layer on the surface.

items.title: Lasting print quality
items.text: Our high-resolution sublimation prints are chlorine-proof and stand up to salt water and repeated washing without cracking, peeling or fading.

items.title: Production certifications
items.text: Our [sustainability certifications](/sustainability/) are OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for tested fabrics/trims, GRS/RCS for recycled fabrics, bluesign for chemistry, ISO 9001 for quality management and WRAP for social compliance.

sections.heading: Artwork Files, Repeats and Design Support
sections.body:
Send your artwork at 300 dpi or higher, as vector files such as AI or PDF or as image files such as PNG or TIFF. We accept other formats too. Your artwork needs a seamless repeat or a layout that's ready to repeat. A motif repeat is typically 15–20 cm, but your design doesn't have to match that size. If you have a non-repeating image that works for it, we help you set it up as a four-way mirror.

We check the repeat seams and scale at actual garment size. If there's a tiling problem, our design team fixes it instead of sending the file back to you. You can send print-ready artwork or develop it with us, and our file-setup guidance is free.

sections.heading: Placement Prints and Layout on Every Style

items.title: Placement instead of repeat
items.text: If your artwork doesn't repeat, or a motif has to sit in one exact spot, we offer placement printing.

items.title: Artwork layout options
items.text: You can choose front and back prints, sleeve branding, full-wrap graphics and gradient fades.

items.title: Consistency across sizes
items.text: We engineer the placement on each size's cut pattern pieces, so your motifs sit in the same visual position across your whole size range.

sections.heading: Pantone Colour Matching for Your Prints
sections.body: We match your colours to a picture you send, to our colour chart or to Pantone references. For sublimation calibration, we prefer a physical Pantone TCX reference over TPG. You confirm the colour on a sample of the actual production fabric in daylight, so you aren't judging the result on a screen.

sections.heading: Mock-ups, Strike-offs and Sample Approval

items.title: Scale and trial print
items.text: We send you digital mock-ups so you can approve the scale, and we turn strike-offs around in one day. We then send a 30x30cm trial-print swatch so you can approve colour and quality, and we revise it as needed.

items.title: A4 approval options
items.text: The fastest option is an A4 strike-off that we photograph or film and email to you, at USD 35 per motif. If you want the same A4 posted to you, it costs USD 35 plus courier.

items.title: Printed fabric checks
items.text: If you need to check drape or stretch, two metres cost USD 35 per metre (USD 70) plus courier. This adds a few extra weeks.

items.title: Sample and design fees
items.text: Standard samples take 10 to 15 days and cost USD 50 each. Design costs USD 50 per design, and that covers all colourways. Neither fee is refunded or credited towards your bulk order.

items.title: Sampling and reorder terms
items.text: Under our [sampling terms](/faq/), you pay the courier, which costs USD 50. New moulds or prints add 2 to 3 weeks. Approved reorders skip sampling, and you're welcome to arrange independent SGS or BV inspections.

items.title: Development service timing
items.text: With [Development](/development/), fabric and trims take 1 to 3 days, cards and swatches reach you within 10 days, and fit approval takes 3 to 7 days. Digital samples add about one week, and revisions add more time.

sections.heading: Print Lead Times, Pricing and Order Terms

items.title: Lower-cost repeat printing
items.text: On larger runs, an all-over seamless repeat on standard print fabric keeps your costs down.

items.title: Higher-cost print treatments
items.text: Exclusive development, a placement setup for each size, and specialty metallic or fluorescent inks all cost more. Keep these treatments for your hero styles to control costs.

items.title: Premium fabric costs
items.text: Branded and recycled print fabrics cost more than our standard print fabric choices.

items.title: Bulk production timing
items.text: Once you've approved the sample and we've received your deposit, bulk production takes 35 to 40 days. Order size and season set where it falls in that range, and approved repeat orders follow the same timing.

items.title: Payment schedule
items.text: You pay a 50% deposit when you confirm the order and the remaining 50% before it ships.

items.title: Shipping terms
items.text: We ship your finished order on FOB, CIF or DDP terms, and DDP is available worldwide.

items.title: Door delivery pricing
items.text: With DDP, you pay one all-in price for delivery to your door, and we handle the duties, customs and freight.

items.title: Returns
items.text: Claims and returns on printed orders follow our [terms and conditions](/terms-and-conditions/).

sections.heading: Print Themes and Exclusive Print Development

items.title: Print theme choices
items.text: We source nearly any colour or print for your digital-printed range, including floral, paisley, retro, zigzag, animal, strawberry, lemon and watercolour themes.

items.title: Exclusive print development
items.text: We develop exclusive prints just for you, and this adds lead time. The per-design fee covers developing the print in all colourways, plus its tech pack and CAD pattern.

items.title: Colourways for later seasons
items.text: If you develop one exclusive print and add colourways later, you don't pay a new design fee. Physical strike-offs and printed approval fabric are still charged separately for each motif.

sections.heading: Minimum Order Quantities and Trial Runs
sections.body: Orders start at 50 pieces per style in each colour, so small and growing labels have a quantity they can start with. We agree your first trial run case by case, and we can flex on quantity only as far as production allows.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions

qa.question: For your digital printing, do the number of artwork colours or the amount of printed coverage change the production cost?
qa.answer: The number of colours doesn't change your digital printing cost, because every design prints in one pass at the same rate. Coverage does matter when you compare print types. We cost all-over prints by the metre of fabric, and a small placement print on a plain piece costs less than printing the whole garment.

qa.question: Can you print on a black or coloured base fabric, or does my print have to go on white fabric?
qa.answer: We print on black or coloured bases, but sublimation only produces tones darker than the base. All-over sublimation needs a polyester-rich fabric. Its dyes are transparent, so they give the truest colours on white or light bases and can't print lighter than the fabric. For white or pastel details, we use a white base, or digital pigment printing with a white underlayer on dark fabric.

qa.question: Can I order custom-printed swimwear fabric from you without ordering garment manufacturing?
qa.answer: No. We only offer custom printing on swimwear we manufacture for you, and we don't take fabric-only orders. Any printed fabric we produce ships with your garment order.

structured_data.name: Custom Swimwear Printing with In-House Sublimation
structured_data.description: Every swimwear design we print goes through our own facility, so we control each stage and keep your turnaround short.
structured_data.serviceType: Custom Swimwear Printing with In-House Sublimation

facts.text: Printed swimwear is one of our core services, and hundreds of brands come to us to add new prints to their collections. We carry out every print in our own facility, so we control each step ourselves and can keep your turnaround short.

Your designs are printed on modern, high-end industrial digital printing machines, using a sublimation process tuned specifically for swimwear fabrics so that the ink bonds directly into the fibres instead of sitting on the surface.
You can put several different designs into the same production run, and we prepare all of them together.
We manufacture swimwear ourselves in a single factory of our own in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China.
Production and export sit in one company that owns its factory, so quality, cost and delivery stay under our direct control.

For new and established brands alike, we take custom bikinis and one-piece suits through a single full-package service, from your first brief to after-sales support. It begins with a consultation and design development, then tech pack and pattern creation, pattern adjustments, print development and placement, and sourcing of fabrics and trims from suppliers worldwide, with our technical advice at every step. Next come prototypes and full samples, a fit review, grading and pre-production samples. In bulk we handle precise cutting, sewing, printing or embroidery, washing, finishing and trimming, followed by label printing and private-label branding, quality control, retail-ready packaging and shipping to any destination, with logistics arranged by our in-house team. Every element can be customised, from fabric and silhouette to branded labels and packaging.
We answer quote requests for screen printing, embroidery and labels within 24 business hours. Cut-and-sew or sublimation projects take up to 3 business days to quote.
We reply to every enquiry within one business day.
You can contact our team by email, phone, WhatsApp, Zoom, Messenger, Skype or Viber, or through the contact form on this website.

We supply sublimation-ready swim fabrics for printing. These include durable polyester qualities designed for digital sublimation, which keep the colour permanently locked deep inside the yarns, and we offer full-colour sublimation on 100% polyester as well as performance blends and poly-blends.

For sublimation prints, we use digital sublimation with eco-friendly ink on a 150 g/m² recycled microfibre made of 86% recycled polyester and 14% elastane. For sustainable collections, we can also print on recycled swim fabrics: a swim fabric of recycled polyamide and elastane, a performance fabric for swim fit, and a super-soft recycled nylon. Recycled microfibre is also available as a print fabric for shorts.

We print on fabric you supply if it is a nylon or polyester blend with spandex. Sublimation needs polyester fabric and nylon is printed with digital pigment, the base should be white or light and free of water-repellent, silicone or other coated finishes, and we test it for shrinkage, colour fastness and stretch before cutting.

We make swimwear from nylon and polyester swimwear fabrics blended with spandex, such as 80% nylon 20% spandex, with matching linings. On request we source chlorine-resistant LYCRA Xtra Life, recycled nylon such as ECONYL, recycled polyester such as REPREVE, and Italian Carvico fabrics.
For every print we use ecological inks certified under OEKO-TEX® ECO PASSPORT, along with OEKO-TEX® certified dyes. Our dyes are water-based, non-toxic and free from harmful chemicals.

Our sublimation prints are high-resolution and chlorine-proof. The dye bonds into the fibre, so no thick ink layer sits on the surface. Your prints also hold up in salt water and do not crack, peel or fade, even after repeated washing.
Our production holds OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for tested fabrics and trims, GRS and RCS for recycled fabrics, bluesign for chemistry, ISO 9001 for quality management and WRAP for social compliance.
Please send high-resolution artwork of at least 300 dpi. We accept vector files (AI, EPS, SVG, PDF), raster files such as JPG, PNG, TIFF and PSD, and other formats as well.

Your artwork should be a seamless repeat or set up to repeat. Most motifs repeat every 15–20 cm, but not all of them do. If an image can't repeat, we can often mirror it four ways, and we'll help you set this up.
You can send us print-ready artwork or develop your designs with our in-house design team. We also give you free guidance on setting up your files.

For artwork that can't repeat, or that has to sit in a specific spot on the swimwear, we offer placement prints. Your options include front and back prints, sleeve branding, full-wrap graphics and gradient fades.

We match colours to a picture you send, to our own colour chart or to Pantone references. For Pantone we prefer TCX to TPG, and we use those references to calibrate our sublimation printing. We recommend confirming the result on a sample.
A standard sample is ready in 10 to 15 days.
Each sample costs USD 50, and the design fee is USD 50 per design (its pattern or print, with all colourways); these fees are not refunded or credited against the bulk order.

For prints, we first send you digital mockups so you can approve the scale. We can turn strike-offs around in one day. Then we send a 30x30cm trial-print swatch so you can approve the colours and check the quality, and we revise it if needed.

Strike-off options: the fastest way to approve is an A4 strike-off that we photograph or film and email to you, at USD 35 per motif. We can also post the same A4 strike-off to you for USD 35 plus courier. If you need two metres of printed fabric for approval, the cost is USD 35 per metre (USD 70) plus courier, and this adds a few extra weeks.
Courier delivery of samples costs USD 50, paid by the buyer in addition to the sample fee.

Sampling time depends on how complex the design is, whether the fabric is available and how many adjustments are needed. We confirm your development timeline once we have reviewed the design. Confirming fabric and trims takes 1 to 3 days, and colour cards and print swatches are ready within 10 days. Reviewing the fit and approving the sample takes 3 to 7 days. A digitally printed sample needs about one more week, and each revision adds further time.
Most partnerships begin with samples so quality can be judged first, and the bulk order follows once they are approved.
Once the sample is approved and the deposit received, bulk production usually needs 35 to 40 days, depending on order size and season.

A typical order moves from your brief or tech pack to a sample in 10 to 15 days, then to your approval and deposit, 35 to 40 days of bulk production depending on size and season, a full final inspection, and shipment on FOB, CIF or DDP terms.
We take a 50% deposit when the order is confirmed, and the remaining 50% is paid before shipment.
Shipments go out on FOB, CIF or DDP terms; DDP is available worldwide, and under DDP one all-in price covers delivery to your door, with duties, customs and freight handled by us.

A seamless all-over pattern that tiles across the fabric keeps costs down on larger runs, while exclusive prints we develop just for you, placement prints set up per size and specialty metallic or fluorescent inks cost more. Branded or recycled print fabrics also raise the price.

Repeat orders of approved styles skip sampling and go straight into bulk production, which takes the same 35 to 40 days after your deposit as a first bulk order, depending on order size and season. A first order also includes 10 to 15 days of sampling, and any style that needs a new mould or print needs an extra 2 to 3 weeks.

Before returning anything, you must get a written return authorization number from us, and we will refuse any package or carton that does not show this number. Authorized returns are charged a 20% restocking fee, with return freight billed separately on top of it. We cannot take back goods that have been altered in any way, such as by screen printing, embroidery, relabelling, washing, dyeing or embellishment. Samples cannot be returned.

For custom designs we can source nearly any colour or print, and we offer digital printing for your swimwear range. Available print themes include floral, paisley, retro, zigzag, animal, strawberry, lemon and watercolour. We can also develop exclusive prints and patterns just for you, though these cost more and add to the lead time.

Exclusive print development is covered by the per-design fee, which includes developing the print in all colourways along with the tech pack and CAD pattern we prepare for it, and adding a new colourway later needs no new design fee. Physical strike-offs and printed fabric for print approval are charged separately per motif.
Orders start at 50 pieces per style in each colour, a level set so that small and growing labels can order.
A first trial run is agreed case by case, and we are as flexible on its quantity as production allows.

With our digital printing, the number of colours in your artwork does not change the cost, because every design prints in a single pass at the same rate. Coverage matters only between print types: an all-over print is costed by the fabric metre, while a small placement print on a plain piece costs less than covering the whole garment.

Our all-over sublimation prints go on polyester-rich fabric and show the truest colours on white or light bases, because sublimation dyes are transparent and cannot print lighter than the base. On black or coloured bases we can print tones darker than the base, so for designs with white or pastel areas we print on white fabric or use digital pigment printing with a white underlayer.
We supply custom printing only for swimwear we manufacture for you, so we don't sell printed fabric on its own. Any printed fabric we produce ships with that garment order.

pages.meta_description: Get rust-resistant swimwear hardware in custom colours with your logo, tested for chlorine, salt water and UV, with placement locked in through sampling.
pages.h1: Swimwear Hardware: Rings, Sliders, Clasps and Custom Logo Parts
pages.hero_lead: For adjustable straps, removable straps and closures, we supply sliders with matching rings and metal hooks in the same sizes, plus rust-resistant D-rings and O-rings.

sections.heading: Swimwear Hardware for Every Strap and Closure
sections.body: We supply swimwear sliders with matching rings and metal hooks in the same sizes, for adjustable straps, removable straps and closures. Our metal rings run from 6 mm to 50 mm: 6 mm, 8 mm, 10 mm, 12 mm, 15 mm, 19 mm, 25 mm, 32 mm, 44 mm and 50 mm. You can also choose rust-resistant D-rings and O-rings, decorative buckles, grommets, stoppers, resin O-rings and metal tags. We also supply hook and eye sets, front clasps, snap buttons, plastic buckles and magnetic closures.

visuals.purpose: Shows the full span of metal ring sizes available, from the smallest to the largest.

sections.heading: Swimwear Hardware Types, Sizes and Materials
sections.body:
We size strap hardware by its inner opening and the finished width of your strap. Resin O-rings are sized differently, by band thickness and outer diameter.

| Hardware | Sizes, materials and selection |
|---|---|
| Strap sizing | A 15 mm metal ring fits a 15 mm strap. Sliders, hooks and front clasps are measured the same way, by inner opening. |
| Front clasp sizes | You can get all three types in 20 mm, 25 mm and 32 mm. |
| Type 1 clasp | The hook-in sides drop together, so triangle and bralette tops under light tension fasten quickly. |
| Type 2 clasp | The interlocking sides slide together and lock. This gives the firmest hold, for bandeau, underwire and larger-cup tops. |
| Type 3 clasp | A push-in spring catch releases with one squeeze. It suits one-piece front closures and decorative centre fronts. |
| Clasp finishes | Types 1 and 2 come in gold, silver, gunmetal or rose gold, in gloss or matte. Type 3 comes in gloss gold or silver. |
| Resin O-rings | Made from resin and pre-polymer, in 4.5 mm and 5 mm band thicknesses and 4 cm and 5.5 cm outer diameters. Colours are coffee, tea brown or milky white. |
| Metal end stoppers | 4 x 14 mm, for straps and ties. |
| Branded metal tags | 18 x 6 x 1.2 mm or 36 x 6.5 x 2 mm, in gold or silver. |
| Plastic buckles | Made from POM, in 10, 15, 20 and 25 mm. |
| Snap buttons | Nickel-free brass or POM, in 10, 12 and 15 mm. |
| Hook and eye sets | Nickel-free zinc alloy or stainless steel, in 10, 15 and 20 mm. |
| Magnetic closures | Neodymium magnets sealed inside nickel-free metal casings, in 10, 14 and 18 mm. |
| Moulded plastic range | We injection-mould buckles, sliders, rings and stoppers from POM (acetal) or nylon 66. Colours are black, white, clear or Pantone-dyed, and surfaces are gloss, matte or frosted. |

sections.heading: Our Own Factory in Guangzhou
sections.body: We make swimwear in our own factory, a single site in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China. Through our [factory ownership and production controls](/about-us/), one company handles production, export, quality, cost and delivery, and we run checks throughout each order. Our in-house [OEM and ODM development](/development/) takes your design, picture or idea through patterns, grading and fit, so there's less design back-and-forth. Our [swimwear fabric sourcing](/swimwear-fabrics-sourcing/) supplies the fabrics your hardware is fitted to.

items.label: Cutting

sections.heading: Metals, Plating and Surface Finishes

items.title: Default metal
items.text: Our rings, sliders, hooks, buckles, clasps, stoppers and tags are made from high-grade zinc alloy. They're electroplated in nickel-free gold or silver, with no chrome or lead.

items.title: Forming and preparation
items.text: We die-cast zinc alloy rings, sliders and clasps in steel moulds and stamp flat tags from sheet. Then we deburr, tumble and polish the parts before plating and anti-rust coating.

items.title: Water protection
items.text: Our anti-rust topcoat stops seawater and pool chlorine from causing corrosion, rust, tarnishing, pitting or fabric stains. We test every piece for long-term wear.

items.title: Stainless steel grades
items.text: If you want stainless steel instead, you can specify grade 304 for general use or marine-grade 316L for long exposure to seawater and chlorinated pools.

items.title: Brass alternatives
items.text: For brass, we offer lead-free H62 brass with 62% copper and 38% zinc, or H65 with 65% copper and 35% zinc.

items.title: Skin-contact testing
items.text: We test every metal grade against the EN 1811 nickel-release limit. If you need hypoallergenic trims, we specify nickel-free plating tested to EN 1811.

items.title: Colours and surfaces
items.text: Rings, sliders, hooks and stoppers come in gold, silver, rose gold or gunmetal, each in gloss or matte, with a polished, brushed or powder-coated surface.

items.title: Production credentials
items.text: Our [sustainability credentials](/sustainability/) include OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for tested fabrics and trims, GRS and RCS for recycled fabrics, bluesign for chemistry, ISO 9001 for quality management and WRAP for social compliance.

sections.heading: Custom Colours and Logo Branding on Metal Parts

items.title: Colour selection
items.text: We give you Pantone references for most hardware items, and larger orders qualify for custom colour matching to your palette.

items.title: Logo application
items.text: We engrave or emboss your logo on metal buckles, sliders and charms. We check your artwork against each part before we develop the mould.

items.title: Small-part artwork
items.text: On stoppers and sliders, your logo needs to be at least 3 mm high, with lines at least 0.3 mm wide. Below that size, we use initials or a monogram instead of detailed artwork so the mark stays sharp after plating.

items.title: Physical approval samples
items.text: Logo or custom-colour hardware samples take about 15 to 20 days after you approve the artwork. Standard parts colour-matched to your fabric take 7 to 10 days.

items.title: Bulk release
items.text: We start bulk hardware only after you sign off the sample. If you ask, we fit the approved parts onto your garment sample.

items.title: Garment branding service
items.text: Our [Swimwear Packaging & Custom Brand Labels service](/swimwear-packaging-custom-brand-labels/) supplies standard heat-transfer labels with your logo, care and size information, along with hygiene liners and hang tags. You can also add woven labels, silicone logos, fabric tags, logo cards and branded packaging.

sections.heading: Pull Strength, Cycle and Temperature Ratings
sections.body:
Our force and cycle ratings apply to the part on its own. Once the closure is sewn into your garment sample, we check again that it holds.

| Check | Rating or requirement |
|---|---|
| Hook-and-eye closures | Hold 3–5 kg of pull force; metal rings and front clasps hold 8–10 kg. |
| Snap closures | Rated for more than 1,000 open-and-close cycles. |
| Closure temperatures | Withstand -20°C to 60°C. |
| Children's swimwear service | Our [children's swimwear requirements](/children-s-swimwear-manufacturer/) cover sewn or riveted trims that pass 90 N, no removable decorations for under-3s, and no hanging charms, glued or heat-fixed stones or swallowable beads. Patches and appliqués are fully edge-stitched, nickel is tested to EN 1811, and lead stays within CPSIA limits of 100 ppm in base metal and 90 ppm in coatings. Accredited testing specific to your order is optional and charged at cost. |

sections.heading: Choosing and Fitting Hardware to Your Design

items.title: Mark your design
items.text: Send us a sketch, photo or tech pack showing where each piece of hardware goes, the finished strap width, and whether the part carries load or is decorative.

items.title: Select the hardware
items.text: We recommend the type, size and placement for your style, balancing function, appearance and budget.

items.title: Secure strap fittings
items.text: During production, we loop rings and sliders onto the strap ends, then fold the fabric back, stitch it and bar-tack it.

items.title: Reinforce closure positions
items.text: We sew hooks and clasps into reinforced fabric channels, and we press or rivet snaps through reinforced layers.

items.title: Prepare grommet supports
items.text: We back each hole with fused interfacing or double fabric that extends 10 mm around it. We place grommets at least 15 mm from seams and edges and press them in with matching washers.

items.title: Test before bulk
items.text: Before bulk production begins, we pull-test the fitted grommets on your garment sample at 70 N.

sections.heading: Costing, Sampling and Checks on Supplied Hardware

items.title: Supplied-part checks
items.text: Send us 2 pieces of each item. Before we accept your bulk hardware, we check fit, chlorine resistance and salt-water resistance on your actual sample fabric.

items.title: Bulk trim arrival
items.text: Ship your hardware with 3% extra so it reaches our factory at least 7 days before scheduled cutting. We plan cutting around when it arrives.

items.title: Our hardware supply
items.text: We supply our own hardware as part of garment production, or separately at the applicable hardware minimums.

items.title: Standard sample timing
items.text: Once we agree on price, we prepare a standard sample in 10 to 15 days.

items.title: Sample and design fees
items.text: Each sample costs USD 50. Design costs USD 50 per design, which covers its pattern or print and all its colourways. Neither fee is refunded or credited.

items.title: Delivery and inspection
items.text: Under our [sample delivery and inspection terms](/faq/), you pay USD 50 for sample courier delivery on top of sampling fees. Independent pre-shipment inspectors, including SGS or BV, are welcome.

items.title: Costing before sampling
items.text: Through our [quotation process](/request-a-quote/), choosing components takes about a week, or longer when it depends on suppliers. We then calculate your garment and bulk requirements and costs, and sampling starts once we agree on price.

sections.heading: Minimum Orders, Lead Times, Payment and Shipping

items.title: Garment order minimum
items.text: Your garment order starts at 50 pieces per style in each colour, which suits small and growing labels.

items.title: First trial run
items.text: We agree your first-trial quantity case by case. How flexible we can be depends on production requirements.

items.title: Bulk production timing
items.text: Once you approve the sample and we receive your deposit, bulk production takes 35 to 40 days. Order size and season decide where in that range your order falls.

items.title: Payment stages
items.text: You pay a 50% deposit when you confirm the order and the remaining 50% before we ship.

items.title: Shipping terms
items.text: We ship on FOB, CIF or worldwide DDP terms. With DDP, one all-in price covers door delivery, duties, customs and freight.

items.title: Enquiry response
items.text: We reply to every [enquiry](/contact-us/) within one business day, so you know when our answer will arrive.

sections.heading: Trims, Hardware Minimums and Logo Mould Fees

items.title: Starting with stock
items.text: As a new brand, you keep your starting order simpler with stock hardware. If you add logos to one or two signature parts, the custom minimums and mould fees below apply.

items.title: Supporting swimwear trims
items.text: We also supply power mesh, adjustable bra straps, decorative braided cords and chlorine-resistant elastic. Our nylon/spandex or polyester straps and elastics range from 3 mm to 25 mm. They recover at least 95% after 100 cycles and withstand more than 200 hours of chlorine exposure.

items.title: Standard hardware minimums
items.text: Standard hardware starts at 100 to 500 pieces per colour or size, depending on the item. Resin O-rings start at 100 pieces per colour.

items.title: Custom hardware minimums
items.text: Logo or embossed stoppers, clasps, hooks, sliders and rings, along with special finishes, start at 1,000 pieces per item. Logo or embossed metal tags start at 100 pieces.

items.title: Mould development charges
items.text: Each custom logo ring, slider, hook, clasp or stopper carries a USD 200 mould development fee. Its design sets the unit price.

items.title: Exclusive mould ownership
items.text: Once you've paid, your logo mould belongs only to you. We store it free for 2 years after your last order, reuse it with no further mould fee and ship it to you whenever you ask.

items.title: Stock and samples
items.text: Stock hardware is ready in 3 to 7 days. Sample sets cover most items, and you can get physical samples once you've browsed our catalogue.

items.title: Hardware shipment checks
items.text: Our hardware complies with OEKO-TEX and international swimwear safety standards, and we quality-check every item before it ships.

sections.heading: Quality Control and Hardware Testing

items.title: Mechanical durability
items.text: We test clasps, rings and other hardware for stretch and durability before they go into your production.

items.title: Exposure resistance
items.text: Our corrosion testing for swimwear hardware covers chlorine resistance, salt spray and UV exposure.

items.title: Relevant test reports
items.text: We send reports on request. Your report needs to cover the exact material and finish you ordered, not just the product line.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions

qa.question: Which hardware choices raise or lower the cost per piece of my swimsuit?
qa.answer: Plastic and resin, standard sizes and stock gloss gold or silver finishes keep your costs lowest. Your unit cost goes up with stainless steel or brass instead of zinc alloy, larger sizes, rose gold, gunmetal, matte plating, custom Pantone matching and logo engraving or embossing. Each custom logo hardware item also carries a one-off USD 200 mould fee.

qa.question: What load capacities are available for rings, sliders, front clasps and buckles used in supportive swimwear?
qa.answer: Our metal rings and front clasps hold 8 to 10 kg, sliders hold 5 to 8 kg before the strap slips, and plastic buckles hold 4 to 6 kg. For supportive and larger-cup swimwear, we specify 25 mm or 32 mm metal parts. These ratings cover the part on its own, so we confirm the closure holds in your sewn garment sample.

qa.question: How many hours of salt-spray, chlorine and UV exposure does the hardware withstand without corroding or fading?
qa.answer: Our metal hardware passes 48 hours of neutral salt spray to ISO 9227, 72 hours soaking in chlorinated pool water and 100 hours of UV exposure. To pass, it has to show no corrosion, rust or colour change at the end.

qa.question: Can you cover rings and sliders in the same fabric as my swimsuit?
qa.answer: Yes. We wrap rings, sliders and buckles from 15 mm to 50 mm in your swimsuit fabric, over plastic or metal cores. During production, we use fabric from your bulk run so each colourway matches.

qa.question: What is the minimum quantity and the development time for custom-moulded, colour-matched beads or a custom rhinestone motif?
qa.answer: Custom-moulded, colour-matched beads start at 1,000 pieces per design and colour. Development takes about 2 to 3 weeks, including a colour-matched approval sample. Custom rhinestone motifs start at 300 motifs per design, and a sample takes about 7 to 10 days.

qa.question: Are your metal rings cast closed, welded or split, and which constructions are available for load-bearing straps?
qa.answer: Our metal rings are die-cast as one solid closed piece, with no weld seams or splits. For load-bearing halter, neck and back straps, we use only closed cast metal rings of 15 mm and above, not split rings or light plastic parts. Split rings are for hanging charms and tags only.

structured_data.name: Swimwear Hardware: Rings, Sliders, Clasps and Custom Logo Parts
structured_data.description: We supply swimwear sliders with matching rings and metal hooks in the same sizes, for adjustable straps, removable straps and closures.
structured_data.serviceType: Swimwear Hardware: Rings, Sliders, Clasps and Custom Logo Parts

facts.text: We supply swimwear hardware including rings, sliders with matching rings, hooks, clasps, stoppers, resin O-rings and metal tags. Our metal line also covers rust-resistant D-rings and O-rings, adjustable sliders, decorative buckles and metal grommets.
For closures, you can choose from hook and eye sets, snap buttons, plastic buckles and magnetic closures.
Our metal rings come in 6 mm, 8 mm, 10 mm, 12 mm, 15 mm, 19 mm, 25 mm, 32 mm, 44 mm and 50 mm.
Sliders for adjustable straps come with matching rings, and our metal hooks for removable straps and closures come in the same sizes.

We offer front closure clasps in three types, each available in 20 mm, 25 mm and 32 mm. Types 1 and 2 are finished in gold, silver, gunmetal or rose gold, either gloss or matte, while type 3 is supplied in gold or silver with a gloss finish.
Our metal end stoppers for straps and ties measure 4 x 14 mm.
Our resin O-rings are made from resin and pre-polymer, in 4.5 mm and 5 mm sizes with 4 cm and 5.5 cm diameters, and you can pick coffee, tea brown or milky white.
We make branded metal tags in two sizes, 18 x 6 x 1.2 mm and 36 x 6.5 x 2 mm, finished in gold or silver.

The sizes we list for metal rings, sliders, hooks and front clasps give the inner opening, which is the strap width each part takes, so a 15 mm ring fits a 15 mm strap. On our resin O-rings, 4.5 mm and 5 mm is the thickness of the ring band, and 4 cm and 5.5 cm are the outer diameters.

Our plastic buckles are moulded from POM, our snap buttons come in nickel-free brass or POM, our hook and eye sets are nickel-free zinc alloy or stainless steel, and our magnetic closures use neodymium magnets sealed in a nickel-free metal casing. Plastic buckles come in 10, 15, 20 and 25 mm, snaps in 10, 12 and 15 mm, hook and eye sets in 10, 15 and 20 mm, and magnetic closures in 10, 14 and 18 mm.

Our plastic buckles, sliders, rings and stoppers are injection-moulded from POM (acetal) or nylon 66, and our resin O-rings are made from resin and pre-polymer in coffee, tea brown or milky white. The moulded plastic parts come in black, white, clear or a colour dyed to your Pantone reference, with a gloss, matte or frosted surface.

Type 1 is a hook-in clasp where one side drops into the other, quick to fasten and suited to triangle and bralette tops under light tension, while type 2 is an interlocking clasp that slides together and locks, giving the firmest hold for bandeau, underwire and larger-cup tops. Type 3 is a push-in clip with a spring catch that releases with one squeeze, suited to one-piece front closures and decorative centre fronts.
We manufacture swimwear ourselves in a single factory of our own in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China.
Production and export sit in one company that owns its factory, so quality, cost and delivery stay under our direct control.
Both OEM and ODM work is possible: a new style can start from your own design, a picture or just an idea.

We make swimwear from nylon and polyester swimwear fabrics blended with spandex, such as 80% nylon 20% spandex, with matching linings. On request we source chlorine-resistant LYCRA Xtra Life, recycled nylon such as ECONYL, recycled polyester such as REPREVE, and Italian Carvico fabrics.

We make the rings, sliders, hooks, buckles, clasps, stoppers and metal tags on your swimwear from high-grade zinc alloy. Each piece is electroplated in a gold or silver finish with nickel-free plating. The alloy has no chrome or lead. An anti-rust coating on top protects the hardware from seawater and pool chlorine, so it will not corrode, rust, tarnish or pit, and it will not stain your fabric after time in the sea or the pool. We test every piece of hardware to check that it lasts through long-term wear.

Our zinc alloy rings, sliders and clasps are die-cast in steel moulds, while flat parts such as metal tags are stamped from sheet metal. Every part is then deburred, tumbled and polished before it gets nickel-free electroplating in your chosen colour and a final anti-rust coating.
Beyond zinc alloy, you can also specify stainless steel or brass for metal hardware.

For stainless steel hardware you can specify grade 304 for general use or marine-grade 316L for pieces that spend long hours in seawater and chlorinated pools. For brass you can choose H62 (62% copper, 38% zinc) or H65 (65% copper, 35% zinc) in a lead-free alloy, and we test every grade against the EN 1811 nickel-release limit for skin contact.
Our metal hardware is lead-free and tested against the EN 1811 nickel-release limit, so it suits customers who need hypoallergenic trims.

For the hardware on your swimwear, we supply rings, sliders, hooks and stoppers in gold, silver, rose gold or gunmetal, and every one of these colours comes in either a shiny gloss or a matte look. You also decide how the metal surface is treated: polished, brushed or powder-coated.
Our production holds OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for tested fabrics and trims, GRS and RCS for recycled fabrics, bluesign for chemistry, ISO 9001 for quality management and WRAP for social compliance.
We carry a wide range of hardware colors and can provide Pantone references for most items. On larger orders, we also offer custom color matching so the hardware matches your palette.
We can engrave or emboss your brand logo on metal hardware such as buckles, sliders and charms.

On small parts such as our 4 x 14 mm stoppers and sliders, we can engrave or emboss a logo as small as 3 mm high, with lines at least 0.3 mm wide. Below that size, detailed logos are best simplified to initials or a monogram so they stay sharp after plating.

Yes: before bulk we make a physical sample of your logo or custom-colour hardware, such as rings, sliders, clasps and stoppers, ready about 15 to 20 days after you approve the artwork, or 7 to 10 days for standard parts colour-matched to your fabric. We start bulk hardware only after you sign off that sample, and we can fit the approved parts onto your garment sample so you see them in place.

Standard branding on each piece is a heat-transfer label, a hygiene liner and a hang tag. We heat-press your logo on the inside back of every item, together with washing instructions and the size breakdown. Your logo can also go on bikini clips, hygiene liners and custom packaging. Other branding options include woven neck labels, silicone logos, branded fabric tags, logo cards and hang tags.
Our closure hooks hold a pull force of 3–5 kg, our snap closures are rated for more than 1,000 open-and-close cycles, and our closures tolerate temperatures from -20°C to 60°C.

On all our children's styles, every snap, ring, slider, buckle, bead and trim is sewn or riveted on and must pass a 90 N pull test. Sizes for under-3s have no removable decorations at all. Kids' designs never include hanging charms, stones fixed with glue or heat, or beads small enough to swallow. We stitch rubber patches and appliqués down around their whole edge instead of only gluing them, so repeated chlorine and washing can't lift them. Our metal hardware is tested against the EN 1811 nickel-release limit and keeps lead under the CPSIA limits: 100 ppm in the base metal and 90 ppm in any coating. We can arrange order-specific testing at an accredited lab, with the fees passed to you at cost.

Send us a sketch, photo or tech pack and we will recommend the hardware type and size to use, weighing function, appearance and budget. We will also help you decide where each piece should go on the garment so it suits the design.

We fit hardware as part of production: you show us where each piece belongs and we sew it into your style. Rings and sliders are looped onto strap ends that are folded back, stitched and bar-tacked, hooks and clasps are sewn into a reinforced fabric channel, and snaps and grommets are pressed or riveted through a reinforced layer.

We set metal grommets through a fused interfacing patch or a double fabric layer that reaches 10 mm around the hole, and we press each one with a matching washer so it cannot tear out of the stretch fabric. Grommets sit at least 15 mm from seams and edges, and we pull-test them on the sample at 70 N before bulk production.
An in-house design team handles pattern design, grading and fit development, which saves you rounds of back-and-forth on the design.
A standard sample is ready in 10 to 15 days.
Each sample costs USD 50, and the design fee is USD 50 per design (its pattern or print, with all colourways); these fees are not refunded or credited against the bulk order.

We fit your own branded hardware and trims to your swimwear: send us 2 pieces of each item first so we can check fit and chlorine and salt-water resistance on your sample, then ship the bulk with 3% extra so it reaches our factory at least 7 days before the scheduled cutting date. Our own hardware is supplied as part of garment production and can also be bought on its own at its minimums.
Courier delivery of samples costs USD 50, paid by the buyer in addition to the sample fee.

Picking the fabrics, ribbons, hardware and tags for your style takes about a week or longer, depending on the supplier. Next, we work out the components needed for each piece and for the whole bulk order. From those figures, we estimate the bulk production cost and the total product cost.
We quote first: once the price is agreed, we move on to making the sample.
Orders start at 50 pieces per style in each colour, a level set so that small and growing labels can order.
A first trial run is agreed case by case, and we are as flexible on its quantity as production allows.
Once the sample is approved and the deposit received, bulk production usually needs 35 to 40 days, depending on order size and season.

A typical order moves from your brief or tech pack to a sample in 10 to 15 days, then to your approval and deposit, 35 to 40 days of bulk production depending on size and season, a full final inspection, and shipment on FOB, CIF or DDP terms.
We take a 50% deposit when the order is confirmed, and the remaining 50% is paid before shipment.
Shipments go out on FOB, CIF or DDP terms; DDP is available worldwide, and under DDP one all-in price covers delivery to your door, with duties, customs and freight handled by us.
We reply to every enquiry within one business day.

Our trims include power mesh, adjustable bra straps, decorative braided cords and chlorine-resistant elastic bands for swimwear. The elastics and straps are made from nylon/spandex blends or polyester, come in widths from 3 mm to 25 mm, recover 95% or more of their stretch after 100 cycles and withstand more than 200 hours of chlorine exposure.

You can add custom-branded metal hardware that stands up to salt water and chlorine. Standard hardware usually starts at 100 to 500 pieces per colour or size. Stoppers, clasps, hooks, sliders and rings with your own logo or emboss start at 1,000 pieces per item, as do special finishes.

Rings, sliders, hooks, clasps and stoppers can carry your logo; each custom item has a mold development fee of USD 200, and its unit price is set according to the design. Resin O-rings start at 100 pieces per colour, and metal tags with your logo or an embossed label start at 100 pieces.

Standard hardware we keep in stock is ready in 3 to 7 days. Sample sets are available for most items, and you can ask for physical samples after browsing our hardware catalogue. Our hardware complies with OEKO-TEX and international safety standards for swimwear, and every item is quality-checked before it ships.

Once you pay the mould fee, the logo mould is yours and we use it only for your hardware. We store it free of charge for 2 years after your last order, so reorders of the same design need no new mould fee, and we can ship the mould to you on request.
We test clasps, rings and other hardware for stretch, corrosion and durability, and we also run chlorine-resistance, salt-spray and UV-exposure tests. Test reports are available on request.
Quality is checked at every stage of an order: fabric on arrival, cutting, sewing, then random checks and a full final inspection.
Independent inspectors such as SGS or BV are welcome to check the goods before they ship.

Plastic and resin parts, standard sizes and stock gold or silver gloss finishes keep hardware cost lowest, and the price per piece rises with stainless steel or brass instead of zinc alloy, larger sizes, rose gold, gunmetal or matte plating, custom Pantone colour matching and logo engraving or embossing. Each custom logo hardware item also carries a one-off mould development fee.

Our metal rings and front clasps are rated for 8 to 10 kg of pull force, our sliders hold 5 to 8 kg before the strap slips, and our plastic buckles hold 4 to 6 kg. For supportive and larger-cup swimwear we recommend metal parts in 25 mm or 32 mm.

We test our metal hardware with 48 hours of neutral salt spray to ISO 9227, 72 hours of soaking in chlorinated pool water and 100 hours of UV exposure. A part passes only if it shows no corrosion, rust or colour change at the end.

Yes, we can wrap rings, sliders and buckles from 15 mm to 50 mm in your swimsuit fabric over a plastic or metal core, so the hardware matches the suit exactly. We cover them with fabric from your bulk run during production, so the colour matches each colourway.

Custom-moulded, colour-matched beads start at 1,000 pieces per design and colour, and a custom rhinestone motif starts at 300 motifs per design. Development takes about 2 to 3 weeks for beads, including a colour-matched sample for your approval, and about 7 to 10 days for a rhinestone motif sample.

Our metal rings are die-cast as one solid closed piece with no weld seam or split, and we test them against long exposure to chlorine, salt water and sun before they go into your production. For halter, neck and back straps that carry load we use only these closed cast rings, recommending 15 mm and above, and we offer split rings only for hanging charms and tags.

pages.h1: Swimwear Fabric and Sourcing from Our Guangzhou Factory
pages.hero_lead: Our core 80/20 nylon-spandex comes with matching linings, and on request we import Italian fabrics or any fabric you name by its supplier and code, including from the mill you already use.

sections.heading: Swim Fabrics Imported Direct from Italian Mills
sections.body: Most of the swimwear we make uses 80% nylon 20% spandex at 180–200 GSM, and on request we import Italian fabrics such as Carvico directly from the knitting mills. If you want a fabric we don't stock, send us its name, or the supplier name and fabric code. We can also import from the mill you already use. Just give us the supplier name and code.

sections.heading: Fabric Blends, Branded Fabrics and Mill Minimums

items.title: Blends and specialist fabrics
items.text: We make nylon-spandex and polyester-spandex swimwear with matching linings. On request, we source chlorine-resistant elastane, recycled nylon, recycled polyester and Italian fabrics.

items.title: Other mills’ minimums
items.text: If you use your own supplier or a mill other than Carvico, the minimum is 50 to 100 m per fabric and colour, set by each mill. We check it before costing, and we store any leftover metres free of charge for your later runs.

items.title: Component selection and costing
items.text: Our [quotation process](/request-a-quote/) starts with choosing your fabric, ribbon, hardware and tags. This takes about a week, or longer depending on the suppliers. We then use the component quantities per piece and your bulk order size to set your estimated production cost and total product cost.

items.title: Swimwear hardware
items.text: Our [Swimwear Hardware](/swimwear-hardware/) range includes power mesh, adjustable bra straps, braided cords and chlorine-resistant elastics. Our nylon/spandex or polyester straps and elastics come in widths from 3 to 25 mm. They recover at least 95% of their stretch after 100 cycles and hold up to more than 200 hours of chlorine exposure.

sections.heading: Order Minimums, Deposits and Shipping Terms

items.title: Order minimum
items.text: Orders start at 50 pieces per style in each colour, which gives small and growing labels a way in.

items.title: First trial run
items.text: We agree your first trial quantity with you case by case. We're flexible up to the limits of our production requirements.

items.title: Payment terms
items.text: You pay a 50% deposit when you confirm the order and the other 50% before shipment.

items.title: Shipping terms
items.text: We ship FOB, CIF or DDP. With worldwide DDP, you get one all-in price delivered to your door, and we handle the duties, customs and freight.

items.title: Brief to sample

items.title: Approval to production

items.title: Inspection to shipment

sections.heading: Our Own Guangzhou Factory for Fabric Sourcing
sections.body: We make your swimwear in our own factory. There is just one, and it is in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China. As a [factory-owning company](/about-us/), we handle both production and export ourselves, so quality, cost and delivery stay under our direct control. To [contact our team](/contact-us/), use email, WhatsApp or the contact form on our website.

sections.heading: 80/20 Nylon-Spandex and Our Stock Fabric Options

items.title: Our main blend
items.text: Most of the swimwear we make uses 80% nylon and 20% spandex, in weights of 180–200 GSM.

items.title: Collection fabric choices
items.text: For print-led collections, we use polyester-spandex. We also offer nylon-spandex and recycled options. We choose between nylon, polyester, spandex and Lycra for stretch, UV resistance, performance and long wear.

items.title: Stock and imported colours
items.text: Use stock colours for your core shades and save imports for the colours that define your collection. Imported Carvico minimums are 70 m for Vita and Sumatra and 50 m for Pantelleria.

sections.heading: Nylon-Spandex Swim Fabrics: Weight, Stretch and Best Use
sections.body:
| Fabric or specification | What it means for your styles |
|---|---|
| Recycled performance | This fabric is 78% recycled nylon and 22% spandex at 190 gsm. It stretches in four directions, gives UPF 50+ protection and resists chlorine and salt water. It performs on a par with premium Italian swim fabrics. |
| Core fabric specifications | Usable width is 145 to 150 cm. Four-way stretch is about 180% lengthwise and 200% widthwise, with recovery of 90% or more. Each fabric's spec sheet comes with your quotation. |
| Single-layer construction | In mid and dark colours, our 190 to 230 g/m² recycled performance, soft-touch and micro-terry fabrics work as a single layer. |
| Lighter construction | With 175 to 180 g/m² fabrics, we add a lining, a double layer or a lined front panel. |
| Minimal, close-fitting styles | The lighter 180 to 190 g/m² fabrics suit triangle bikinis, string styles and fashion pieces. Linings or pads add extra shaping. |
| Supportive cuts | Our 230 g/m² soft-touch knit holds more firmly and lies smoother over the torso, so it works for one-pieces, larger cups, high-waist bottoms and shaping styles. |
| Imported Italian fabric | You get a smoother, denser hand, a cleaner face, a broader seasonal colour card and tight shade matching between dye lots, so your repeat orders stay consistent. |
| Stock fabric | Core shades cost less in fabric and have no mill minimum, so they suit first runs and smaller collections. |

sections.heading: Which Fabrics Take Digital Prints
sections.body: If your collection is printed, our nylon-based recycled micro-terry, recycled crinkle, recycled metallic and post-consumer recycled nylon all take [digital printing](/custom-swimwear-printing/). Recycled polyester corduroy rib takes sublimation, which gives sharp, clean detail. Post-consumer recycled nylon also works for your plain-colour styles.

sections.heading: Chlorine, Salt Water and UPF Performance

items.title: Pool and training
items.text: If your styles are for regular use in chlorinated pools and for training, we choose recycled performance fabric or a fabric built on chlorine-resistant elastane such as LYCRA Xtra Life.

items.title: Beach and fashion
items.text: Metallic knits, high-shine charmeuse, micro-terry, crinkle and soft-touch fabrics are for beachwear and fashion styles, not for regular pool training.

items.title: Standard UPF testing
items.text: Our UPF 50+ fabrics are tested to AS/NZS 4399, the Australia and New Zealand standard, and we give you the documentation. The rating applies to the fabric when it's dry and relaxed.

items.title: Additional claim testing
items.text: If you want to claim more than the dry, relaxed rating, you need extra testing. We can arrange wet, stretched, selected-colourway, EU EN 13758-1 or US AATCC 183 tests through an accredited lab, and you pay the fees at cost.

sections.heading: Recycled Content and Fabric Certifications
sections.body: Our recycled materials are GRS certified. All of the recycled content comes from fishing nets, plastic bottles and post-consumer waste, and we give you the GRS documentation to back up your claims. Our [production certifications](/sustainability/) are OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for tested fabrics and trims, GRS and RCS for recycled fabrics, bluesign for chemistry, ISO 9001 for quality management and WRAP for social compliance.

sections.heading: Swim Fabric Swatch Kits and Samples
sections.body:
Order our real-fabric swatch kit before sampling so you can compare hand, sheen, stretch and print quality side by side. The kit has five Italian nylon swatches, two recycled lustre swatches, three high-shine charmeuse swatches, one recycled micro-terry swatch, four recycled nylon digital prints and three recycled polyester sublimation prints. It also includes samples of recycled performance, recycled metallic, recycled sparkle and mesh fabric.

Each garment sample costs USD 50. The design fee is USD 50 per design, which covers its pattern or print in every colourway. We don't refund either fee, and neither one is credited against bulk orders.

sections.heading: Pantone Colour Matching and Custom Dyeing

items.title: Included colour matching
items.text: Pantone matching is included for fabric, screen printing and sublimation. Send us a Pantone reference or a physical swatch, and that includes team or club colours.

items.title: Approval before bulk
items.text: During sampling we confirm whether your colour can be achieved. We then make one round of lab dips on the actual production fabric for you to approve.

items.title: Custom dyeing requirements
items.text: Custom-dyed fabric takes about 4 weeks from your deposit. It has a 100-metre minimum and a USD 110 surcharge. For small runs, use our in-stock colour cards instead.

items.title: Colour and accessory timing
items.text: Send us your requirements for custom colours and branded accessories, and we'll confirm the timing for those parts of your order.

sections.heading: Wet Opacity, Linings and Fabric Care
sections.body: White and pale swimwear risks turning see-through when it's wet. For light colours, we build your styles with 190 to 220 g/m² shell fabric plus a lining, a double layer or a lined front panel, and we use a matching 140 g/m² lining. We confirm opacity on a wet sample. Then we check the finished garment wet and stretched before you approve bulk production.

sections.heading: Chlorine Resistance and Fabric Testing
sections.body: Before we cut your bulk fabric, we test chlorine resistance and colour fastness after repeated chlorine exposure. We also test stretch and recovery to check that the fabric returns to shape after wear and time in the water. Strength, softness and durability get tested too. The tests you request depend on how your product will be used.

sections.heading: What Drives Your Fabric Cost
sections.body: Standard nylon- or polyester-spandex blends cost less, so they suit your basics. Branded or recycled LYCRA Xtra Life, Carvico, ECONYL and REPREVE fabrics cost more and suit your hero styles. Your quotation shows the fabric difference separately so you can compare. Italian fabric adds the most when your order can't use up a full mill minimum. Metallic yarns, textured surfaces and custom dyeing also cost more than stock colours.
