sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions

qa.question: Can I buy sourced swimwear fabric without a garment order?
qa.answer: No. We only source fabric for garments we make for you. We import or source the cloth you choose, then cut and sew it into your styles.

qa.question: Can several styles jointly meet a mill minimum?
qa.answer: Yes. When styles share the same fabric and colour, we combine them into one fabric order: 70 m for Carvico Vita and Sumatra, or 50 m for Pantelleria. Each style still needs 50 pieces per colour. If you confirm shared fabrics and colours early, we start imports before sampling and production.

qa.question: How much time does importing fabric add?
qa.answer: Importing from Italy or from your own mill adds about 7 to 10 days before sampling, because the sample yardage is couriered. It adds about 3 to 5 weeks before bulk for knitting or dyeing and shipping. Our 10 to 15 days for sampling and 35 to 40 days for bulk start once the fabric arrives. Bulk also needs your sample approval and your deposit.

qa.question: Can you reserve fabric for repeat orders?
qa.answer: Yes. Once you confirm a repeat collection, we book fabric and colour against your forecast up to 6 months ahead and keep your leftover metres for your next run. If the mill discontinues the fabric, we tell you at least 8 weeks ahead and send two or three matched alternatives for you to approve before bulk.

qa.question: Which linings are available, and when do you match the shell or use nude?
qa.answer: We offer nylon-spandex or recycled-nylon-spandex linings at about 110 to 140 g/m² in white, black, nude or colours matched to your shell. Your recycled-fabric styles get recycled lining. We match the shell for dark, bright, reversible and visible-edge styles. Nude goes under white, pale colours and light prints so the lining doesn't show through.

structured_data.name: Swimwear Fabric and Sourcing from Our Guangzhou Factory
structured_data.description: Most of the swimwear we make uses 80% nylon 20% spandex at 180–200 GSM, and on request we import Italian fabrics such as Carvico directly from the knitting mills.
structured_data.serviceType: Swimwear Fabric and Sourcing from Our Guangzhou Factory

facts.text: We import swimwear fabric directly from knitting mills in Italy, so the Italian cloth on your styles comes to us straight from the producing mill.

If the fabric you want is not one we stock, send us the fabric name or the supplier name along with the fabric code, and we will import it for your order. The same works for mills you already buy from: give us the supplier name and the fabric code, and we will bring that fabric in from your own mill.

We make swimwear from nylon and polyester swimwear fabrics blended with spandex, such as 80% nylon 20% spandex, with matching linings. On request we source chlorine-resistant LYCRA Xtra Life, recycled nylon such as ECONYL, recycled polyester such as REPREVE, and Italian Carvico fabrics.

When we import from your own supplier or from a mill other than Carvico, the minimum is usually 50 to 100 m per fabric and colour, depending on that mill. Any metres left over after cutting stay in our warehouse free of charge, ready for your next run.

Picking the fabrics, ribbons, hardware and tags for your style takes about a week or longer, depending on the supplier. Next, we work out the components needed for each piece and for the whole bulk order. From those figures, we estimate the bulk production cost and the total product cost.

Our trims include power mesh, adjustable bra straps, decorative braided cords and chlorine-resistant elastic bands for swimwear. The elastics and straps are made from nylon/spandex blends or polyester, come in widths from 3 mm to 25 mm, recover 95% or more of their stretch after 100 cycles and withstand more than 200 hours of chlorine exposure.
Orders start at 50 pieces per style in each colour, a level set so that small and growing labels can order.
A first trial run is agreed case by case, and we are as flexible on its quantity as production allows.
Shipments go out on FOB, CIF or DDP terms; DDP is available worldwide, and under DDP one all-in price covers delivery to your door, with duties, customs and freight handled by us.
We take a 50% deposit when the order is confirmed, and the remaining 50% is paid before shipment.
Once the sample is approved and the deposit received, bulk production usually needs 35 to 40 days, depending on order size and season.

A typical order moves from your brief or tech pack to a sample in 10 to 15 days, then to your approval and deposit, 35 to 40 days of bulk production depending on size and season, a full final inspection, and shipment on FOB, CIF or DDP terms.
We manufacture swimwear ourselves in a single factory of our own in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China.
You can contact our team by email, phone, WhatsApp, Zoom, Messenger, Skype or Viber, or through the contact form on this website.
Production and export sit in one company that owns its factory, so quality, cost and delivery stay under our direct control.
Most of the swimwear we produce uses an 80/20 nylon-spandex blend, which we supply in weights of 180–200 GSM.

Pick the fabric to suit your collection: polyester-spandex for print-led collections, nylon-spandex blends, or recycled fabrics. We offer nylon, polyester, spandex and Lycra in a wide range of colours. Each fabric is chosen for stretch, UV resistance, performance and long wear.

Instead of importing the fabrics and colours you request, you can choose from fabrics in our stock colours. Imported Carvico colours have minimums of 70 m for Vita and Sumatra and 50 m for Pantelleria.

Our recycled performance fabric is 78% recycled nylon and 22% spandex at 190 gsm. It stretches in four directions, gives UPF 50+ protection, stands up to chlorine and salt water, and performs as well as premium Italian swim fabrics.

Our core nylon and spandex swim fabrics have a usable width of 145 to 150 cm, four-way stretch of about 180% lengthwise and 200% widthwise, and recovery of 90% or more, and we send the spec sheet for each fabric with your quotation. The 190 to 230 g/m² fabrics, such as our recycled performance, soft-touch and micro-terry cloths, can be used single-layer in mid and dark colours, while for the 175 to 180 g/m² fabrics and all light colours we add a lining, a double layer or a lined front panel.

Our lighter 180 to 190 g/m² fabrics suit triangle bikinis, string styles and fashion pieces where you want a light, close fit, with extra shaping coming from linings or pads. Choose the 230 g/m² soft-touch fabric for one-pieces, larger cup sizes, high-waist bottoms and shaping styles, where the heavier knit holds the body more firmly and lies smoother over the torso.

When you choose imported Italian fabric, you get a smoother, denser hand and a cleaner face, a broader card of seasonal colours, and tight shade matching from one dye lot to the next, so your repeat orders come out looking the same. Our stock fabrics cover the core shades at a lower fabric price and without any mill minimum, which makes them a good fit for a first run or a smaller collection.

Yes: our recycled polyester corduroy rib takes sublimation printing with sharp, clean detail. The nylon-based textures, our recycled micro-terry, recycled crinkle and recycled metallic fabric, take digital printing, as does our post-consumer recycled nylon for prints and plain colours.

For regular chlorinated-pool or training use we recommend our recycled performance fabric or any fabric built on chlorine-resistant elastane such as LYCRA Xtra Life. Keep the metallic knits, high-shine charmeuse, micro-terry, crinkle and soft-touch fabrics for beach and fashion styles.

Our UPF 50+ fabrics are tested to AS/NZS 4399, the standard used in Australia and New Zealand, and we supply the UPF test documentation; the standard rating applies to dry, relaxed fabric. Wet and stretched tests, tests on your selected colourway, or tests to EN 13758-1 for the EU or AATCC 183 for the US can be added at an accredited lab, with fees paid by you at cost.
Our recycled materials are GRS certified. All of their recycled content comes from fishing nets, plastic bottles and post-consumer waste.
Our production holds OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for tested fabrics and trims, GRS and RCS for recycled fabrics, bluesign for chemistry, ISO 9001 for quality management and WRAP for social compliance.
A standard sample is ready in 10 to 15 days.
Each sample costs USD 50, and the design fee is USD 50 per design (its pattern or print, with all colourways); these fees are not refunded or credited against the bulk order.
You can order a swatch kit from us with real fabric samples, so you can feel each material before you decide.

The kit holds five Italian nylon swatches, two recycled lustre swatches, three high-shine charmeuse swatches, one recycled micro-terry swatch, four recycled nylon digital prints and three recycled polyester sublimation prints. It also includes samples of our recycled performance fabric, recycled metallic fabric, recycled sparkle fabric and mesh.

Pantone matching is included. You can pick from our in-stock colour cards, or we can match a Pantone reference or a physical swatch, including your team or club colours. Pantone matching also covers screen printing and sublimation. Before bulk production, we make one round of lab dips for your approval. Slight colour variations can still occur.
Custom-dyed fabric takes about 4 weeks from your deposit. We confirm whether your colour is feasible during sampling.
Custom dyeing has a 100-metre minimum and a USD 110 surcharge. Ask us and we will confirm the timing for your custom colours and branded accessories.

White and pale swimwear can turn see-through when wet, so for light colours we use fabrics of 190 to 220 g/m² and add a lining, a double layer or a lined front panel, with a matching 140 g/m² lining. We confirm wet opacity on a wet sample and check it again on the finished garment, both wet and under stretch, before you approve bulk production.

We test our fabrics for chlorine resistance, for colour fastness after repeated chlorine exposure, and for stretch and recovery so the suit returns to shape after wear and time in the water. We also test strength, softness and durability, and UPF 50+ fabrics are available.

Branded and recycled options such as LYCRA Xtra Life, Carvico, ECONYL and REPREVE are priced above our standard nylon or polyester spandex blends. Your quotation shows the fabric difference on its own line, so you can weigh both choices for each style. Italian fabric adds the most to your cost when your order is too small to use a full minimum run. Metallic yarns, textured surfaces and custom dyeing also cost more than stock colours.

Our fabric sourcing is supplied only for garments we produce for you, so we don't sell sourced swimwear fabric on its own. When you place a garment order, we source or import the fabric you choose and cut and sew it into your styles.

Yes: when several of your styles use the same fabric in the same colour, we add their metres together in one fabric order so they jointly reach the mill minimum, such as 70 m for Carvico Vita and Sumatra or 50 m for Pantelleria. Each style still needs its own 50 pieces per colour.

Importing a fabric from Italy or from your own mill adds about 7 to 10 days before sampling, while sample yardage reaches us by courier, and about 3 to 5 weeks before bulk production, while the mill knits or dyes your metres and ships them. Our usual 10 to 15 days for a sample and 35 to 40 days for bulk production start once that fabric has arrived.

Yes: once you confirm a repeat collection, we book your fabric and colour with the mill against your forecast for up to 6 months ahead, and leftover metres from your order stay in our warehouse for your next run. If a mill discontinues your fabric, we tell you at least 8 weeks in advance and send you two or three matched alternatives to approve before bulk production.

Our linings are nylon or recycled nylon blended with spandex, at about 110 to 140 g/m², in white, black, nude or dyed to match your shell colour, with recycled lining available for styles in recycled fabric. We match the lining to the shell for dark and bright colours and for reversible or visible-edge styles, and use nude lining under white, pale and light prints so it does not show through.

Average product rating (out of 5): 4.1 to 4.6 (Summer 2024 season vs summer 2025 season)

pages.h1: Swimwear Brand Launch Services, From Pattern to Online Store
pages.hero_lead: Pick from our existing styles or hand us your own designs, and we produce every piece in our Guangzhou factory, checking quality, cost and delivery at each stage of your order.

sections.heading: Your Designs or Ours, Made and Checked in Our Own Factory
sections.body: You can pick swimwear from our existing range or bring us your own designs. Either way, we make it in our own factory in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China. Because we run a [factory-owned production and export operation](/about-us/), we keep quality, cost and delivery under our direct control, and we check your order at every stage.

sections.heading: Before the Launch: Design, Samples and Certified Production

items.title: Design development
items.text: Our in-house [OEM and ODM development team](/development/) turns your design, picture or idea into patterns, grading and fit, so there's less back-and-forth on the design.

items.title: Sample approval
items.text: You judge the quality on samples first. Your bulk order goes ahead once you've approved them.

items.title: Production certifications
items.text: Our [certifications](/sustainability/) are OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for fabrics and trims, GRS/RCS for recycled fabrics, bluesign for chemistry, ISO 9001 for quality management and WRAP for social compliance.

sections.heading: From Pattern to Bulk: Steps, Timing and Terms

items.title: Starting quantities
items.text: Orders start at 50 pieces per style in each colour. That gives small and growing labels a place to start production.

items.title: Trial runs
items.text: We agree your first trial quantity with you case by case. How far we can adjust it depends on production requirements.

items.title: Bulk timing
items.text: Bulk production takes 35 to 40 days once you've approved the sample and we've received your deposit. Your order size and the season set where you fall in that range.

items.title: Production payments
items.text: You pay a 50% deposit when you confirm your order and the other 50% before we ship the goods.

items.title: Shipping terms
items.text: You can choose FOB, CIF or DDP. With worldwide DDP you get one all-in price delivered to your door, and we handle duties, customs and freight.

items.title: Fabric sourcing
items.text: Our [Fabric sourcing](/swimwear-fabrics-sourcing/) covers 80% nylon/20% spandex as well as your own textiles. If you supply fabric, give us the mill name or code. We report any shortages or defects within 3 business days, before cutting. If our error causes damage beyond the 5% overage, we pay you back at the documented purchase cost.

items.title: Custom printing
items.text: Our in-factory [Custom Printing service](/custom-swimwear-printing/) prints stocked fabrics the same day. Standard jobs take 2–3 days after you approve the artwork, and a full print run is finished within 2.5 weeks, inside the 35 to 40 days of bulk production. You approve the print by video or with a physical strike-off on your fabric.

items.title: Swimwear hardware
items.text: Our [Swimwear Hardware service](/swimwear-hardware/) supplies branded metal fittings that resist salt water and chlorine. Standard hardware starts at 100 to 500 pieces per colour or size. Logo or embossed items and special finishes start at 1,000 pieces per item.

sections.heading: Samples First: Lead Time and Fees

items.title: Sample timing and cost
items.text: We make a standard sample in 10 to 15 days. Each sample you order costs USD 50.

items.title: Starter pack for new labels
items.text: Our starter pack gives you three finished samples, twenty fabric swatches, a catalogue of the ready-made styles we keep in stock and a short guide to launching your swimwear brand.

items.title: Design fees
items.text: The design fee is USD 50 per design, whether it's a pattern or a print, and it covers all colourways. We don't refund sample or design fees or credit them against bulk orders.

items.title: Courier and inspections
items.text: Under our [sample delivery and inspection terms](/faq/), you pay USD 50 for courier delivery on top of the sample fees. Independent pre-shipment inspectors such as SGS or BV are welcome.

items.title: Quotation first
items.text: Send us complete designs, meaning front and back images, tech packs or clear line drawings. We'll give you a [sampling-to-shipping quotation](/request-a-quote/) within 2 to 3 working days, and sampling starts once we've agreed the price.

sections.heading: Launch Photography Shot From Your Own Samples

items.title: Samples to shoot
items.text: Your samples go straight from our factory to the shoot, so your images are finished before your bulk stock arrives.

items.title: Campaign and product images
items.text: On set, we style and prepare your collection for editorial campaign images, clean product photographs and close-up details for your online store.

items.title: Consistent product pages
items.text: You can choose on-model, flat-lay or ghost-mannequin formats, or combine them. Pair your on-model campaigns with one white-background product format per category, and your store imagery stays consistent.

items.title: Locations and casting
items.text: We shoot in our Guangzhou studio or at a beach or pool chosen for your collection. We cast professional models, including plus-size models from 1X to 3X and child models for kids’ swimwear.

items.title: Live shoot approval
items.text: You can attend the shoot in person or follow it over a live video link, and you approve the images as we take them.

items.title: Sample sizes and quantities
items.text: We shoot size M, or 2XL for plus-size styles, using 1 piece per style and colour per model. If a style is shown on two models together, we need a second piece.

items.title: Your samples returned
items.text: The shoot samples stay yours, and we ship them back to you with your completed bulk order.

items.title: Approved colour reference
items.text: You approve each physical fabric colour under daylight. We then match every image to that swatch using a colour reference card and daylight-balanced lighting.

items.title: Faithful retouching
items.text: We only remove dust, lint and temporary marks. Retouching never changes the fabric texture, coverage, cut or fit on the body.

items.title: Image files and crops
items.text: For each style, you get 3 retouched images per look as high-resolution JPEGs at 4000 px on the long edge, along with web-optimised versions and 1:1, 4:5 and 2:3 crops.

items.title: Proofs and final delivery
items.text: We send you proofs within 3 business days of the shoot and deliver your final retouched images within 10 business days.

items.title: Shoot pricing
items.text: Your photo and film price depends on the number of styles, looks, models, locations, shoot days and retouched images, plus the length and number of video edits.

items.title: Agreement before booking
items.text: Before we book any shoot or film work, we agree your project’s dates, deliverables and price with you.

sections.heading: Launch Film Cut for Social and Your Store
sections.body: We plan your film and stills together and set aside time to capture movement, stretch and fit both in the water and on land.

items.title: Shared shoot production
items.text: We film alongside your stills with the same crew and locations, then edit the footage for your store and social channels.

items.title: Launch film formats
items.text: You can choose a hero campaign cut for launch and paid media, vertical reels and stories, and product motion clips that show movement and fit.

items.title: Branding and captions
items.text: We add logo intros, end cards and lower thirds in your brand fonts and colours, with captions either burned in or supplied as separate SRT files.

items.title: English voiceover
items.text: You get a professional English voiceover recorded from the script you approve, and you can pick from 2 voices for your film.

items.title: Translated video versions
items.text: Each edit can have up to 5 language versions, including Spanish, French, German, Japanese or Arabic. You approve the translations in a text file before we add subtitles and on-screen text.

items.title: Paid media use
items.text: The music is commercially licensed for paid social and search advertising, and you can use your final edits with no time or territory limit.

items.title: Raw footage handover
items.text: If you ask for it, we hand over your raw footage as a file download within 5 business days of final delivery.

sections.heading: Brand Identity: Logo Marks, Colours and Typography

items.title: Logo marks for garments
items.text: We start by designing your logo to work very small and in one colour on woven labels, hang tags and hygiene liners, and then we settle its full-colour screen version.

items.title: Identity beyond the logo
items.text: Alongside your logo marks, we develop your colour palette and typography, with guidelines that show you how to use the identity across labels, tags and screens.

items.title: Packaging and supplied labels
items.text: [Swimwear Packaging & Custom Brand Labels](/swimwear-packaging-custom-brand-labels/) uses marked, retail-ready 5-ply export cartons. If you supply your own labels, tags or bags, send 3% extra at least 7 days before cutting. We check them when they arrive and report any shortages or defects within 3 business days, before cutting.

sections.heading: An Online Store Ready on Launch Day
sections.body: We build and set up your online store, lay out its product pages and place your images. Then we hand it over to you to own and run. Every swimwear product page is built around fit, with a clear size guide, the size the model is wearing, the fabric composition, coverage and care notes.

sections.heading: Your Launch Step by Step, From Brief to Go-Live
sections.body: We invoice launch services separately from production: half when you book and half on delivery of the finished work, by T/T in USD or EUR.

items.title: Share your brief
items.text: Send us your brand name, market, mood board, style images or tech packs, fabrics, collection size, quantities, branding needs, budget and shipping destination. If you don't have any assets yet, your brand name and a few reference pictures are enough to get started.

items.title: Agree your plan
items.text: We [reply to your enquiry](/contact-us/) within one business day. Then we work out which launch services your project needs and quote them separately from production.

items.title: Make and brand
items.text: Branding runs alongside sampling and takes 2 to 3 weeks. We finalise it during sampling, so your labels, tags and packaging are ready for bulk production.

items.title: Shoot approved samples
items.text: Your photo and video shoot takes 1 to 2 weeks. It happens during bulk production and uses the samples you've approved.

items.title: Build during production
items.text: Your store build takes 2 to 3 weeks. It also runs during bulk production, alongside the work of getting your collection ready for launch.

items.title: Complete your launch
items.text: Allow about 10 to 12 weeks from brief to launch across all six stages. We fit sampling, branding, the shoot and the store work around production.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions

qa.question: Can you shoot or build a store for swimwear I already have from another supplier, or only for styles you manufacture?
qa.answer: We work with swimwear from other suppliers as well as the styles we make. You can book photography, film, branding or a store build on its own, with no package or garment order needed. Send us the service you want and the materials you already have, and we'll explain what the project needs. If we manufacture your collection, we build the store around your styles, your identity and your campaign images.

qa.question: What revision rounds are included for the photos and films, and which changes would require a new shoot rather than an edit?
qa.answer: Photo retouching comes with 2 revision rounds, and so does every film or video edit. These rounds cover colour, image selection, crops, cut order, timing, captions and music. Please put your team's feedback together in one list for each round. New models, new locations, new styling, styles that weren't in the shoot and fresh angles all need a new shoot. Branding comes with 2 logo concepts and 1 revision round on the concept you pick. Store builds come with 2 rounds of changes before handover.

qa.question: What usage rights do I receive for the photos and videos, including model releases and any music licences, across my store, advertising and retailer channels?
qa.answer: Once you've paid, you get unlimited commercial rights to the final photos and videos. You can use them in your store, on your social channels, in paid advertising and with retail or wholesale partners, with no time or territory limits. Before every shoot, we get signed model releases that cover all of these uses. The only music we use is royalty-free and licensed for commercial and paid social use.

qa.question: Is the launch service meant for new founders only, or can an established label use it for a new swim line?
qa.answer: It's for both new founders and established labels. Founders without assets can book the full package, from brief to launch. Established labels adding swimwear can pick individual services. Either way, one team handles your development, sampling, production and launch.

qa.question: Does the launch step include advertising setup, campaign management or social publishing, or does your service end with delivering the assets and store?
qa.answer: Our service ends when we hand over your finished assets and your store is ready to take orders. We don't do advertising setup, campaign management or social publishing. You or your marketing team handle those with the files we deliver.

qa.question: What decides how much a full launch costs, and which choices make it more or less expensive?
qa.answer: Your total depends on how many styles you have, the shoot locations and models, how many photos and film edits you need, the video length, how much branding you need, your packaging items and how complex your store is. Adding shoot days, looks or retouched images also changes the shoot price. Production costs change with how complex the design is, whether you use premium or standard fabrics, your quantity, and whether you go with custom designs or catalogue styles.

qa.question: Will one person manage my whole launch across production, the shoot and the store?
qa.answer: When you enquire, we assign you a dedicated swimwear specialist. That person is your one contact for production, photography, branding and the store. A merchandiser tracks sampling and bulk production and sends you photo updates at every stage. You also deal directly with our design and production teams, with no agents in between.

You can add custom-branded metal hardware that stands up to salt water and chlorine. Standard hardware usually starts at 100 to 500 pieces per colour or size. Stoppers, clasps, hooks, sliders and rings with your own logo or emboss start at 1,000 pieces per item, as do special finishes.
A standard sample is ready in 10 to 15 days.
Each sample costs USD 50, and the design fee is USD 50 per design (its pattern or print, with all colourways); these fees are not refunded or credited against the bulk order.
Courier delivery of samples costs USD 50, paid by the buyer in addition to the sample fee.
Most partnerships begin with samples so quality can be judged first, and the bulk order follows once they are approved.
We quote first: once the price is agreed, we move on to making the sample.
Your samples move directly from our factory to the photo shoot, so your images are finished before the bulk stock lands.
We shoot editorial campaign images of the styles we produce for you, plus clean product shots and close-up detail shots for your online store, with the collection styled and prepared on set.

You can choose on-model, flat-lay or ghost-mannequin product photography for each style, or combine them. For example, we can pair on-model campaign shots with flat-lay or ghost-mannequin images on a clean white background for your product pages.

We shoot in our studio in Guangzhou or at an outdoor beach or pool location chosen for your collection, and we cast professional models to suit your line, including plus-size models from 1X to 3X and child models for kids' swimwear. You are welcome to attend the shoot in person, or follow it remotely on a live video link and approve shots as they are taken.

We shoot in sample size M, or 2XL for plus-size styles, with 1 piece per style and colour for each model and a second piece for any style shown on two models at once. After the shoot the samples are yours, and we ship them to you together with your bulk order.

We shoot with a colour reference card under daylight-balanced light and match every image to your approved fabric, so colours stay true to the sample. Our retouching removes only dust, lint and temporary marks and never changes fabric texture, coverage, cut or how the piece fits on the body.

Each style comes with 3 retouched images per look, delivered as high-resolution JPEG files at 4000 px on the long edge plus web-optimised versions, with 1:1, 4:5 and 2:3 crops to fit your store and marketplace image specifications. We share a proof selection within 3 business days of the shoot and deliver the final retouched images within 10 business days.

The cost of a shoot or film rises or falls with the number of styles and looks, how many models and locations you need, the number of shoot days, how many retouched images you order, and the length and number of video edits. We set the dates, deliverables and price for each project with you before booking.
We shoot film alongside the stills, using the same locations and the same crew, then edit the footage for your social channels and your store.

Film deliverables can include a hero campaign cut for your launch and paid media, vertical edits for social formatted for reels and stories, and product motion clips that show how each piece moves and fits on the body.

We can finish your launch videos with branded graphics such as logo intros, end cards and lower thirds in your brand fonts and colours, plus burned-in captions or separate SRT caption files. We also add a professional English voiceover recorded from a script you approve, with a choice of 2 voices.

We create captioned versions of each launch video with subtitles and on-screen text translated into the languages of your target markets, such as Spanish, French, German, Japanese or Arabic, with up to 5 language versions per edit. We send you the translations as a text file for approval before we add them to the video.

You can run the launch films in paid ads on social and search platforms, because we score them only with music licensed for commercial and paid media use, and the final edits are yours to use with no time or territory limit. The raw footage is also handed over to you on request as a file download within 5 business days of final delivery.
Our branding work covers your identity: logo marks for labels, tags and screens, a color palette and typography, and guidelines on how to use them.

Your goods are packed retail-ready in 5-ply export cartons printed with your shipping marks and labelled with the style, colour and size breakdown inside, so they can go directly into your own warehouse, your 3PL or an FBA warehouse.

If you supply your own labels, hang tags and bags, send 3% extra of each to cover wastage, and make sure everything reaches our factory at least 7 days before the scheduled cutting date. We count and check them on arrival and report any shortages or defects to you within 3 business days, before cutting.
We build and configure your online store, structure the product pages, place your imagery, and then hand the store over to you to own and run.
Your launch follows six steps in order: brief, plan, make, shoot, build and launch.

For the brief, share your brand name, target market and a mood board, together with style images or tech packs, the fabrics you have in mind, your expected collection size and quantities, your branding needs, your budget and where the goods will ship. If you have no brand assets yet, a brand name and a few reference pictures are enough to start.

Branding runs alongside sampling over 2 to 3 weeks, while the photo and video shoot with your approved samples (1 to 2 weeks) and the store build (2 to 3 weeks) both run during bulk production, so allow about 10 to 12 weeks from brief to launch.

Launch services such as the photo shoot, brand film, branding and store build are quoted and invoiced separately from the deposit and balance on your production order. Each service is paid in two stages, half on booking confirmation and half on delivery of the finished work, by T/T bank transfer in USD or EUR.
We reply to every enquiry within one business day.

Once we have all your design information, we prepare a detailed quotation within 2 to 3 working days. It covers everything from sampling to manufacturing, including fabrics, accessories, branding, labelling, production and shipping, and can be based on front and back images, tech packs or clear line drawings.

Our launch services are a photo shoot, a launch film, branding and a store build. You can book any one of them on its own. You don't need a full package or a garment order. This means we can work on swimwear you already get from another supplier as well as on styles we make for you. When we produce your collection, we build the store around those styles and use your brand identity and campaign images. Let us know which service you need and send us the materials you already have. We will then explain what your project requires.

We include 2 revision rounds with photo retouching and with every film or video edit. These rounds can cover colour correction, picking images, crops, the order of cuts, timing, captions and music. If a change needs new footage, such as another model, a different location or styling, styles that were not on set, or fresh angles, we have to plan a new shoot because an edit cannot cover it. For branding, we give you 2 logo concepts, and you get 1 revision round on the one you pick. When we build your store, you get 2 rounds of changes before we hand it over.

Once the project is paid, you receive unlimited commercial usage rights to the final photos and videos for your online store, social channels, paid advertising and retailer or wholesale partners, with no time or territory limit. We obtain signed model releases covering all these uses before every shoot, and we use only royalty-free music licensed for commercial and paid social use.

The launch service suits first-time founders with no brand assets, who can use the full brief-to-launch package, as well as established labels adding a new swim line, who can pick only the parts they need. Both start-ups and established international brands use one team with us for development, sampling, production and launch.

Our service ends at the launch step, when we hand over your finished assets and your store ready to take orders. Advertising setup, campaign management and social publishing are not included, and you or your marketing team run them using the files we deliver.

A full launch costs more or less depending on the number of styles, the shoot locations and models, how many photos and film edits you order, video running length, branding scope, packaging items and how complex your store is. On the production side, design complexity, premium versus standard fabrics, order quantity and choosing custom designs over our catalogue styles also change the total.

When you enquire, we assign a dedicated swimwear specialist to your project as your single point of contact across production, the shoot, branding and the store build. A merchandiser tracks your order through sampling and bulk production with photo updates at each stage, and you deal directly with our design and production teams, with no agents in between.

pages.meta_description: Work directly with your swimwear factory. Strandmill owns its Guangzhou factory, with design, sampling, production and export handled under one roof.
pages.h1: About Us: Strandmill's Own Guangzhou Factory
pages.hero_lead: Since 2011 we have run bulk lines of about 100,000 pieces a month alongside a 65-person sampling studio, so your collection gets its own development capacity at any order size.

sections.heading: What We Make In-House and How Much Each Month
sections.body: We make about 100,000 swimwear pieces a month in bulk, so we take on everything from small runs to large-volume orders. Our 65-person sampling studio works alongside the bulk lines and turns out about 55 custom samples a day. That gives your collection its own development capacity.

sections.heading: Our Story: One Guangzhou Factory Since 2011
sections.body: We've made swimwear in our own single factory in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China, since 2011. We're one company that owns its factory and runs both production and export, so quality, cost and delivery stay under our direct control.

sections.heading: The Brands We Work With Directly
sections.body: Every year we make samples and bulk orders for more than 350 brands, with design, production and private labelling for clients from small businesses to large enterprises.

items.title: First-time and emerging brands
items.text: If you're a founder, we help you turn your ideas into specifications. We work with private-label start-ups and with emerging bikini labels that are planning seasonal online launches.

items.title: Established and apparel labels
items.text: We produce to your tech packs. We work with swimwear, resort, fashion and activewear labels, and with boutique and apparel brands.

items.title: Retail and trade buyers
items.text: E-commerce swim and sports labels, online retailers, wholesalers and importers work with us on their sampling and bulk orders.

items.title: Specialist organisations
items.text: We also manufacture for swim schools, surf shops, lifeguard programmes, resorts and event organisers who buy directly from our factory.

items.title: Direct business orders
items.text: We sell B2B only, through this website and our team, and we agree every order directly. We don't have an online shop, a third-party marketplace or a platform store.

sections.heading: Everything Under One Roof, From Pattern to Carton
sections.body:
The pattern maker and team who make your sample also make its bulk adjustments. That way one team handles fit corrections from the first pattern to the sealed carton. We do design development, digital patterning, fabric sourcing, sampling, printing, embroidery, cutting, sewing, hardware, accessories, labels, finishing, packing and export shipping ourselves. No stage goes to an outside workshop.

When you buy from us, you buy from the factory that sews your swimwear.

sections.heading: Order Minimums for Small and Growing Labels
sections.body:
Orders start at 50 pieces per style in each colour. For your first trial order, we agree the quantity with you case by case, within our production limits.

Small or complex runs go on flexible setups, and high-volume repeat styles go on dedicated bulk lines. Our experienced technicians run modern, automated cutting and sewing machinery around the clock, including flatlock machines and sublimation printers. Production follows ethical labour standards. If you're an established label, you get dedicated project management.

sections.heading: How an Order Moves From Sample to Shipment
sections.body: [OEM and ODM development](/development/) starts from your design or idea; samples take 10 to 15 days and cost USD 50 plus USD 50 a design.

items.title: Final sample approval
items.text: You approve the final sample in the actual bulk fabric, colour and print. That signed-off piece becomes the sealed production reference.

items.title: Order confirmation
items.text: We take a 50% deposit when you confirm your order. Bulk production starts once you've approved the sample and we've received that deposit.

items.title: Bulk production
items.text: Bulk production takes 35 to 40 days. Your order size and the season set the exact timing.

items.title: Reference-led production
items.text: Cutting, stitching, assembly and finishing follow the approved sample under controlled production standards. We check fit, construction and finish the whole way through, and sizing stays consistent across repeat orders.

items.title: Balance payment
items.text: You pay the remaining 50% before shipment, so your confirmed order is fully paid before the goods leave.

items.title: Shipment terms
items.text: We ship FOB, CIF or DDP. With worldwide DDP you get one all-in price for delivery to your door, and we handle duties, customs and freight.

sections.heading: How We Check Quality at Every Stage

items.title: Checks throughout production
items.text: Our structured QC system covers incoming fabric, cutting and sewing. We also run random checks and finish with a full final inspection.

items.title: Every piece inspected
items.text: Before packing, we check every bulk piece for measurements, size tolerance, symmetry, seam strength and comfort, stretch recovery, colour consistency, print clarity, and wires and straps.

items.title: Agreed inspection criteria
items.text: We inspect bulk against your approved sample and the tolerances we've agreed with you in writing. Before shipment, we send you the final inspection report so you can decide whether to release the goods.

items.title: Consistent bulk finish
items.text: Every piece gets export-standard stitching and finishing, whatever the size of your order. We check that colour stays uniform across the whole run and matches across fabric, lining and trims.

items.title: Materials and results
items.text: We use quality yarn and fabric, aim for zero defects on every order and keep our qualification rate above 99%.

items.title: Experienced inspection team
items.text: Our dedicated QC team has more than 10 years of inspection experience and oversees every run. If you ask, they'll provide remote quality checks, video inspections or goods presentations.

sections.heading: Certifications and Compliance Paperwork
sections.body: We ask for your target market when we quote. That way we pick fabrics, trims, labels and tests that meet its rules from the start.

items.title: Certifications held
items.text: Our production holds OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for tested fabrics and trims, GRS and RCS for recycled fabrics, bluesign for chemistry, ISO 9001 for quality management and WRAP for social compliance. Our factory is also BSCI certified, and we meet GB 18401 and REACH requirements.

items.title: Production audit requirements
items.text: Our production is audited against CPSIA, CCPSA and SASO requirements. Every stage, from fabric to finished garment, follows international quality-system certification standards.

items.title: Market compliance paperwork
items.text: We give you complete paperwork and test reports to support your market's regulations. Our certifications back shipments to Australia, the EU, the US, the Middle East and other regions.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions

qa.question: Who runs the company, and which managers will we be dealing with directly?
qa.answer: We run the company ourselves, and production and export sit under one management. You work with a dedicated swimwear specialist and a merchandiser. We own our single swimwear factory in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China, and it has been running since 2011. We assign your specialist when you enquire. Your merchandiser tracks sampling and bulk production and sends you photo updates at each stage. You deal directly with our design and production teams, and there are no agents in between. Every quotation and pro-forma invoice shows our registered company name and full factory address. If the company name on the pro-forma invoice matches the bank beneficiary, you know you're dealing with us directly.

qa.question: Do you have your own designers and pattern makers in-house to develop our styles?
qa.answer: Yes. Our in-house designers and pattern makers handle pattern design, grading and fit development for your styles. Because this work stays within our team, you avoid rounds of back-and-forth on the design.

qa.question: Can we visit your factory, or get a video tour, before we place an order?
qa.answer: Yes. You're welcome to visit our production floor or book a live video tour before you place an order. You can also visit or arrange a live video audit during sampling or bulk production. If you can't come in person, we show you around the factory on a live video call as an online audit.

qa.question: How quickly will someone reply to my message, and is it slower on weekends or holidays?

Our factory closes for about 3 weeks over Chinese New Year and for 7 days during National Day week (1 to 7 October), and production timelines move back by the same amount of time. If you need bulk shipment before Chinese New Year, place your order at least 8 weeks before the holiday. If you approve just before a closure, your delivery is delayed by more than the approval time itself.

You are welcome to visit our own factory in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China, in person during development or mass production, and the sample room there shows our in-stock styles and fabric swatches; book your visit at least 5 business days ahead by email or WhatsApp. If you cannot travel, we show you around the production floor on a live video call instead.
Both OEM and ODM work is possible: a new style can start from your own design, a picture or just an idea.
We quote first: once the price is agreed, we move on to making the sample.

pages.hero_lead: Before you write to us, find answers on samples, minimums, lead times, payment, inspection and shipping terms, from the team that replies to every enquiry within one business day.

sections.heading: Strandmill at a Glance
sections.body: We make your swimwear ourselves, in our own single factory in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China. Production and export are handled within one company, so quality, cost and delivery stay under our direct control. Your brief goes through sampling and approval, then into production, inspection and shipment. We reply to every enquiry within one business day.

visuals.caption: How a typical order runs

items.detail: Sample ready in 10 to 15 days.

items.detail: You approve the sample and pay the deposit.

items.detail: 35 to 40 days, depending on order size and season.

sections.heading: Our Background & How We Sell
sections.body: We sell only to brands that hold and ship their own stock, so your warehouse or third-party fulfilment partner needs to be ready before delivery. We don't dropship, and we don't fulfil marketplace or web-store orders. We sell only through our website and our team. We have no online or marketplace shop, and we agree every order with you directly. Our [factory background](/about-us/) goes back to 2011.

We keep our private-label clients anonymous. To give you a client reference, we need that client's written consent. If they consent, you get the reference within 5 business days of your request. While you wait, we offer you our catalogue and available garments from earlier production runs, so you can handle and test them yourself.

sections.heading: OEM, ODM & Design Confidentiality

items.title: Confidential design files
items.text: We sign your NDA or cooperation agreement before we receive any files. We keep those files restricted to your company account, and we protect your designs, prints, patterns, brand and ideas.

items.title: Your patterns and brand
items.text: We use the patterns you supply only for your company, and we never reveal your brand without your approval.

items.title: OEM and ODM development
items.text: A style starts from your design, a picture or an idea. Our in-house team handles pattern design, grading and fit development, which cuts down the design back-and-forth.

sections.heading: Stock Styles & Wholesale Buying

items.title: Stock wholesale styles
items.text: As well as making to order, we keep some styles in stock for wholesale buyers.

items.title: Check before branding
items.text: Before you pick ready-to-brand styles, you check fabric hand-feel and fit on up to three garments from earlier runs. Any preprinted samples we have ship within 1 to 2 business days.

items.title: Wholesale access
items.text: Send your enquiry through the form on our website or by email, and we agree every order with you directly.

sections.heading: Pricing & Quotes

items.title: Individual style pricing
items.text: We don't publish prices online. We quote from your spec sheets, detailed photos or reference images.

items.title: Construction and materials
items.text: Your price depends on the style's complexity, coverage, fabric, lining, print method and any custom printing.

items.title: Branding and quantity
items.text: Labels, branding, packaging and order quantity also set the cost. We confirm bulk pricing once we've reviewed your design and the fabric you've chosen.

items.title: Factory-level costs
items.text: Our private-label and wholesale prices reflect direct production, buying materials in bulk and efficient manufacturing.

items.title: Volume discounts
items.text: The more pieces you order, the lower your per-unit cost, and that includes custom embroidered pieces. For 3,000 pieces or more, you get a custom quote at our best pricing.

items.title: Quote before sampling
items.text: With our [quotation process](/request-a-quote/), we agree the price with you before we make your sample.

sections.heading: Fabrics & Materials
sections.body: Our [swimwear fabrics and sourcing](/swimwear-fabrics-sourcing/) range covers nylon or polyester blended with spandex, including 80% nylon / 20% spandex with matching linings. On top of that there's chlorine-resistant LYCRA Xtra Life, recycled ECONYL nylon, recycled REPREVE polyester and Italian Carvico fabrics, which we source on request.

visuals.purpose: Shows the fibre make-up of a typical swimwear fabric blend.

sections.heading: Samples: Timing, Fees & Delivery
sections.body: Your standard sample takes 10 to 15 days, and DHL delivers it to your door in 5 to 7 days. Each sample costs USD 50, plus a USD 50 design fee per design that covers its pattern or print in all colourways. Neither fee is refunded or credited against bulk. Courier delivery is another USD 50.

visuals.purpose: Shows how long sample making and DHL delivery take, so buyers can plan sample approval.
visuals.caption: Sample timing

visuals.purpose: Shows the sample-stage fees, none of which are refunded or credited against the bulk order.
visuals.caption: Sample-stage fees (not refunded or credited)

sections.heading: Minimum Order Quantities

items.title: Starting minimum
items.text: Swimwear orders start at 50 pieces per style in each colour. That suits small and growing labels launching a capsule or testing their market.

items.title: Sizes and bikini counting
items.text: You split each style-and-colour minimum across 3 to 4 sizes. A bikini top and bottom together count as one piece.

items.title: Fabric minimums
items.text: Imported or custom-dyed fabrics carry their own mill minimums in metres, which we check before costing; the garment minimum stays 50 pieces per style in each colour. We agree first-trial quantities with you case by case, within our production limits.

items.title: Matching accessories
items.text: Bucket hats, scrunchies and headbands also start at 50 pieces per style per colour. We cut them from your swimwear fabric or print.

items.title: First collection planning
items.text: If you build your first range around a few core styles with matching accessories, it stays within our low per-colour minimums.

items.title: Ready-made and couple styles
items.text: You can order our ready-made designs without a tech pack. Matching couple sets also start at a low minimum.

items.title: Resort piece minimums
items.text: The same minimum applies even when a piece has embroidery, special washes, unusual construction, mixed fabrics and prints, or private-label details.

items.title: Fabric and print support
items.text: We help you balance fabric stretch against durability, and we guide the printing on swimwear that carries your own label and logo.

items.title: Growing production volumes
items.text: We take on boutique batches, small team orders and large retail programmes, and your sizing stays consistent as your volumes grow.

items.title: Combined order planning
items.text: You can mix sizes and colours within one order. Your quantities decide which styles we combine, and we plan production around your requirements.

items.title: Mixed carton ratios
items.text: We pack your size split at no extra cost, including mixed age ratios for children's swimwear.

items.title: Standard size split
items.text: Our S:M:L:XL ratio is 1:2:2:1, for example 2 S, 4 M, 4 L and 2 XL.

items.title: Even carton quantities
items.text: If you order each size in multiples of 5 or 6, your cartons pack evenly.

items.title: Larger size split
items.text: For a larger-size assortment, we propose 4 each of L, XL and 2XL per carton.

sections.heading: Bulk Production Lead Times
sections.body: Once you've paid your deposit, we schedule bulk production based on your signed-off sample and specifications. Order size and season affect timing. So do design complexity, sample revisions, material availability, washing, customisation, our production schedule and holidays. If you lock your specifications early and allow time for fabric sourcing and holidays, all of this fits into your launch plan.

visuals.caption: From sign-off to bulk production

items.detail: You approve the sample, fit, fabrics and technical details.

items.label: Lead time confirmed
items.detail: We confirm your exact lead time with the order.

items.label: Deposit received
items.detail: Bulk starts once the deposit is received.

items.label: Bulk production
items.detail: Usually 35 to 40 days, depending on order size and season.

sections.heading: Order Confirmation & Scheduling

items.title: Agree commercial details
items.text: Before you confirm the order, our sales team goes over price, quantity and delivery time with you and gives you a detailed production schedule.

items.title: Confirm production details
items.text: Once your sample is approved, we confirm specifications, colours, size ratio, packaging, quantity and schedule with you before bulk starts.

items.title: Confirm and queue
items.text: When you give final approval on the prototype, you can confirm the bulk order. We then handle purchase orders strictly in the order we receive them.

items.title: Control subsequent changes
items.text: Your approved sample and confirmed specification sheet are the only references we use for bulk. Any change after confirmation becomes a revision with a new schedule.

items.title: Track delivery dates
items.text: Our merchandisers track progress against your confirmed delivery date, and if a delay comes up, they tell you within 2 business days.

sections.heading: Priority & Rush Orders
sections.body: If you produce with us every month, you get scheduling priority. If your launch is time-critical, give us an early forecast so we book your production slot instead of relying on rush production. We accept a rush order when the product, quantity, artwork and our available workload capacity allow it. We quote the surcharge as a percentage of order value; you pay it in full with your 50% deposit.

sections.heading: Repeat Orders & Restocks
sections.body: We keep your approved designs, patterns, artwork and production specifications, so your restocks match earlier deliveries. Reorder under the same style references and list any changes in writing. We store leftover components free and use them first on your next run. Approved repeat styles skip sampling: bulk takes 35 to 40 days after deposit. A style needing a new mould or print adds 2 to 3 weeks.

sections.heading: Quality Control & Inspections

items.title: In-house quality checks
items.text: We check your incoming fabric, then cutting and sewing, then run random checks and a full final inspection.

items.title: Your chosen inspector
items.text: Before shipment, you can inspect the goods yourself or appoint an independent inspector such as SGS or BV.

items.title: Inspection arrangements
items.text: Book any third-party inspection before you pay the balance, and agree the inspection standard and checklist with us in advance.

sections.heading: Test Reports & Certifications
sections.body:
Check your market's and retailers' testing requirements before sampling. Our available reports name the fabric, trim or hardware that was tested. They don't cover your specific style unless that style was tested. When your ordered styles, colours and trims need reports, we arrange testing at an accredited lab and share the results with you before bulk. Lab fees are charged at cost on your balance invoice.

Our [production certifications](/sustainability/) cover OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for tested fabrics and trims, GRS and RCS for recycled fabrics, bluesign for chemistry, ISO 9001 for quality management and WRAP for social compliance.

sections.heading: Payment Terms & Shipping Options
sections.body: You pay a 50% deposit when you confirm your order and the other 50% before we ship, both by T/T bank transfer in USD or EUR. Put your order number in the transfer reference, and once you've paid, send us the bank remittance slip. For samples and courier charges, you can also pay by PayPal.

visuals.purpose: Shows how the order value is split between the deposit and the balance.
visuals.caption: Payment split

sections.body: We ship on FOB, CIF or DDP terms. Our DDP service covers destinations worldwide: you pay one all-in price for delivery to your door, and we handle the duties, customs and freight for you.

We can arrange shipping and logistics for your order, or you can arrange them yourself. Freight pricing depends on your destination and order size. If you ask for freight alongside your goods quote, you get the full delivered cost to compare, and it's clear who pays each charge under the delivery terms we agree.

We measure your packed cartons, then choose sea, air, rail or express based on actual weight, volume and urgency. Our planning guide puts air express quickest below 100 kg and sea freight economical at around 300 kg. We ship by express carriers such as DHL and FedEx. We ship regularly to the US, EU, UK and Australia. We email you the courier tracking link within a few hours of collection.

sections.heading: Customs & Export Documents
sections.body: Before dispatch, send us your consignee details and certificate requirements, so our export documents match what you need at import. Our shipping department handles the customs declaration, and declaration plus dispatch takes 4 to 7 days. We prepare your commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin and the other customs documents your shipment requires. That includes compliance paperwork for children's products when your order needs it. You get complete export documentation for every freight mode.

sections.heading: Dispatch & Delivery to Your Door
sections.body: Before we pack, confirm your discharge port, delivery address or fulfilment centre, so the carton labels, marks and pallet builds meet your receiver's requirements. We film-wrap your cartons to protect them in transit. As soon as production and packing are finished, we dispatch straight from our factory on the schedule you agreed and give you an estimated delivery timeline. Every shipment is tracked from departure through to arrival.

sections.heading: Send Us Your Enquiry
sections.body: Send us your brief, tech pack or reference images. We reply within one business day, review your requirements and quote before moving to sampling once you agree the price.

cta.label: Ask us a question

facts.text: We manufacture swimwear ourselves in a single factory of our own in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China.
Production and export sit in one company that owns its factory, so quality, cost and delivery stay under our direct control.

A typical order moves from your brief or tech pack to a sample in 10 to 15 days, then to your approval and deposit, 35 to 40 days of bulk production depending on size and season, a full final inspection, and shipment on FOB, CIF or DDP terms.
We reply to every enquiry within one business day.

We are a business-to-business manufacturer: this website and our own team are our only sales channels. We have no online shop and no store on any third-party marketplace or platform, and every order is agreed directly with our team.
We do not dropship, and we are not set up for marketplace or web-store fulfilment.
The factory has been running since 2011.

We keep private-label clients anonymous, so we put you in touch with a client reference only once that client has given written consent, usually within 5 business days of your request. Meanwhile we can send our catalogue and up to three garments from earlier production runs, usually within 1 to 2 business days, subject to availability.
Both OEM and ODM work is possible: a new style can start from your own design, a picture or just an idea.
An in-house design team handles pattern design, grading and fit development, which saves you rounds of back-and-forth on the design.

We keep your designs, prints, patterns, brand name and ideas confidential, and we use the patterns you provide only for your company. We never reveal your brand without your approval and we keep private label clients anonymous. We will sign an NDA or cooperation agreement with you.
Alongside made-to-order production, some styles are held in stock for wholesale buyers.
Before you order, we can send you up to three garments from earlier production runs, and preprinted samples usually go out in 1 to 2 business days, subject to availability.
You do not need a business licence to buy wholesale from us. Send your enquiry through the form on this website or by email, and we agree every order with you directly.

We do not list prices online. Each style is priced from your spec sheets, detailed photos or reference images. The quote depends on the style and how complex its construction is, the level of coverage, the fabric and lining, the print method and any custom printing, your labels, branding and packaging, and the quantity you order. We confirm the bulk price after reviewing your design and fabric choice, and you pay factory-direct prices.
Since you deal directly with our production floor, private label and wholesale orders are priced at factory level, helped by our bulk material purchasing and efficient production.
Larger orders get volume discounts, including custom embroidered pieces. Your per-unit cost falls as quantity rises, and orders of 3,000+ pieces get a custom quote at our best pricing.
We quote first: once the price is agreed, we move on to making the sample.

We make swimwear from nylon and polyester swimwear fabrics blended with spandex, such as 80% nylon 20% spandex, with matching linings. On request we source chlorine-resistant LYCRA Xtra Life, recycled nylon such as ECONYL, recycled polyester such as REPREVE, and Italian Carvico fabrics.
A standard sample is ready in 10 to 15 days.
Each sample costs USD 50, and the design fee is USD 50 per design (its pattern or print, with all colourways); these fees are not refunded or credited against the bulk order.
Courier delivery of samples costs USD 50, paid by the buyer in addition to the sample fee.
We send samples to your door by DHL, and they arrive within 5 to 7 days.
Import duties in your country may apply when samples arrive.
Orders start at 50 pieces per style in each colour, a level set so that small and growing labels can order.
A first trial run is agreed case by case, and we are as flexible on its quantity as production allows.

Custom bucket hats, scrunchies and headbands start at 50 pieces per style in each colour, the same as our swimwear. Each can be cut from the fabric or print of your swimwear so the accessories match your range.

Within each style and colour, the minimum can be split over 3 to 4 sizes, and a bikini top plus its bottom counts as a single piece. The exact minimum for a given style may vary with the fabric and print method you pick. You can order our ready-made designs without a tech pack, and matching couple sets also start at a low minimum. Resort pieces carry the same minimum even when they need embroidery, special washes, unusual construction, a mix of fabrics and prints, or private-label details. This lets start-ups and boutique labels test the market, launch a small capsule or brand swimwear with their own label and logo, while we help you choose a fabric blend that balances stretch with durability and walk you through the printing process.
We are open to negotiating MOQ.

We take orders of every size, from small batches for boutique labels and small team orders up to high-volume bulk runs for large retail programmes. As your volumes grow, we can move you on to larger bulk production with the same consistent sizing. Depending on the quantities, you can combine several styles in one order, and we plan production flexibly around what you need.

You can mix sizes and colours within one order, and mixed size ratios in each carton come at no extra cost; our usual split is S:M:L:XL at 1:2:2:1, for example 2 S, 4 M, 4 L and 2 XL, and for kids' swimwear we can also pack mixed age ratios per carton. Please grade bulk quantities by size in multiples such as 5, 10, 15, 20 or 6, 12, 18, 24. If you need larger sizes, we recommend 4 L, 4 XL and 4 2X.
Once the sample is approved and the deposit received, bulk production usually needs 35 to 40 days, depending on order size and season.

Before bulk starts, you sign off the sample along with fit, fabrics and technical details, and we confirm your exact lead time with the order. Beyond order size and season, timing is affected by garment and design complexity, the number of sample revisions, availability of fabric and materials, any washing or customisation, our production schedule and holidays.
Once your sample is approved, we confirm specifications, colours, size ratio, packaging, quantity and schedule with you before bulk production starts.
Our sales team discusses price, quantity and delivery time with you for each order, and you receive a detailed production schedule before the order is confirmed.
We confirm the bulk order once you approve the final prototype. Purchase orders are then handled strictly in the sequence we receive them.
Our merchandising team tracks delivery dates so that your order is finished on time or even early.
Our merchandisers track your confirmed delivery date and tell you within 2 business days if a delay comes up.
Brands that produce with us every month get priority in our schedule.

Rush production is possible when our schedule allows, depending on the product, quantity, artwork and our current workload. We quote the rush surcharge per order as a percentage of the order value, and you pay it in full together with the 50% deposit.
We keep your approved designs, patterns, artwork and production specs on file. That makes restocks fast and helps repeat bulk runs match your earlier deliveries.
We store components left over from your order in our warehouse free of charge, ready for your next run.

Repeat orders of approved styles skip sampling and go straight into bulk production, which takes the same 35 to 40 days after your deposit as a first bulk order, depending on order size and season. A first order also includes 10 to 15 days of sampling, and any style that needs a new mould or print needs an extra 2 to 3 weeks.
Quality is checked at every stage of an order: fabric on arrival, cutting, sewing, then random checks and a full final inspection.
Independent inspectors such as SGS or BV are welcome to check the goods before they ship.
Beyond our in-house checks, you are welcome to inspect the goods yourself or to send any inspector you choose, including agencies like ITS, UL or TUV.

Our test reports name the fabric, trim or hardware tested and cover the fabrics and trims tested under our OEKO-TEX Standard 100 certification and our hardware tests; we send them on request, and they do not cover your specific style unless it has been tested. If your market needs reports for the styles, colours and trims you order, we have them tested at an accredited lab and share the report before bulk, with lab fees paid by you at cost on the balance invoice.
Our production holds OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for tested fabrics and trims, GRS and RCS for recycled fabrics, bluesign for chemistry, ISO 9001 for quality management and WRAP for social compliance.
We take a 50% deposit when the order is confirmed, and the remaining 50% is paid before shipment.
You pay both the deposit and the balance by T/T bank transfer in USD or EUR, and samples and courier charges can also be paid by PayPal.
Shipments go out on FOB, CIF or DDP terms; DDP is available worldwide, and under DDP one all-in price covers delivery to your door, with duties, customs and freight handled by us.

We ship to destinations worldwide and can manage all the shipping and logistics for you, finding a global logistics solution that suits your order. We quote freight according to your destination and the size of your order, and we are happy to agree the delivery terms with you. If you would rather arrange the shipping yourself, you can.

We send orders worldwide by sea, air, rail or express courier, using DHL, FedEx, UPS, TNT, EMS and other carriers, and can deliver to any of the roughly 220 countries and territories in the FedEx network; the US, the EU, the UK and Australia are regular destinations for us. As a rule of thumb, air express is usually quickest for loads below 100 kg, and sea freight starts to pay off at around 300 kg. For courier orders, the carrier picks up your packed goods and brings them to whatever address you give us, and we email you the tracking number and online link within a few hours of collection.

Our shipping department takes care of customs declaration, and declaration together with dispatch normally takes 4 to 7 days. We prepare the commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin and every other customs document, plus compliance paperwork for children's products when it is needed, and complete export documents are available whichever freight mode you use. We also advise you on the best way to move your bulk order, and you can follow it with tracking from the day it leaves us until it reaches you.
We ship every order straight from our factory. We wrap the cartons in film to protect them in transit.

When bulk production and packing are complete, we send your goods out without delay on the schedule agreed with you, give you an estimated delivery timeline, and ship anywhere in the world: to your discharge port, your own address or directly to your fulfilment centre. Every shipment carries tracking.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions

qa.question: Can you show examples of swimwear you've made for brands selling in Europe or North America?
qa.answer: Yes. Every year we make samples and bulk orders for more than 350 brands, and some of those labels sell in Europe and North America. Here are three recent projects, with client names kept private. A start-up bikini label in the United States came to us with sketches and a mood board for its first collection. Our in-house design team turned them into patterns graded from XS to XL, and the fit samples were ready in 10 to 15 days. The label launched six styles at our 50-piece minimum per style in each colour, shipped them DDP to its warehouse and reordered its two best sellers the next season. A swim school in Canada needed chlorine-resistant training suits in its club colours, with its logo printed and sizes from children's to adult. We matched the club colours to its Pantone references, sublimated the logo on chlorine-resistant polyester and packed mixed sizes in each carton at no extra cost. Bulk took 35 to 40 days after sample approval, and the approved style now repeats without a new sample. A plus-size swimwear label in Germany moved a range to us after cups gaped and straps dug in on its previous factory's run. We redrafted the styles on a 2XL base, wet-tested the samples on a 2XL fit model and graded them up to 5XL. An SGS inspector checked the bulk before shipment, and the label relaunched the range the following season. For those markets, our production is certified to OEKO-TEX Standard 100, GRS, RCS, bluesign, ISO 9001, WRAP and BSCI. We ship on FOB, CIF or DDP terms. If your market requires test reports for the styles you order, we have those styles tested at an accredited lab, and the lab fees go on your balance invoice at cost.

qa.question: Have you ever taken over a production that went wrong at another factory, and what did you do?
qa.answer: Yes. When we take over a run that went wrong at another factory, we find the fault and get a corrected sample approved before bulk production starts again. Most failed runs come from mistakes in the pattern, grading or fit, not from the sewing. If we produce again from the same faulty pattern, the defect comes back at our factory too. Switching factories doesn't fix it on its own. Send us your approved sample or tech pack along with a few of the faulty pieces, and we'll reply within one business day. After we agree on the price, our in-house design team fixes the pattern, grading and fit and makes a new sample in 10 to 15 days. Bulk production then takes 35 to 40 days from when you approve the sample and we receive your deposit, depending on order size and season. The extra sample round means delivery takes longer than just re-running the order. If the original fault was clearly in the fabric or trims and not the fit, that extra round adds little. We also accept fabric and trims you've already bought for the order. We inspect them when they arrive and tell you about any shortages or defects within 3 business days, before cutting.

qa.question: Have you worked with small start-up brands placing their first order, like us?
qa.answer: Yes. We work with new labels on their first order, and we offer a starter pack and separate startup packages for your first collection. The starter pack contains three finished samples, twenty fabric swatches, a catalogue of the ready-made styles we keep in stock and a short guide to launching your own swimwear brand. The startup packages cover design, development and manufacturing. Many new labels combine these packages with our consulting service. The starter pack and the startup packages are offered separately.

qa.question: Can I speak to one of the brands you've worked with as a reference?
qa.answer: Yes, but only once that client has given written consent. When they do, we put you in touch within 5 business days of your request. We keep our private-label clients anonymous, and that includes brands whose failed production runs we've taken over. So we never share a reference contact without permission. In the meantime, we can send you our catalogue and up to three garments from earlier production runs within 1 to 2 business days, depending on availability.
