sections.heading: Recycled Fabrics and Low-Impact Production
sections.body: We start by matching recycled fabrics to the stretch, hand feel, print and colour your swimwear needs. Then we source options that suit your design and budget.

items.title: Regenerated Fibre Performance
items.text: Waste such as plastic items and old carpets is cleaned, sorted, liquefied and reformed, then made into fabric. Regenerated fibre performs much like new fibre. Any difference in performance comes from the fibre type and the way the fabric is constructed, not from the fibre being recycled.

items.title: Sustainable Fabric Choices
items.text: On request, we source ECONYL regenerated nylon, including Italian Carvico ECONYL fabrics, REPREVE recycled polyester and 84/16 recycled polyester-spandex. We also offer organic and other sustainable fabrics, and we source these only from certified material suppliers.

items.title: Requested Fabrics And Trade-offs
items.text: If you ask, we source imported GRS- or OEKO-TEX-certified recycled fabrics, regenerated Lycra, and waste-regenerated fabrics coloured with OEKO-TEX-certified dyes. Branded or imported certified options cost more and come in fewer colours with less stock, so a tight budget or deadline narrows your choice.

items.title: Swimwear Fabric Construction
items.text: We make your swimwear in nylon or polyester blended with spandex, such as 80% nylon 20% spandex, with matching linings. Chlorine-resistant LYCRA Xtra Life is available if you ask for it.

items.title: Production And Waste
items.text: We use water-saving, low-carbon production processes, manage production waste strictly and follow carbon-neutral packaging strategies. Choosing recycled polyester helps your line cut plastic waste.

items.title: Animal-free Production
items.text: Our production carries PETA's 'Cruelty Free' stamp and the 'PETA-Approved Vegan' logo, and our process involves no animal testing.

items.title: Retail-ready Packaging Service
items.text: Through our [Swimwear Packaging & Custom Brand Labels](/swimwear-packaging-custom-brand-labels/) service, you get retail-ready biodegradable packaging, branded accessories and logos heat-pressed inside, plus optional cardboard tags, connectors and individual hand-wrapping. We make labels and packaging in-house wherever we can.

items.title: Sample Development Costs
items.text: A standard [development sample](/development/) is ready in 10 to 15 days and costs USD 50 each. On top of that, you pay USD 50 per design, meaning each pattern or print, with all its colourways included. Neither fee is refunded or credited against your bulk order.

sections.heading: Our Certifications, Audits and Transaction Certificates
sections.body: Our [ordering terms](/faq/) start at 50 pieces per style in each colour, with 35 to 40 days of bulk production and FOB, CIF or DDP shipping.

items.title: Production Standards
items.text: We hold OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for tested fabrics and trims, bluesign for chemistry, ISO 9001 for quality management and WRAP for social compliance.

items.title: Fabric-specific Certification
items.text: We hold GRS and RCS for recycled fabrics, and we supply GRS documentation, including for recycled polyester. Certified options are available on request, and your fabric determines which certificates apply.

items.title: Shipment-level Recycled Claims
items.text: If your order uses GRS- or RCS-certified fabric, ask for a transaction certificate when you confirm the order. We then apply for the shipment-specific evidence of recycled-content percentage that retailers and labelling rules require. This goes beyond what mill certificates show.

items.title: Transaction Certificate Costs
items.text: We pass on the certification body's fee at cost on your balance invoice. The extra paperwork takes time, so if your line makes no recycled-content claims, you don't need to pay for this.

items.title: Fibre-brand Trademark Approval
items.text: Before you put ECONYL or REPREVE hangtags and logos on your labels, the fibre brand has to give trademark approval. Starting early gives the approval time to come through, and we provide the mill application documents.

items.title: Certificate Copies
items.text: Our factory is BSCI certified. When you ask, we email you certificate copies within 1 business day, each showing the certificate number and validity date.

items.title: Buyer-appointed Factory Audits
items.text: We accept factory and social-compliance audits by any auditor you appoint, as long as you give us 14 days' notice. You pay the audit fee.

items.title: Audit Summary Access
items.text: Under an NDA, we share summaries of our latest WRAP and BSCI audits with you.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions

qa.question: Can you measure the carbon footprint of our order and share it with us?
qa.answer: Yes, we can prepare a carbon footprint estimate per piece and for your whole bulk swimwear order. It covers fabric, the energy used for cutting and sewing in our factory, packaging, and freight to your destination under your FOB, CIF or DDP terms. We calculate it with GHG Protocol emission factors, and we use fabric mill data wherever the mill provides it. You get a PDF report within 10 business days after shipment. Please note that this is our own calculation, not a figure verified by an outside party.

qa.question: Can you take back fabric offcuts or old swimwear for recycling?
qa.answer: Yes. We sort the nylon, polyester and spandex offcuts from your orders by fibre and send them to a textile recycling partner, who turns them into fibre or filling. If you ask, we report the recycled weight for each order. We also take old swimwear from your brand's collection programme. It has to arrive at our factory in batches of at least 20 kg, and we pass it on to the same recycling partner.

qa.question: Do you use plastic-free or recycled packaging and polybags when you ship our goods?
qa.answer: We offer biodegradable and recyclable bags. Our biodegradable corn-starch bags compost in industrial composting facilities within about 180 days. They don't break down in home compost or landfill. Our eco zip-lock bags with biodegradable cornstarch can be recycled wherever soft-plastic (LDPE 4) collection is accepted. Which claim applies depends on how your customers can dispose of the bag. We supply material supplier data for both bags. That data covers only the bag material, not the printed finished pack. You need to check any claim about disposing of the whole pack against your market's rules. We only print wording that you've approved in writing.

qa.question: Do you subcontract any sewing or printing, and are those workshops held to the same standards as your own factory?
qa.answer: No. We do [all sewing, printing and other production under one roof](/about-us/), and no stage goes to an outside workshop.

As a [factory-owned B2B business](/about-us/), we keep production and export within one company, so quality, cost and delivery stay under our direct control. qa.question: Which currency do you quote in, and does the price include shipping and import duties?

qa.question: How long is the quoted price valid, and can it change before bulk production?

qa.question: Will you sign an NDA and keep the designs we send confidential?

qa.answer: You pay both the 50% deposit and the remaining 50% balance by T/T bank transfer in USD or EUR. The deposit is due when your order is confirmed, and the balance is due before shipment. For sample fees and courier charges, you can also pay by PayPal.

pages.h1: Swimwear Accessories Manufacturer for Your Brand
pages.hero_lead: Send us a tech pack, CAD file, sample or sketch, or just your brand goals, and our specialists recommend options balancing cost, durability and appearance for your market and price tier.

sections.heading: OEM Swimwear Accessories from Your Tech Pack, Sample or Sketch
sections.body: Send us a tech pack, CAD file, physical sample, sketch or visual reference, and we develop your swimwear accessories from it. If all you have so far is your brand goals, we build the brief around your target market, positioning and pricing tier. Our product specialists then recommend options that balance cost, durability and appearance against your concept and your target price.

sections.heading: Wholesale Accessory Minimums, Trial Runs and Payment Terms

items.title: Standalone orders
items.text: You can order accessories without ordering swimwear. Minimums start at 50 pieces per style in each colour, and that includes finished bucket hats and scrunchies.

items.title: Focused first range
items.text: Your first range starts with a few core styles in your best-selling colours. More colours come once sell-through has proven them.

sections.heading: Our Accessories Factory in Guangzhou, China
sections.body: We make swimwear ourselves in our one factory in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China.

items.title: Production standards
items.text: Our production holds [OEKO-TEX Standard 100, GRS, RCS, bluesign, ISO 9001 and WRAP](/sustainability/) certification.

items.title: Direct factory control
items.text: With our [factory ownership](/about-us/), production and export stay inside one company, so we have direct control over your quality, cost and delivery.

items.title: In-house development
items.text: Our [design team](/development/) does pattern design, grading and fit development in-house, so you go through fewer rounds of design back-and-forth.

items.title: Contact our team
items.text: [Contact us](/contact-us/) by email, WhatsApp or our website form. We reply within one business day.

sections.heading: Sample Fees, Lead Times and Production Timeline

items.title: Brief and fees
items.text: You send us your brief or tech pack. Each sample costs USD 50, plus USD 50 per design for its pattern or print, which covers all colourways. Neither fee is refunded or credited.

items.title: Sample review
items.text: Your standard sample is ready in 10 to 15 days, and you review it before you approve bulk production.

items.title: Bulk production
items.text: Once you approve the sample and we receive your deposit, bulk production takes 35 to 40 days, depending on order size and season.

items.title: Final inspection
items.text: We do a full final inspection, and then your completed order goes to shipment under the shipping terms you agreed.

sections.heading: Shipping Terms: FOB, CIF and DDP

items.title: Shipping options
items.text: We ship FOB, CIF or DDP. With worldwide DDP, you get one all-in price for delivery to your door, and we handle freight, customs and duties.

items.title: Detailed quotation
items.text: Once we have your complete design information, meaning front-and-back images, tech packs or clear drawings, we send your [quotation](/request-a-quote/) within 2 to 3 working days. It covers everything from sampling through production to shipping.

items.title: Reporting deadline
items.text: Under our [order terms](/terms-and-conditions/), you have 7 days from receiving your goods to report any shortages, defects, late-delivery damages or returns to us in writing.

sections.heading: Private Label Woven, Satin and Size Labels

items.title: Brand and care labels
items.text: We pair your custom woven brand labels with separate soft satin care labels, which we place away from sensitive skin. We also add clearly printed size labels in standard or custom sizing.

items.title: Additional personalisation
items.text: To carry your brand beyond the woven label, you can personalise accessories with [embroidery](/swimwear-embroidery/), custom labels or branded packaging.

sections.heading: Custom Metal Hardware, Charms and Finishes

items.title: Exposure and finish
items.text: We pick the base metal and plating to stand up to chlorine and salt water. Our electroplated charms keep their bright finish after saltwater and sun.

items.title: Custom mould fee
items.text: Custom logo hardware has a one-off USD 200 mould development fee, which you pay with your order deposit. Your design sets the unit price.

items.title: Metal and weight
items.text: Brass and stainless steel cost more per piece than zinc alloy, and heavier hardware uses more metal.

items.title: Plating and detail
items.text: Thicker or multi-layer plating and special finishes add to the cost. Fine logos need complex moulds and longer finishing, while simpler detail plates more evenly.

items.title: Hardware range
items.text: Our [Swimwear Hardware](/swimwear-hardware/) range covers metal rings, sliders, buckles and hooks in gold, silver, rose gold or gunmetal, and moulded plastic parts in black, white, clear or Pantone-dyed colours.

items.title: Buyer-supplied trims
items.text: If you supply your own trims, send 2 pieces per item for sample checks. Then send the bulk quantity plus 3% extra at least 7 days before scheduled cutting.

items.title: Hardware safety
items.text: If you need hypoallergenic trims, our Swimwear Hardware metals are lead-free and tested against the EN 1811 nickel-release limit.

items.title: Hardware ordering
items.text: You can have our Swimwear Hardware supplied as part of garment production, or you can buy it separately at its applicable minimum quantities.

sections.heading: Rhinestones, Crystals and Beads for Swimwear

items.title: Decoration choices
items.text: We offer heat-press and sew-on rhinestones and crystals in a range of sizes, colours and patterns. We also offer acrylic, resin, metal and wood beads, including custom-moulded designs matched to your colours.

items.title: Swim-ready materials
items.text: Stainless steel or plated brass beads, resin and acrylic beads, and glass crystals sewn into metal claw settings all hold up to repeated pool and sea use.

items.title: Shore-only materials
items.text: Wood beads, shell pieces and heat-press rhinestones go only on shore-only accessories such as hats and bags; on garments, we sew every stone on by hand. On your trim sheet, we mark every option as swim-ready or shore-only.

items.title: Stretch-safe placement
items.text: We keep dense decoration away from side seams, cup edges and leg openings. We sew small clusters at least 3 mm apart, so the fabric around them still stretches by about 30%.

items.title: Protected skin contact
items.text: We stitch each decoration through soft backing and cover knots and thread ends with the lining. That way nothing rubs the skin or snags nearby fabric.

items.title: Material cost drivers
items.text: Your price is set by complexity, materials, decoration count and order quantity. Glass crystals and metal beads cost more than acrylic or resin, and every extra stone adds material and handwork.

items.title: Labour cost drivers
items.text: Hand sewing takes longer than heat-pressing. Decoration over seams, cups or curves also takes more labour than decoration on flat panels.

sections.heading: Straps and Strings Made to Your Specs
sections.body: You choose the width, stretch, colour and texture of our straps and strings. We then match the construction to the load each one carries: firmer flat or braided straps handle support, and softer ruched or tube straps are mainly decorative.

visuals.purpose: Shows which strap constructions suit load-bearing use and which suit decorative use.
visuals.caption: Choosing strap construction by load

sections.heading: Cups, Underwires, Boning and Silicone Grip
sections.body:
We match your cups, wires or boning and grip tape so they work together as one support system for your style.

| Component | Specification and use |
|---|---|
| Foam cups | Our soft, quick-drying foam cups come in triangle, round and push-up shapes, and you can have them removable or sewn in. |
| Light coverage | 3 mm foam adds almost no bulk. |
| Natural shaping | Moulded cups of 5 to 8 mm give natural shaping. |
| Added lift | Graduated push-up cups are 5 mm at the top edge and 15 mm at the base. |
| Steel underwires | Our nylon-coated stainless steel wires run from size 30 to 46 and cover cup sizes up to G. |
| Flexible wires | Plastic wires are the lighter option for small cups and bandeau styles. |
| Wire protection | The wire ends are capped and sit in padded, double-layer nylon channelling that we stitch closed at both ends, so the wires don't break through or rust in chlorine or salt water. |
| Boning | For bandeau and strapless support, we insert plastic or rubber boning into the side seams or bodice. |
| Silicone grip | Transparent elastic tape stops slipping inside waistbands, chest lines and leg openings. It comes in 6, 10, 15 and 20 mm widths, with full-width silicone, single-stripe, double-stripe, dot or wave patterns. |
| Grip placement | To hold without leaving pressure marks, we use 10 mm striped tape at chest lines, 15 to 20 mm dot tape at waistbands and 6 to 10 mm wave or dot tape at leg openings. |

sections.heading: Hygienic Liners Printed with Your Logo
sections.body: We make your hygienic liners from skin-friendly adhesive materials in a range of shapes and colours, and we match the shape and adhesive to your gusset and fabric. We keep your logo or brand message simple and easy to read. Branded liners are quoted on request. Liners peel off cleanly for up to 12 months in normal storage, and sampling includes an 8-hour wear peel-test.

sections.heading: Eco Packaging Printed With Your Logo

items.title: Your packaging design
items.text: We customise every eco packaging option with your logo and layout. We keep the artwork simple and use only a few print colours, so the packaging stays recyclable and looks the same from order to order.

items.title: Branded bag minimums
items.text: Through our [Swimwear Packaging & Custom Brand Labels](/swimwear-packaging-custom-brand-labels/) service, we print zip-lock bags from 300 pcs with a USD 35 screen fee. Screens for cotton drawstring bags also cost USD 35.

items.title: Wet and dry uses
items.text: For damp suits, we offer ventilated cotton mesh bags and wet/dry bags that are water-resistant but not leakproof. Cotton drawstring, corn-starch and eco zip-lock bags are for dry presentation and shipping.

items.title: Composting and recycling
items.text: Our corn-starch bags break down within about 180 days in industrial composting, but not in home compost or landfill. Eco zip-lock bags have to go to a collection that accepts soft plastic (LDPE 4).

items.title: Disposal claim approval
items.text: Supplier data covers the bag material, not the printed packs. We print only the disposal wording you approve in writing under your market's rules.

sections.heading: Bucket Hats, Hair and Beach Accessories

items.title: Finished accessory range
items.text: We make waterproof bucket hats and swimming scrunchies in durable fabrics with reinforced stitching. We also make hair elastics and adjustable headbands.

items.title: Hat design choices
items.text: Our straw, camo and floral bucket hats come with adjustable chin straps. You can also choose wide-brim, crochet, sports, summer and XXXL designs.

items.title: Waterproof hat construction
items.text: Your waterproof bucket hats have polyester or nylon shells with PU-coated backs and taped seams, so water stays out.

items.title: Sun protection rating
items.text: Hats made with our UPF 50+ fabrics come with AS/NZS 4399 test documentation. The rating applies only to dry, relaxed fabric.

items.title: Head size coverage
items.text: Children's sizes run from 48 to 54 cm, standard adult sizes from 56 to 60 cm and XXXL from 62 to 64 cm. Chin straps or inner drawcords fine-tune the fit.

items.title: Repeated swimming use
items.text: Hats in nylon, polyester and spandex blends, with taped or overlocked seams and soft, unstiffened brims, stand up to repeated pool and sea use when they're rinsed in fresh water and dried afterwards.

items.title: Shore-only hat care
items.text: Natural straw and crochet hats are for the shore only, because soaking weakens their fibres and pulls the crowns out of shape. Each hat's care label matches how it's meant to be used.

sections.heading: Quality Control and Material Safety Testing

items.title: Colour approval
items.text: We check your accessories against swatches from the actual production fabric lot under the same light. We pay particular attention to custom-dyed parts.

items.title: Finish and fit
items.text: We check that matte, glossy and brushed surfaces are even. Then we test each accessory on its own and fitted to the garment, and check colour and finish again.

items.title: Children's safety figures
items.text: For [children's swimwear](/children-s-swimwear-manufacturer/), trims pass 90 N pull tests, pieces for under-3s carry no removable decorations, and metals meet EN 1811 and CPSIA limits: 100 ppm for base metal and 90 ppm for coatings.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions

qa.question: Can you provide a silicone-free grip solution for customers who cannot wear silicone tape?
qa.answer: Yes. We use a textured polyurethane grip print, ribbed or plush-back elastic, or an edge band cut 1 to 2 cm shorter so its tension holds the garment in place. Before bulk production, we sample the option you choose on your style so you can approve the hold.

qa.question: Can you supply latex-free elastic components for accessories intended for latex-sensitive customers?
qa.answer: Yes. For straps, scrunchies, hair elastics and headbands, we use spandex-covered or clear TPU elastic in place of rubber thread. We mark these components as latex-free on your trim sheet and keep them stored separately during production.

qa.question: For children's bucket hats, can you provide breakaway chin straps or strap-free constructions to reduce entanglement risk?
qa.answer: Yes. We fit plastic safety clips that release under about 25 to 45 N. Or we leave the strap off and use an elasticated inner band with an adjustable toggle behind the crown.

qa.question: What usually goes wrong with swimwear accessories, how do you prevent it, and what care instructions should I give my customers?
qa.answer: The main failures are tarnished plating, rust marks, loose stones or beads, and elastic or grip tape that goes slack. Before you sign off bulk, we lacquer plated hardware and soak-test it in salt water for 24 hours, pull-test sewn and heat-pressed stones, and stretch-test elastics and grip tape. Your hangtag or care label tells customers to rinse in cool fresh water after every swim, hand wash with mild soap, dry flat in the shade, and keep away from hot tubs, sunscreen oils and tumble dryers.

qa.question: What bead sizes and bore diameters can you supply to fit my swimwear cords?
qa.answer: We supply beads from 6 mm to 20 mm across, with bore diameters from 2 mm to 5 mm in 2, 3, 4 or 5 mm options. They fit cords from 1.5 mm to 4.5 mm thick. Send us a 20 cm sample of your cord and we match the bore so the beads slide with light friction and stay where you put them.

qa.question: Which accessory choices raise or lower the cost per piece, so I can balance looks against my target price?
qa.answer: Resin or plastic costs less than metal. Stock hardware and beads cost less than custom-moulded parts, and those add a one-off mould fee. Standard gold or silver plating costs less than rose gold, gunmetal or matte black. Heat-press decoration is quicker and cheaper than hand-sewn stones, but it goes on shore-only pieces. Plain liners and packaging cost less than printed ones.

Custom logo hardware carries a one-off USD 200 mould development fee, paid with the order deposit, and its unit price depends on the design. Brass and stainless steel cost more per piece than zinc alloy, and heavier pieces use more metal. Thicker or multi-layer plating and special finishes add cost, and fine logo detail needs a more complex mould and longer finishing.
We supply metal rings, sliders, buckles and hooks for swimwear.
Available finishes include gold, rose gold, silver, matte black, gunmetal and white.

We fit your own branded hardware and trims to your swimwear: send us 2 pieces of each item first so we can check fit and chlorine and salt-water resistance on your sample, then ship the bulk with 3% extra so it reaches our factory at least 7 days before the scheduled cutting date. Our own hardware is supplied as part of garment production and can also be bought on its own at its minimums.
Our metal hardware is lead-free and tested against the EN 1811 nickel-release limit, so it suits customers who need hypoallergenic trims.
Rhinestones and crystal embellishments come in heat-press or sew-on versions, in a range of sizes, colours and patterns.
We offer beads in acrylic, resin, metal and wood, in many shapes, colours and finishes. For branded designs, we can custom-mould beads and colour-match them to your design.

These options hold up to repeated pool and sea use: stainless steel or plated brass beads, resin and acrylic beads, and glass crystals sewn on in metal claw settings. Keep wood beads, shell pieces and heat-press rhinestones to beach and resort accessories. On your trim sheet we mark each option as swim-ready or shore-only.

We keep dense beading and crystals away from the zones that stretch most, such as side seams, cup edges and leg openings. We sew them in small clusters at least 3 mm apart, so the fabric around them still stretches by about 30%. Each piece is stitched through a soft backing, and the knots and thread ends are covered by the lining, so nothing snags nearby fabric or rubs against the skin.

Embellishment cost depends on how complex the design is, which materials you choose, how many decorations there are and how many pieces you order. Glass crystals and metal beads cost more than acrylic or resin, and every extra stone adds material and handwork. Hand sewing takes longer than heat-pressing, and placing decorations over seams, cups or curves takes more labour than placing them on flat panels.
You can specify the width, stretch, colour and texture of our straps and strings, in braided, ruched, flat or tube constructions.
Our swim cups are made from soft, quick-drying foam in triangle, round and push-up shapes, and can be either removable or sewn in.

For light coverage you can choose 3 mm foam cups that add almost no bulk. For natural shaping we offer 5 to 8 mm moulded cups. For added lift, our graduated push-up cups run from 5 mm at the top edge to 15 mm at the base.

For swimwear we use nylon-coated stainless steel underwires in wire sizes 30 to 46, covering cup sizes up to G. For small cups and bandeau styles, flexible plastic wires are a lighter option. Each wire has capped ends and sits in padded, double-layer nylon channelling that is stitched closed at both ends, so it can't work through the fabric or rust in chlorine or salt water.
We can insert plastic or rubber boning into side seams or bodices, which works well for bandeau and strapless styles.
We apply transparent silicone elastic grip tape inside waistbands, along chest lines or at leg openings to stop the garment from slipping.

Our silicone grip tape comes in 6, 10, 15 and 20 mm widths, with full-width silicone or a single-stripe, double-stripe, dot or wave pattern. For good hold without pressure marks, we usually suggest 10 mm striped tape at chest lines, 15 to 20 mm dot-pattern tape at waistbands and 6 to 10 mm wave or dot tape at leg openings.

Our hygienic liners are made with skin-friendly adhesive materials and come in a variety of shapes and colours. We can print them with your logo or a brand message, and we quote branded liners on request.

Our liner adhesive is a low-tack, pressure-sensitive type. Every adhesive we use holds well on the nylon-spandex, polyester-spandex and recycled-nylon linings in our swimwear. We do not advise it on cotton, open mesh or brushed linings. For mesh, crochet, velvet, sequinned or coated surfaces, we suggest a sewn-in gusset instead. In normal storage a liner stays in place for up to 12 months and then peels away cleanly without marking or damaging the fabric. Storing it longer, or above 40°C, can leave adhesive behind on the lining. During sampling we peel-test the liner on your own fabric. This confirms that it lies flat through 8 hours of wear and comes off in one piece, without residue, pilling or colour lift.
Every eco packaging option can be customised with your logo and your preferred layout.
For branded packaging, we can print your logo on zip-lock bags from 300 pcs, with a USD 35 screen fee. A printing screen for cotton drawstring bags also costs USD 35.

For a swimsuit that is still damp after swimming, we suggest our cotton mesh bags with a drawstring or zip. The open weave lets air circulate, so the bag dries fast. Our wet/dry bags are another option, in drawstring and zip styles. They are made of PU-coated fabric with welded seams and have a drainage eyelet at the bottom. A separate compartment keeps wet suits and towels apart from dry things. These bags resist water but are not completely leakproof. Plain cotton, linen and jute bags absorb moisture and dry slowly, so we advise them for presenting dry garments. If you want a cotton bag for wet use, we can add a waterproof inner lining. Our cotton drawstring bags, corn-starch bags and eco zip-lock bags are intended for dry retail presentation and shipping.

Our corn-starch bags are biodegradable and are our compostable option: they break down in industrial composting facilities within about 180 days, but not in home compost or landfill. Our eco zip-lock bags with biodegradable cornstarch are recyclable wherever soft-plastic (LDPE 4) collection is accepted. We supply the material supplier's data for both bags, which covers the bag material rather than the printed finished pack. Disposal claims printed on your packaging, such as 'compostable' or 'recyclable', must follow the rules of your market, and we print only wording you have approved in writing.
Alongside swimwear components, we make finished accessories such as waterproof bucket hats and swimming scrunchies, using durable fabrics and reinforced stitching.
Our straw, camo and floral bucket hats each come with an adjustable chin strap. Other bucket hat concepts include wide-brim, crochet, sports, summer and XXXL designs.

Our waterproof bucket hats have a polyester or nylon shell with a PU-coated back and taped seams. Hats made in our UPF 50+ fabrics carry a rating tested to AS/NZS 4399, which applies to dry, relaxed fabric, and we supply the test documentation. We cover head sizes of 48 to 54 cm for children, 56 to 60 cm for standard adult sizes and 62 to 64 cm for our XXXL design, and the adjustable chin strap or an inner drawcord fine-tunes the fit.

Our nylon, polyester and spandex-blend bucket hats with taped or overlocked seams and a soft, unstiffened brim can go into pools and the sea again and again, as long as they are rinsed in fresh water and dried after use. Natural straw and crochet hats are for beach and resort wear only, because soaking weakens the fibre and the crown loses its shape.
For hair, we offer hair elastics and adjustable headbands.
We check that accessories match the colour of the main fabric, paying special attention to custom-dyed parts. We also inspect matte, glossy and brushed finishes for evenness and surface quality.
We test accessories both on their own and fitted to the actual garment.

On all our children's styles, every snap, ring, slider, buckle, bead and trim is sewn or riveted on and must pass a 90 N pull test. Sizes for under-3s have no removable decorations at all. Kids' designs never include hanging charms, stones fixed with glue or heat, or beads small enough to swallow. We stitch rubber patches and appliqués down around their whole edge instead of only gluing them, so repeated chlorine and washing can't lift them. Our metal hardware is tested against the EN 1811 nickel-release limit and keeps lead under the CPSIA limits: 100 ppm in the base metal and 90 ppm in any coating. We can arrange order-specific testing at an accredited lab, with the fees passed to you at cost.

Yes. Instead of silicone, we can use a textured polyurethane grip print or a ribbed or plush-back elastic, or make the edge band 1 to 2 cm shorter so tension holds the garment in place. We sample the option you choose on your own style, so you can check the hold before bulk production.

Yes. For straps, scrunchies, hair elastics and headbands meant for latex-sensitive customers, we can use spandex-covered elastic or clear TPU elastic instead of rubber thread. We mark these parts as latex-free on your trim sheet and store them separately during production.

Yes. For children's bucket hats we can fit a breakaway chin strap with a plastic safety clip that releases under a pull of about 25 to 45 N. We can also leave the strap off and hold the hat in place with an elasticated inner band and an adjustable toggle at the back of the crown.

The most common problems are tarnished plating, rust marks, loose stones or beads, and elastic or grip tape that goes slack. To prevent them, we seal plated hardware with a protective lacquer, soak-test hardware in salt water for 24 hours, pull-test sewn and heat-pressed stones, and stretch-test elastics and grip tape before bulk. Tell your customers to rinse in cool fresh water after every swim, hand wash with mild soap, dry flat in the shade, and keep the piece away from hot tubs, sunscreen oils and tumble dryers.

We supply beads from 6 mm to 20 mm across, with bore diameters of 2, 3, 4 or 5 mm, to fit ties and cords from 1.5 mm to 4.5 mm thick. If you send us a 20 cm length of your cord, we match the bore so each bead slides on with light friction and stays where you place it.

Resin or plastic parts cost less per piece than metal. Stock hardware and beads cost less than custom-moulded ones, which also carry a one-off mould development fee. Standard gold or silver plating costs less than special finishes such as rose gold, gunmetal or matte black. Heat-press embellishment is quicker and cheaper than sewing stones on by hand, and plain liners and packaging cost less than printed ones.

pages.h1: Plus-Size Swimwear Manufacturer for Supportive, Private-Label Styles
pages.hero_lead: Under OEM or ODM, you pick strapless, halter, sleeveless or cut-out silhouettes, and our contoured seams shape every bikini, one-piece and matching set to your design brief.

sections.heading: OEM and ODM Plus-Size Swimsuits Shaped to Your Design Brief
sections.body: We make your women’s plus-size swimwear under OEM or ODM, so your bikinis, one-piece swimsuits and matching sets all come from one source. Contoured seams shape the silhouette. We let you pick the silhouette for every swimsuit, whether that's strapless, halter, sleeveless or cut-out, matched to your design brief.

sections.heading: Wholesale Plus-Size Tankinis, Swim Dresses and 50-Piece Minimums

items.title: Longline tankinis
items.text: We make tankinis that reach past the hip, with ruched sides, empire waists, halter or cross-back straps, and loose babydoll or swing shapes.

items.title: Mix-and-match bottoms
items.text: You can pair tops with classic or high-waisted briefs, boy-shorts, swim shorts or swim skirts, so your customers choose coverage for bust, tummy and thighs separately.

items.title: Fuller coverage
items.text: We also make swim dresses and modest one-pieces, which give you fuller-coverage options next to the separates in your range.

items.title: Stock commitments
items.text: Every extra separate adds styles and sizes you have to stock. If your budget is small, start with a few key tankini-and-bottom pairings to keep the range focused.

items.title: Minimum order
items.text: Orders start at 50 pieces per style in each colour. For first trials, we agree quantities with you case by case within production limits.

sections.heading: China Factory Terms: Samples, Lead Times, Payment and Shipping
sections.body: We make swimwear in our own factory, our only one, in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China.

items.title: Sample terms
items.text: A standard sample takes 10 to 15 days and costs USD 50. Design fees are USD 50 per pattern or print and cover all colourways. We don't refund or credit either fee.

items.title: Production and payment
items.text: Once you approve the sample and we receive your 50% confirmation deposit, bulk production takes 35 to 40 days, depending on order size and season. A full final inspection follows, and the remaining 50% is due before shipment.

items.title: Shipping terms
items.text: We ship on FOB, CIF or DDP terms. With worldwide DDP, we handle door delivery, duties, customs and freight for one all-in price.

items.title: Delivery and packing
items.text: Under our [sample delivery and packing terms](/faq/), courier cost adds USD 50. You can mix sizes and colours, mixed-ratio cartons are free, and for larger sizes we recommend 4 each of L, XL and 2XL per carton.

items.title: Quote before sampling
items.text: Through our [quotation process](/request-a-quote/), we agree the price with you before we start making your sample.

items.title: Enquiry response
items.text: When you [contact our team](/contact-us/), you'll get a reply within one business day. We answer every enquiry, so you know when to expect to hear from us.

items.title: Factory ownership
items.text: We've run our [factory and export business](/about-us/) since 2011. That keeps quality, cost and delivery under our direct control, and you agree orders directly with our team.

items.title: Production credentials
items.text: Our [production credentials](/sustainability/) are OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for tested fabrics and trims, GRS and RCS for recycled fabrics, bluesign for chemistry, ISO 9001 for quality management and WRAP for social compliance.

sections.heading: Bust, Tummy and Waistband Support That Stays in Place
sections.body: We match each support feature to its job, solving digging straps, rolling waistbands and riding leg openings at the pattern stage, without stacking every feature onto one suit.

items.title: Straps and bands
items.text: For plus-size and extended-cup ranges, we reposition and widen adjustable straps, widen back bands, reinforce the underbust elastic and build in bust support.

items.title: Cup options
items.text: Structured underwire tops run from D through DD+ up to a G cup. Moulded cups come in A to DD.

items.title: Cup-sized construction
items.text: If you ask, we add underwire channels and grade to your size chart. Cup-sized underwire gives the best support, but every band-and-cup combination counts as its own size.

items.title: Removable padding
items.text: Our bikinis and one-piece sets come with removable padding, so the wearer can adjust coverage and shaping herself.

items.title: Firm tummy control
items.text: Where your design needs firm control, a separate power mesh front panel anchored into the side seams provides it.

items.title: Light front smoothing
items.text: A double front lining gives light smoothing and opacity without the compression of a shaping construction.

items.title: Strongest shaping
items.text: We cut the front body or the whole suit in compression swim fabric, and add an extra power mesh panel if you specify one.

items.title: Secure waistbands
items.text: Our waistbands are 3 to 4 cm wide, with fully enclosed rubber elastic stitched through every layer. Where it's needed, we add a high-waisted cut or a side-seam bone.

sections.heading: Heavier Fabrics, Full Front Linings and Power Mesh

items.title: Heavier base fabric
items.text: For larger sizes we specify about 200 to 220 gsm, in 80% nylon 20% spandex or a higher-spandex blend. It holds its shape better and stays more opaque under larger-size stretch than our standard 180–200 GSM fabric.

items.title: Lining and trade-offs
items.text: Full front linings are 140 gsm nylon-spandex, and we add power mesh only where you need extra hold. Heavier fabric and full linings cost more and dry more slowly, so they work against very lightweight or resort briefs.

items.title: Specialist fabric sourcing
items.text: Our [fabric sourcing](/swimwear-fabrics-sourcing/) covers nylon and polyester blended with spandex. On request, you can also have chlorine-resistant LYCRA Xtra Life, ECONYL recycled nylon, REPREVE recycled polyester and Italian Carvico.

items.title: Hardware performance
items.text: Our [Swimwear Hardware service](/swimwear-hardware/) supplies elastics and straps from 3 mm to 25 mm wide. They recover 95% or more of their stretch after 100 cycles and withstand more than 200 hours of chlorine exposure.

sections.heading: Your Designs, Size-by-Size Print Placement and Private Label Branding
sections.body:
We help you choose designs that suit plus-size customers, and we apply your private label. We place and approve your artwork size by size, so focal motifs stay in the right position as bust and abdomen panels grow. We don't just scale up the base-size artwork.

Size-by-size placement adds artwork time and an approval round. All-over prints that need no placement move faster. Our [custom printing](/custom-swimwear-printing/) includes leopard and floral motifs for one-piece swimsuits.

sections.heading: Ready-to-Brand Curvy Collections and Low-MOQ Trend Drops

items.title: Test market demand
items.text: Our low-MOQ, ready-to-brand trend drops let you test what sells in your market before you commit to larger orders and to full-custom pattern and sampling costs.

items.title: Know the trade-off
items.text: Ready-to-brand styles aren't exclusive to your label, and they give you less control over fit and fabric than custom development does.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions

qa.question: Can you take our current straight-size styles and extend them into plus sizes with adjusted fit and support?
qa.answer: Yes. We extend your styles up to 5XL by redrafting each one on a 2XL base, regrading it and adjusting the support. That means we reposition straps, widen back bands, reinforce the underbust elastic and add built-in bust support. We sample each extended style in 10 to 15 days, and you approve the fit before bulk production starts.

qa.question: What makes a plus-size style cost more than a standard-size style, such as extra fabric, underwires, shaping linings or extra sizes?
qa.answer: Larger sizes use more fabric. Underwires, moulded or cup-sized construction, power mesh and shaping linings add materials and sewing time. Dedicated base patterns, fit sessions and extra graded sizes add development time and cost. With band-and-cup sizing, every combination counts as its own size.

qa.question: How do you verify that bust support and coverage remain secure when a plus-size suit is wet and the wearer swims or bends?
qa.answer: We check the sample against your measurement sheet on a real 2XL fit model, then wet-test it before grading. She swims, bends and lifts her arms for at least 30 minutes while we check support, stretch, coverage and opacity. Finished-measurement tolerances are -0.5 to 0.5 cm for straps and bindings and -1 to 1 cm for body measurements.

qa.question: Do you build plus-size patterns from a dedicated plus-size base size, or simply grade up a regular-size pattern?
qa.answer: We start from a dedicated 2XL base pattern fitted on a 2XL model and grade up to 5XL from there. We don't just enlarge a straight-size pattern. Bust, waist and hip grading steps are 5 cm per size, against 4 cm in straight sizes. Extra length in the rise, straps and back band keeps the coverage as body proportions change.

facts.text: We produce custom plus-size swimwear for women under OEM or ODM, covering bikinis, one-piece swimsuits and matching sets, so your whole plus-size line can come from a single source. Our plus-size patterns use contoured seaming that shapes the silhouette.
You choose the silhouette for each swimsuit. We can make strapless, halter, sleeveless or cut-out styles to match your design brief.
Orders start at 50 pieces per style in each colour, a level set so that small and growing labels can order.

Besides bikinis and one-pieces, we make plus-size tankinis in longline lengths that reach past the hip, with ruched sides, empire waists, halter or cross-back straps, or loose babydoll and swing shapes. You can pair them with classic or high-waisted briefs, boy-shorts, swim shorts or swim skirts, and we also make swim dresses and modest one-pieces with fuller coverage.

Please grade bulk quantities by size in multiples such as 5, 10, 15, 20 or 6, 12, 18, 24. If you need larger sizes, we recommend 4 L, 4 XL and 4 2X.
We manufacture swimwear ourselves in a single factory of our own in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China.
Once the sample is approved and the deposit received, bulk production usually needs 35 to 40 days, depending on order size and season.

Shipments go out on FOB, CIF or DDP terms; DDP is available worldwide, and under DDP one all-in price covers delivery to your door, with duties, customs and freight handled by us.

A typical order moves from your brief or tech pack to a sample in 10 to 15 days, then to your approval and deposit, 35 to 40 days of bulk production depending on size and season, a full final inspection, and shipment on FOB, CIF or DDP terms.
We take a 50% deposit when the order is confirmed, and the remaining 50% is paid before shipment.
Courier delivery of samples costs USD 50, paid by the buyer in addition to the sample fee.
We quote first: once the price is agreed, we move on to making the sample.
We reply to every enquiry within one business day.
Production and export sit in one company that owns its factory, so quality, cost and delivery stay under our direct control.
The factory has been running since 2011.

We are a business-to-business manufacturer: this website and our own team are our only sales channels. We have no online shop and no store on any third-party marketplace or platform, and every order is agreed directly with our team.
Our production holds OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for tested fabrics and trims, GRS and RCS for recycled fabrics, bluesign for chemistry, ISO 9001 for quality management and WRAP for social compliance.

For plus-size and extended-cup ranges, we reposition the straps, widen the back bands and reinforce the underbust elastic. We also use wider, adjustable straps, secure elastics and built-in bust support. On request we can make cup-sized versions with underwire channels, and we also offer underwire bikini tops and high-waisted bottoms.

For extended-cup plus-size tops, our structured underwire styles run from D through DD+ up to a G cup, and our moulded cups come in A to DD. We grade band-and-cup sizes to your own size chart, and each band-and-cup combination counts as one size.
We can make bikinis and one-piece sets with removable padding, so the wearer can adjust coverage and shaping.

For tummy control we can add a separate power mesh panel across the front, anchored into the side seams for firm control, or a double front lining for light smoothing and extra opacity without real compression. For the strongest shaping, we cut the front body or the whole suit in a compression swim fabric, which you can also combine with a power mesh panel.

The most common problems with plus-size swimsuits are waistbands that roll down, straps that dig in, leg openings that ride up and fabric that turns see-through when stretched, so we design against each of them from the pattern stage. To stop waistbands rolling, we use a 3 to 4 cm wide waistband with a fully enclosed rubber elastic stitched through all layers, add a high-waisted cut or a side-seam bone where needed, and combine it with the wider adjustable straps and reinforced underbust elastic used on our plus-size tops.

For plus-size suits we recommend a heavier swim fabric of about 200 to 220 gsm in 80% nylon 20% spandex or a blend with more spandex, which holds its shape and stays opaque better than our standard 180–200 GSM swim fabric. We pair it with a full front lining in a 140 gsm nylon-spandex lining fabric and add power mesh where you need extra hold.

We make swimwear from nylon and polyester swimwear fabrics blended with spandex, such as 80% nylon 20% spandex, with matching linings. On request we source chlorine-resistant LYCRA Xtra Life, recycled nylon such as ECONYL, recycled polyester such as REPREVE, and Italian Carvico fabrics.

Our trims include power mesh, adjustable bra straps, decorative braided cords and chlorine-resistant elastic bands for swimwear. The elastics and straps are made from nylon/spandex blends or polyester, come in widths from 3 mm to 25 mm, recover 95% or more of their stretch after 100 cycles and withstand more than 200 hours of chlorine exposure.
Quality is checked at every stage of an order: fabric on arrival, cutting, sewing, then random checks and a full final inspection.

For your plus size bikinis and one-piece swimsuits, we take care of supportive fit development, selecting premium materials, placing prints, applying your own private label and developing on-trend designs.
Our team helps you pick designs and styles that suit plus-sized customers.

Yes, we set up placement artwork separately for each style and size, positioning the file digitally on every graded pattern piece before printing so the focal motif stays correctly placed as the bust and abdomen panels grow. You approve the digital placement for each size before we print the bulk fabric.
We offer custom prints, for example leopard or floral motifs on one-piece swimsuits.
We offer trend-driven plus size collections in low-MOQ drops, so you can test new styles before you place larger orders.

If you would rather not start from scratch, you can choose from ready-to-brand collections for women, men, kids and plus sizes. We keep developing these alongside our fully custom work. The styles are already designed and patterned, and they are graded in advance to international body sizes. Bottoms come in full, medium or cheeky coverage, and our designers refresh the collections every season to follow trends. You select styles from the range, specify your fabrics and colours, and we produce and label them under your brand, adding your custom heat-pressed logo.

Yes, we can extend your current straight-size styles into plus sizes up to 5XL: our in-house pattern team redrafts each style on a 2XL base, regrades it, and adjusts the construction with repositioned straps, wider back bands, reinforced underbust elastic and built-in bust support. Each extended style is sampled in 10 to 15 days so you can approve the fit before bulk production.

A plus-size style usually costs more than its straight-size version because larger sizes use more fabric per piece, while underwires, moulded or cup-sized construction and power mesh or shaping linings add materials and sewing time. Grading more extended sizes also adds pattern and sampling work, and with band-and-cup sizing each band-and-cup combination counts as one size.

Before any plus-size style is graded across its size range, we fit it on a real fit model in our 2XL base size and check it against your measurement sheet. She then wears it wet in the water for no less than 30 minutes, swimming, bending and lifting her arms, while we confirm that bust support, stretch, coverage and opacity all stay in place. Straps and bindings are held to ±0.5 cm of the finished measurement, and body measurements to ±1 cm, so every graded size keeps the support you signed off on the fit model.

We draft plus-size styles on their own 2XL base pattern, fitted on a 2XL fit model, instead of grading up a straight-size pattern, and then grade from that base up to 5XL. In the plus range we use larger grading steps of 5 cm per size on bust, waist and hip, compared with 4 cm in straight sizes, and we add extra length to the rise, straps and back band so coverage keeps up with the body.

sections.heading: Matching Cover-Ups, Resort Shirts and Order Minimums

items.title: Coordinating pieces
items.text: We carry your set's print onto sarongs, kimonos, beach dresses and men's short-sleeve resort shirts. We print and sew them in our factory alongside your swimwear.

items.title: Shared production run
items.text: If you start with one or two coordinating pieces printed from the same artwork in the same production window, colour and scale stay consistent across the swimwear and the lighter fabrics.

items.title: Separate style minimums
items.text: Each added item starts at 50 pieces per colour, so a wider capsule ties up more stock and budget than swimwear alone.

items.title: First trial orders
items.text: We agree quantities for a first trial order case by case. How flexible we can be depends on what production allows.

sections.heading: Our Own Swimsuit Factory in China
sections.body: We make your swimwear in our own factory in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China. It's a single factory, and our company owns it. Our [factory and export operation](/about-us/) are part of the same company, so we control quality, cost and delivery directly. We check your goods throughout production and again before shipment. Our [production certifications](/sustainability/) include OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for tested fabrics and trims, GRS and RCS for recycled fabrics, bluesign for chemistry, ISO 9001 for quality management and WRAP for social compliance.

sections.heading: Get Your Matching Swimsuit Quote and Sample

items.title: Design information
items.text: Send us front and back images, tech packs or clear line drawings, and we'll base your quotation on them.

items.title: Detailed quotation
items.text: Once your design information is complete, you get your [quotation](/request-a-quote/) within 2 to 3 working days. It covers sampling, fabrics, accessories, branding, labelling, production and shipping.

items.title: Standard samples
items.text: We make a standard sample in 10 to 15 days so you can review it before you approve bulk production.

items.title: Sample and design fees
items.text: Each sample costs USD 50. Each design also costs USD 50, which covers its pattern or print and all of its colourways. Neither fee is refunded or credited.

items.title: Enquiry response

sections.heading: Bulk Lead Times, Payment Terms and Shipping Options

items.title: Bulk production timing
items.text: Once you've approved the sample and we've received your deposit, bulk production takes 35 to 40 days. Your order size and the season decide where in that range it falls.

items.title: Payment schedule
items.text: You pay a 50% deposit when you confirm the order and the other 50% before shipment.

items.title: Shipping terms
items.text: We ship on FOB, CIF or DDP terms. With worldwide DDP, you get one all-in price for delivery to your door, and we handle the duties, customs and freight.

items.title: Sample courier charge
items.text: Under our [sample delivery terms](/faq/), you pay a USD 50 courier charge on top of the sample fee.

sections.heading: Design Support and Colour-Matched Fabrics for Each Set

items.title: Design starting points
items.text: With our [OEM and ODM development](/development/), you can start a new couples style from your own design, a picture or an idea.

items.title: Fabric and colour decisions
items.text: Our design specialists develop the line with you. They settle the fabrics and colour for both styles before sampling, so the two pieces hold the same colour.

items.title: Paired sample approval
items.text: We always approve the two samples together, never one at a time, and we check sizing, fit, proportion and shade. If you change one piece and its partner then needs checking again against it, that adds a sampling round.

items.title: Fabric sourcing options
items.text: Our [fabric sourcing](/swimwear-fabrics-sourcing/) covers nylon and polyester blended with spandex, including 80% nylon 20% spandex, plus matching linings. If you ask, we also supply chlorine-resistant LYCRA Xtra Life, recycled ECONYL nylon, recycled REPREVE polyester and Italian Carvico fabrics.

sections.heading: Custom Prints Matched Across Different Fabrics
sections.body: If your set uses different fabrics, your print goes through four steps: a digital preview, shared artwork, separate colour matching for each fabric, and a physical review of the two pieces together. A screen can't show how each fabric base takes the print. Approving the preview settles scale and placement, but it doesn't give you reliable colour agreement. Waiting for physical samples takes longer than approving on screen alone, but it avoids colour surprises in production. Our [Custom Printing service](/custom-swimwear-printing/) uses water-based digital printing with calibrated colour. That gives you sharp, high-resolution artwork, less deviation on stretch fabric and consistent colour from one run to the next.

sections.heading: Keeping Colour Consistent Between His and Hers Pieces
sections.body: Different dye lots are the most common reason his and hers pieces look mismatched under shop lighting. We plan a single dye lot to cover both pieces for your whole order, which removes that cause, and we check the pair together at final inspection. If you reorder the matching pieces together, the restock stays coordinated. If a later reorder needs a new dye lot, it has to be colour-matched against your earlier stock. To keep the pair matched after wear, we use the same fabric base and print method for both pieces, and you can choose the chlorine-resistant fabric option for both garments.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions

qa.question: Which women's and men's styles can be paired into one couples matching set?
qa.answer: Any women's style we make can go with men's swim trunks, board shorts or swim briefs in the same print or colour story. That includes triangle and bandeau bikinis, one-pieces and tankinis. One print also works for more than one pairing, so you could match a bikini and a one-piece to the same trunks.

qa.question: Do you have ready-made couples matching designs we can brand or buy wholesale, or does every set have to be custom developed?
qa.answer: You don't have to develop every set from scratch. We hold some styles for wholesale, so ask us which couples designs are available right now. Our ready-made designs stay open to every buyer, but your prints, artwork and branding are used only for you. Any custom or ODM couples set we develop for your brand is exclusive to you.

qa.question: How does positioning coordinated motifs on both garments affect fabric use and cutting cost compared with sharing an all-over repeat print?
qa.answer: Placed coordinated motifs use about 10 to 15% more fabric than an all-over repeat, because every panel has to line up with the print. Each piece takes longer to cut and costs more. The artwork has to be made for each size, and we charge physical approval strike-offs separately for each motif. An all-over repeat covers both pieces, nests tightly with the least waste and makes size grading simpler, so it's the easier choice for a first collection. If you keep placed motifs for a few hero sets, you limit the extra work and still get the deliberate, mirrored placement an all-over repeat can't give you.

facts.text: We manufacture coordinated swimwear sets designed for couples, and you can order these matching swimsuits as private label goods carrying your own brand.

Yes, the women's and men's pieces in a couples set are separate styles, so you can order different quantities of each as long as every style reaches 50 pieces per colour. Each style is split over 3 to 4 sizes, usually at an S:M:L:XL ratio of 1:2:2:1, and you can set a different size ratio for the men's pieces and the women's pieces.
Orders start at 50 pieces per style in each colour, a level set so that small and growing labels can order.
A first trial run is agreed case by case, and we are as flexible on its quantity as production allows.

Yes, we can carry the same print from a couples set onto a matching cover-up, such as a sarong, kimono or beach dress, and onto a men's short-sleeve resort shirt, all printed from one artwork so the whole look reads as a single story. Each added item counts as its own style, starting at 50 pieces per colour, and is printed and sewn in our own factory alongside the swimwear.
We manufacture swimwear ourselves in a single factory of our own in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China.
Production and export sit in one company that owns its factory, so quality, cost and delivery stay under our direct control.
Our production holds OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for tested fabrics and trims, GRS and RCS for recycled fabrics, bluesign for chemistry, ISO 9001 for quality management and WRAP for social compliance.
Quality is checked at every stage of an order: fabric on arrival, cutting, sewing, then random checks and a full final inspection.
A standard sample is ready in 10 to 15 days.
Each sample costs USD 50, and the design fee is USD 50 per design (its pattern or print, with all colourways); these fees are not refunded or credited against the bulk order.

A typical order moves from your brief or tech pack to a sample in 10 to 15 days, then to your approval and deposit, 35 to 40 days of bulk production depending on size and season, a full final inspection, and shipment on FOB, CIF or DDP terms.

It covers everything from sampling to manufacturing, including fabrics, accessories, branding, labelling, production and shipping, and can be based on front and back images, tech packs or clear line drawings.

Our design specialists work with you to build out your couples' matching swimwear line. We choose fabrics that hold the same color across the men's and women's styles in a set, and we review the samples for each matching set so the sizing and the overall look of both pieces line up.
Both OEM and ODM work is possible: a new style can start from your own design, a picture or just an idea.

We make swimwear from nylon and polyester swimwear fabrics blended with spandex, such as 80% nylon 20% spandex, with matching linings. On request we source chlorine-resistant LYCRA Xtra Life, recycled nylon such as ECONYL, recycled polyester such as REPREVE, and Italian Carvico fabrics.

When the women's suit and the men's trunks are cut from different fabrics, we first send you a digital preview of the print on each fabric, showing colour matching, motif scale and placement on both garments. We then print both pieces from the same artwork file at the same scale, colour-match each fabric separately, and compare the two pieces side by side on the samples for every set.

Our swimwear printing produces sharp, high-resolution artwork and keeps colour consistent from one production run to the next. We use water-based digital printing and calibrate colour to reduce print deviation on stretch fabric. Other printing and embellishment options are also available.

The most common cause is cutting the men's and women's pieces from different dye lots, which can look mismatched under shop lighting, so we cut both pieces of a set from the same lot; a different fabric base (nylon versus polyester) or print method, and uneven fading from chlorine, sun and salt water, can also make them drift apart after wear. To limit this, we choose fabrics that hold the same colour across both styles, check the two pieces together at final inspection, and can use chlorine-resistant LYCRA Xtra Life for both garments.

A couples set can pair any women's style we make, such as a triangle or bandeau bikini, a one-piece or a tankini, with men's swim trunks, board shorts or swim briefs, in the same print or colour story. You can also offer more than one pairing per print, for example a bikini and a one-piece both matched to the same men's trunks.

You don't have to develop every set from scratch: some styles are held in stock for wholesale, so ask us whether any couples designs are available now. These ready-to-go designs stay in our range for all buyers, but the prints, artwork and branding you put on them are used only for you, and any custom or ODM couples sets we develop for your brand are exclusive to you.

Placing coordinated motifs on each garment usually uses about 10 to 15% more fabric than an all-over repeat, because every panel has to be lined up on the print instead of nested freely, and placement cutting takes longer per piece, so cutting costs more; an all-over repeat lets us nest men's and women's panels tightly with the least waste. Placed motifs also need artwork set for each size, and physical strike-offs for print approval are charged separately per motif, whereas one all-over repeat can serve both pieces of the set.
